candidates.principal_decision: Apply postop cardiac reasoning for Postoperative Cardiac Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postoperative myocardial ischemia, arrhythmia, and heart failure and initiate appropriate management/escalation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pattern recognition reasoning for Forearm (Radius/Ulna) Shaft Fractures (Monteggia, Nightstick, Galeazzi).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the 'fracture of necessity' principle (all forearm shaft fractures with joint involvement are operative), and identify the classic eponymous patterns: Monteggia (ulna fracture + radial head dislocation -- always image the elbow), Galeazzi (radius fracture + DRUJ dislocation -- always image the wrist), and isolated ulnar shaft (nightstick) fracture from a direct blow.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Infectious Mononucleosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize infectious mononucleosis (exudative pharyngitis, posterior cervical lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, atypical lymphocytosis, positive heterophile/monospot) and counsel on contact-sport avoidance for splenic-rupture risk and the amoxicillin-induced-rash pitfall if mistaken for strep throat.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic distal-greater-than-proximal weakness, myotonia (delayed muscle relaxation), frontal balding, and cardiac conduction abnormalities of myotonic dystrophy type 1, and its autosomal dominant trinucleotide-repeat inheritance with anticipation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Bronchiolitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose bronchiolitis clinically (viral URI prodrome progressing to wheeze/crackles/respiratory distress in a child <2 yr) and recognize that management is primarily supportive (no evidence benefit for bronchodilators/corticosteroids in typical cases), with palivizumab prophylaxis reserved for defined high-risk infants.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Congestive Heart Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate guideline-directed medical therapy principles and manage acute decompensation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate management plan for symptomatic vs. asymptomatic hyponatremia/hypernatremia, including correction-rate safety limits to avoid osmotic demyelination/cerebral edema.
candidates.study_unit: Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Renal Replacement Therapy: Dialysis Modalities, Indications, and Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for urgent/chronic dialysis and select an appropriate modality (peritoneal dialysis vs. hemodialysis) based on patient factors.
candidates.study_unit: Renal Replacement Therapy: Dialysis Modalities, Indications, and Complications

candidates.principal_decision: Apply tft interpretation reasoning for Tests of Thyroid Function and Structure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret TSH and free T4 patterns to localize thyroid dysfunction (primary vs. central) and select confirmatory antibody or imaging tests.
candidates.study_unit: Tests of Thyroid Function and Structure

candidates.principal_decision: Apply infectious esophagitis recognition reasoning for Infectious Esophagitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize odynophagia in an immunocompromised patient as suggestive of infectious esophagitis (candida, HSV, CMV) and initiate appropriate investigation/treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cholecystitis diagnosis reasoning for Biliary Colic and Cholecystitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose biliary colic and acute cholecystitis (RUQ pain, Murphy's sign, ultrasound findings) and initiate appropriate management including surgical referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Vitamin K Deficiency (Hemorrhagic Disease of the Newborn).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize vitamin K deficiency bleeding (early/classic/late forms) as preventable with routine intramuscular vitamin K administration at birth, and the increased risk in exclusively breastfed infants who did not receive prophylaxis.
candidates.study_unit: Vitamin K Deficiency (Hemorrhagic Disease of the Newborn)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Hyphema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize traumatic hyphema, know the risk of secondary rebleed and elevated IOP, and manage with activity restriction, upright positioning, and ophthalmology follow-up (avoiding NSAIDs/aspirin).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Ocular Problems in the Contact Lens Wearer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize contact-lens-associated red eye/pain as requiring urgent slit-lamp assessment to exclude microbial keratitis, and counsel on lens-hygiene risk factors.
candidates.study_unit: Ocular Problems in the Contact Lens Wearer

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Other Parkinsonian Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize red flags (early falls, poor levodopa response, early autonomic failure/dementia) that suggest an atypical parkinsonian syndrome rather than idiopathic Parkinson's disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply bedside tests reasoning for Approach to Hearing Loss (Physiology, DDx, Bedside Tuning Fork Tests).
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform and interpret the Rinne test (AC vs. BC on the affected ear) and Weber test (lateralization) to distinguish conductive from sensorineural hearing loss at the bedside, and generate an age-appropriate differential for hearing loss (congenital/genetic, infectious, ototoxic, traumatic, neoplastic) before ordering audiometry.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Hearing Loss (Physiology, DDx, Bedside Tuning Fork Tests)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk vs harm reduction reasoning for Health Promotion, Behaviour Change, and Community Needs Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish risk reduction from harm reduction interventions.
candidates.study_unit: Health Promotion, Behaviour Change, and Community Needs Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications and emergencies reasoning for Sickle Cell Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sickle cell disease's key pediatric emergencies (fever as a sepsis emergency given functional asplenia, vaso-occlusive pain crisis, acute chest syndrome, splenic sequestration, aplastic crisis) and the role of newborn screening and penicillin prophylaxis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Congestive Heart Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize signs/symptoms of decompensated heart failure (volume overload, reduced perfusion).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply brain death pvs reasoning for Neurologically Determined Death (Brain Death) and Persistent Vegetative State.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical concept of neurologically determined death and persistent vegetative state and the need for specialist/legal processes (e.g., organ donation referral) without requiring the detailed confirmatory testing protocol.
candidates.study_unit: Neurologically Determined Death (Brain Death) and Persistent Vegetative State

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for von Willebrand's Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize vWD (mucocutaneous bleeding pattern, autosomal inheritance, normal-to-prolonged PTT, abnormal vWF antigen/activity/factor VIII assays) as the most common inherited bleeding disorder.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pediatric Congenital Urologic Abnormalities.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common congenital urologic abnormalities and urgent obstructive/infectious complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply outbreak measures reasoning for Outbreak, Epidemic, and Pandemic Definitions and Measures.
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate and interpret attack rate, secondary attack rate, case-fatality rate, and basic reproduction number (R0), and distinguish case-fatality rate from the general mortality rate.
candidates.study_unit: Outbreak, Epidemic, and Pandemic Definitions and Measures

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Drug- and Treatment-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Review culprit exposure, assess severity and oxygenation, stop or withhold a suspected agent when safe, and seek specialist input.
candidates.study_unit: Drug- and Treatment-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply legal professional action reasoning for Confidentiality.
candidates.source_competency_text: Maintain patient confidentiality and recognize the recognized exceptions (duty to warn, mandatory reporting).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Heart Murmurs (Innocent vs. Pathologic).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate innocent/functional pediatric murmurs (soft, systolic, no associated symptoms, normal exam otherwise) from pathologic murmurs (diastolic, holosystolic, harsh/loud, associated with symptoms or abnormal exam findings) using history and physical exam features.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply classification reasoning for Normocytic Anemia (Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Use the reticulocyte count to differentiate hypoproliferative normocytic anemia (e.g., early iron deficiency, anemia of chronic disease, bone marrow failure) from a hyperproliferative response (hemolysis, acute blood loss).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply polymorphism reasoning for Drug Metabolism and Cytochrome P450-Mediated Interactions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize genetic CYP polymorphism (poor/ultra-rapid metabolizer) as a cause of unpredictable drug response, using the codeine/tramadol/tamoxifen (CYP2D6) and warfarin (CYP2C9) examples.
candidates.study_unit: Drug Metabolism and Cytochrome P450-Mediated Interactions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sjs ten recognition reasoning for Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (SJS/TEN).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize SJS/TEN by prodromal targetoid/purpuric rash progressing to positive Nikolsky sign, full-thickness epidermal detachment, and mucosal erosions, and classify severity by percent BSA detachment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and urgency reasoning for Ectopic Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ectopic pregnancy as a life-threatening cause of early pregnancy bleeding/pain, identify risk factors, and initiate urgent investigation (beta-hCG trend, transvaginal ultrasound) and management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply preconception counselling reasoning for Preconception Counselling.
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel a patient planning pregnancy on folic acid supplementation, immunization status, medication review, and modifiable risk factors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prognostication reasoning for Communication in Palliative Care (incl. SPIKES Protocol for Breaking Bad News).
candidates.source_competency_text: Communicate prognosis using imprecise time-frame language (e.g., hours to days, weeks to months) rather than an overly specific estimate, recognizing that clinicians consistently overestimate survival.
candidates.study_unit: Communication in Palliative Care (incl. SPIKES Protocol for Breaking Bad News)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply herniation recognition reasoning for Herniation Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given clinical findings (blown pupil, decorticate/decerebrate posturing, Cushing's triad), identify the herniation syndrome and its urgency.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish ARFID from anorexia nervosa by the absence of body-image disturbance/fear of weight gain, recognizing it can occur in children and adults for sensory, low-interest, or fear-of-consequence (e.g., choking) reasons.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Anemia (Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of anemia in a given patient population.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply iufd management reasoning for Intrauterine Fetal Demise.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize intrauterine fetal demise, investigate possible causes, and outline the delivery-planning and bereavement-support approach.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply graves diagnosis reasoning for Graves' Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Graves' disease by hyperthyroid symptoms, diffuse goitre, and TSH-receptor antibodies, and recognize Graves' orbitopathy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gh excess reasoning for Growth Hormone Disorders (Deficiency and Excess/Acromegaly).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acromegaly (adults) and gigantism (children) as GH-excess presentations and initiate appropriate workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply next step reasoning for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Exclude common alternative exposures or systemic causes, assess oxygenation, and refer for specialist confirmation and management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cholesteatoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a 'small white pearl' behind an intact TM (congenital) or foul-smelling chronic otorrhea with a retraction pocket/perforation (acquired) as cholesteatoma requiring otolaryngology referral for surgical excision given its erosive, complication-prone course.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fever reasoning for Fever.
candidates.source_competency_text: Evaluate fever in a primary-care patient, ruling out life-threatening causes and differentiating benign self-limited illness from causes requiring urgent management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sch risk reasoning for Muscle Relaxants, Reversal Agents, and Induction Analgesia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize patient populations at risk of succinylcholine-induced hyperkalemia (burns >24h, neuromuscular disease, severe infection, closed head injury) as a contraindication.
candidates.study_unit: Muscle Relaxants, Reversal Agents, and Induction Analgesia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply history reasoning for Urologic History and Initial Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Elicit urinary, sexual, constitutional and risk-factor history and identify red flags.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Schizophrenia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the diagnostic pattern of schizophrenia (positive/negative/cognitive symptom domains, duration criteria, functional decline) and differentiate from other psychotic disorders by duration and course.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and workup reasoning for Abnormal Uterine Bleeding.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause of abnormal uterine bleeding (structural vs. non-structural, e.g. PALM-COEIN framework) across the reproductive lifespan (adolescent, reproductive-age, perimenopausal, postmenopausal) and initiate appropriate investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Transposition of the Great Arteries (TGA).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize TGA's ductal-dependent physiology (progressive hypoxemia unresponsive to oxygen as the ductus closes), egg-shaped-heart CXR sign, and the emergency management sequence (prostaglandin E1 to maintain ductal patency, balloon atrial septostomy, definitive arterial switch surgery).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply penetrating neck trauma reasoning for Chest Trauma (incl. Penetrating Neck Trauma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a zone-based approach to penetrating neck trauma assessment and management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply concept reasoning for Reconstructive Ladder and Skin Grafting.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the reconstructive-ladder concept (primary closure -> healing by secondary intention -> skin graft -> local/regional flap -> free flap) as a framework for escalating wound-closure complexity, without needing to select or perform a specific technique.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply named interactions reasoning for Drug Interactions (Mechanisms and Clinically Significant Examples).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical consequence of the chapter's named high-yield interaction pairs (warfarin + macrolide/quinolone/TMP-SMX/metronidazole -> increased INR; warfarin + acetaminophen -> increased INR with chronic high-dose use; OCP + rifampin -> contraceptive failure; sildenafil + nitrates -> severe hypotension; SSRI + St. John's wort/MAOI -> serotonin syndrome; statin + macrolide/azole/fibrate/niacin -> rhabdomyolysis; TMP-SMX + ACEi/ARB/spironolactone -> hyperkalemia).
candidates.study_unit: Drug Interactions (Mechanisms and Clinically Significant Examples)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply deprescribing reasoning for Polypharmacy and Inappropriate Prescribing in Older Adults.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a structured medication-review/deprescribing approach in an older adult with polypharmacy.
candidates.study_unit: Polypharmacy and Inappropriate Prescribing in Older Adults

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for HIV Infection: Epidemiology, Transmission, Natural History, and Antiretroviral Therapy Overview.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute retroviral syndrome and interpret the relationship between CD4 count, viral load, and disease stage.
candidates.study_unit: HIV Infection: Epidemiology, Transmission, Natural History, and Antiretroviral Therapy Overview

candidates.principal_decision: Apply timing reasoning for Palliative Approach to Care (Definition and Enhanced Model).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that a palliative approach can be initiated alongside curative/disease-modifying treatment early in a life-limiting illness, not only at the end of life.
candidates.study_unit: Palliative Approach to Care (Definition and Enhanced Model)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply stabilization reasoning for Pneumothorax and Tension Pneumothorax.
candidates.source_competency_text: Provide immediate stabilization for tension physiology without delaying for imaging and arrange definitive pleural management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gi ddx framework reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Common GI Complaints.
candidates.source_competency_text: Construct a differential diagnosis for common GI presentations (abdominal pain, GI bleeding, diarrhea, jaundice, dysphagia, constipation) using a structured approach.
candidates.study_unit: Differential Diagnosis of Common GI Complaints

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Fibroids (Uterine Leiomyoma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate management plan across the medical-to-surgical spectrum (GnRH agonist/antagonist therapy, uterine artery embolization, myomectomy, hysterectomy) based on bleeding vs. bulk symptoms and fertility goals.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Dislocated Lens (Ectopia Lentis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lens dislocation/subluxation as a prompt to evaluate for an underlying genetic connective-tissue or metabolic disorder (Marfan syndrome -- superotemporal dislocation; homocystinuria -- inferonasal dislocation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Disorders of Sexual Development.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ambiguous genitalia in a newborn as a diagnostic and psychosocial emergency requiring urgent multidisciplinary evaluation (karyotype, hormone panel, imaging) before sex assignment, and understand the broad DSD classification (46,XX DSD; 46,XY DSD; sex chromosome DSD).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply safety disposition reasoning for Suicide Risk Assessment and Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Determine appropriate disposition (voluntary/involuntary hospitalization vs. outpatient safety planning) based on risk stratification and identify when urgent intervention is required.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply adrenal crisis management reasoning for Adrenocortical Insufficiency (Addison's Disease, Adrenal Crisis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize adrenal crisis as a life-threatening emergency and initiate immediate IV hydrocortisone and fluid resuscitation without delaying treatment for confirmatory testing.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply structural narrowing recognition reasoning for Structural Esophageal Narrowing (Diverticula, Peptic Stricture, Webs and Rings).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Zenker diverticulum, peptic stricture, and esophageal webs/rings as structural causes of intermittent or progressive dysphagia.
candidates.study_unit: Structural Esophageal Narrowing (Diverticula, Peptic Stricture, Webs and Rings)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Peripheral Arterial Disease and Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize symptomatic peripheral arterial disease, ischemic wounds, and chronic limb-threatening ischemia.
candidates.study_unit: Peripheral Arterial Disease and Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk and management reasoning for Neonatal Sepsis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize early-onset (GBS, E. coli, vertical transmission) vs. late-onset (nosocomial, CoNS) neonatal sepsis risk factors and the nonspecific presentation, and initiate a full septic workup (blood/urine/CSF culture) with empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics given the low threshold for treatment in this population.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial workup reasoning for Pulmonary Hypertension.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess common cardiac, pulmonary, thromboembolic, systemic, and medication causes and arrange confirmatory specialist evaluation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Congenital Sensorineural Hearing Loss.
candidates.source_competency_text: Know that universal newborn hearing screening (OAE/ABR) is standard of care because early identification of congenital SNHL (genetic non-syndromic/syndromic, congenital infection, perinatal hypoxia/prematurity) is critical for language development, and that prelingually deaf infants benefit most from early aural rehabilitation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Determine the underlying immune defect (neutropenia, transplant immunosuppression, ART-related immune reconstitution) and the likely class of causative organism.
candidates.study_unit: Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase (G6PD) Deficiency.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify and avoid triggering drugs/exposures; recognize that G6PD assay may be falsely normal during acute hemolysis (high reticulocyte G6PD levels).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Sickle Cell Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and initiate management of acute sickle cell crises (vaso-occlusive, aplastic, splenic sequestration, acute chest syndrome) as hematologic emergencies, including indications for exchange transfusion.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply nevus recognition reasoning for Pigmented Nevi and Acquired Pigmented Lesions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish benign congenital and acquired nevi from atypical/dysplastic nevi requiring surveillance or biopsy, using ABCDE-type features.
candidates.study_unit: Pigmented Nevi and Acquired Pigmented Lesions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Lead Poisoning (Hematologic Manifestations).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate investigation (blood lead level) and management (remove exposure source, chelation in severe cases).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ibd general approach reasoning for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Overview).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize IBD as a cause of chronic abdominal pain and/or diarrhea, including extraintestinal manifestations, and initiate an appropriate diagnostic workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply legislative framework reasoning for Workplace Legislation and Workers' Compensation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify the jurisdiction (provincial vs. federally-regulated industry) governing a workplace, and describe the no-fault principle of workers' compensation insurance (WSIB-type boards).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hand Fractures and Dislocations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common hand fracture patterns (boxer's fracture, Bennett/Rolando, mallet finger) and joint dislocations, and identify which require urgent reduction or surgical referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply keloid vs scar reasoning for Benign Fibrous and Hyperkeratotic Skin Lesions (Dermatofibroma, Skin Tags, Seborrheic Keratosis, Corns, Keloids).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish keloid from hypertrophic scar based on extension beyond the original injury margin.
candidates.study_unit: Benign Fibrous and Hyperkeratotic Skin Lesions (Dermatofibroma, Skin Tags, Seborrheic Keratosis, Corns, Keloids)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish warm from cold AIHA using the direct Coombs (direct antiglobulin) test and blood film findings (spherocytes vs. agglutination), and identify primary vs. secondary causes (lymphoproliferative disease, SLE, drugs, infection).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply postterm management reasoning for Postterm Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postterm pregnancy and apply appropriate increased fetal surveillance and induction-timing counselling.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Dissociative Identity Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize dissociative identity disorder (disruption of identity with >=2 distinct personality states, recurrent gaps in recall) as a diagnosis strongly associated with severe early childhood trauma, without needing subspecialist-level diagnostic/treatment detail.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply history reasoning for Approach to the Patient with Physical Differences (Dysmorphology Assessment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Elicit a three-generation family pedigree and prenatal/teratogenic exposure history in a patient with suspected congenital anomalies or dysmorphic features.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to the Patient with Physical Differences (Dysmorphology Assessment)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply class recognition reasoning for Anxiolytics and Sedative-Hypnotics.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the indications, class-characteristic adverse effects, and rational-use principles of anxiolytics and sedative-hypnotics as a drug class, without hard-coding specific current dosing, sequencing, or monitoring-schedule recommendations (verified independently against current guidance at question-generation stage).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Aortic Stenosis and Pulmonary Stenosis (Valvular Obstructive Lesions).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize valvular vs. subvalvular/supravalvular aortic and pulmonary stenosis by exam findings (systolic ejection murmur with ejection click for valvular disease) and that severe neonatal obstructive lesions present as duct-dependent circulatory collapse when the ductus closes.
candidates.study_unit: Aortic Stenosis and Pulmonary Stenosis (Valvular Obstructive Lesions)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Malignant (Necrotizing) Otitis Externa (Skull Base Osteomyelitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize otalgia and purulent otorrhea refractory to standard otitis externa therapy in an elderly diabetic or immunocompromised patient as malignant otitis externa, a medical emergency requiring temporal bone imaging, hospitalization, and IV antibiotics.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment and communication reasoning for Adults with developmental disabilities.
candidates.source_competency_text: For an adult with developmental disability, assess intellectual and adaptive functioning, adapt communication, and recognize common physical, mental, and behavioural concerns, including atypical serious illness or pain and risk of abuse or neglect.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cholangiocarcinoma recognition reasoning for Cholangiocarcinoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painless obstructive jaundice as the classic presentation of cholangiocarcinoma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for White Blood Cell Count Abnormalities (Neutrophilia, Neutropenia, Lymphocytosis, Lymphopenia, Eosinophilia, Agranulocytosis, Leukemoid Reaction).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate the causes of neutrophilia, lymphocytosis, eosinophilia, and leukemoid reaction (reactive vs. malignant) and of neutropenia, lymphopenia, and agranulocytosis (production failure vs. peripheral destruction vs. drug-induced).
candidates.study_unit: White Blood Cell Count Abnormalities (Neutrophilia, Neutropenia, Lymphocytosis, Lymphopenia, Eosinophilia, Agranulocytosis, Leukemoid Reaction)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Cerebrovascular Disease and Stroke Imaging (CT vs. MRI Timing, Carotid/Cerebral Angiography).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select non-contrast CT as the initial imaging study in suspected acute stroke to exclude hemorrhage and guide time-sensitive thrombolysis/thrombectomy decisions, recognizing MRI's greater sensitivity for early ischemic change when the diagnosis remains unclear.
candidates.study_unit: Cerebrovascular Disease and Stroke Imaging (CT vs. MRI Timing, Carotid/Cerebral Angiography)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial workup reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Common Respiratory Presentations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Choose initial investigations that distinguish common pulmonary, cardiac, and other causes.
candidates.study_unit: Differential Diagnosis of Common Respiratory Presentations

candidates.principal_decision: Apply stabilization reasoning for Renal Stones.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize renal colic, investigate for infection/obstruction and arrange urgent escalation when needed.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Pulmonary Embolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Begin timely anticoagulation when appropriate, recognize hemodynamic instability, stabilize, and escalate for reperfusion or specialist care.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Syphilis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate benzathine penicillin G per stage; recognize indications for LP in suspected neurosyphilis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply aloc differential reasoning for Altered Level of Consciousness / Coma (incl. Empiric Antidotes).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a structured differential (toxic/metabolic vs. primary CNS) to altered level of consciousness and coma.
candidates.study_unit: Altered Level of Consciousness / Coma (incl. Empiric Antidotes)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Stroke: Assessment and Treatment of Acute Ischemic Stroke.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with acute ischemic stroke, apply time-window-based eligibility criteria for IV thrombolysis and endovascular thrombectomy, and initiate acute supportive management (e.g., blood pressure targets).
candidates.study_unit: Stroke: Assessment and Treatment of Acute Ischemic Stroke

candidates.principal_decision: Apply shoulder dystocia management reasoning for Shoulder Dystocia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize shoulder dystocia (turtle sign) and apply the stepwise emergency maneuver sequence (McRoberts, suprapubic pressure, etc.).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypocalcemia management reasoning for Hypocalcemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and manage acute symptomatic hypocalcemia (tetany, Chvostek's/Trousseau's signs) with IV calcium replacement.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply allergic rhinitis reasoning for Allergic Rhinitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose allergic rhinitis, distinguish it from other causes of rhinorrhea, and initiate an appropriate management plan (allergen avoidance, intranasal corticosteroids, antihistamines).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply nvp management reasoning for Nausea and Vomiting of Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize typical nausea and vomiting of pregnancy and apply first-line dietary/pharmacologic management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply adrenal function tests reasoning for Adrenocortical Functional Workup.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select and interpret cosyntropin stimulation testing (adrenal insufficiency), dexamethasone suppression testing (Cushing's), and aldosterone-renin ratio (primary aldosteronism).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Delirium.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize delirium (acute onset, fluctuating course, inattention, plus disorganized thinking or altered consciousness -- CAM criteria) and distinguish from dementia by acuity/fluctuation/attention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cocaine Use Disorder and Stimulant Intoxication.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic intoxication/withdrawal presentation and health consequences of this substance.
candidates.study_unit: Cocaine Use Disorder and Stimulant Intoxication

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening for poverty reasoning for Groups Facing Systemic Barriers, Discrimination, and Structural Violence.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the two validated poverty-screening questions and connect patients to appropriate social/financial supports.
candidates.study_unit: Groups Facing Systemic Barriers, Discrimination, and Structural Violence

candidates.principal_decision: Apply impetigo recognition reasoning for Bacterial Skin and Soft Tissue Infections (Impetigo, Erysipelas, Cellulitis, Folliculitis/Furuncle/Carbuncle, Skin Abscess).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize impetigo by honey-crusted lesions and select topical vs. systemic antibiotics by extent.
candidates.study_unit: Bacterial Skin and Soft Tissue Infections (Impetigo, Erysipelas, Cellulitis, Folliculitis/Furuncle/Carbuncle, Skin Abscess)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply bias recognition reasoning for Screening Principles and Screening Biases.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a screening-outcomes scenario, identify whether an apparent survival/prevalence benefit reflects lead-time bias or length-time bias rather than a true mortality benefit.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply tbi severity reasoning for Head Trauma and Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify traumatic brain injury severity using GCS and determine need for CT head imaging.
candidates.study_unit: Head Trauma and Mild Traumatic Brain Injury

candidates.principal_decision: Apply staging and prevention reasoning for Pressure Injuries.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pressure injury risk factors and staging, and initiate an appropriate prevention/management plan in an immobile or hospitalized older adult.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply interpretation reasoning for Echocardiography and Advanced Cardiac Imaging.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret basic echocardiographic findings (ejection fraction category, gross valve/chamber abnormality) in clinical context.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Strabismus and Amblyopia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize strabismus (misaligned corneal light reflex/cover test) and know that timely referral is essential before the critical period closes, since amblyopia is preventable only with early intervention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply confirmation reasoning for Tracheal Intubation: Technique, Confirmation, and Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize capnography (ETCO2) as the gold-standard method to confirm tracheal (vs. esophageal) tube placement, and identify signs of a malpositioned tube (right endobronchial intubation, accidental extubation).
candidates.study_unit: Tracheal Intubation: Technique, Confirmation, and Complications

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Ankle Ligamentous Injuries (Sprains).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish lateral (inversion, ATFL) from medial/syndesmotic (eversion, deltoid ligament) ankle sprains, grade severity, and know most are managed non-operatively (RICE, functional rehabilitation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Ankylosing spondylitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate inflammatory from mechanical back pain and recognize extra-articular manifestations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigate reasoning for Synovial fluid analysis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select and interpret cell count, Gram stain/culture, and crystal examination in an acute swollen joint.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diabetic nephropathy reasoning for Microvascular Complications of Diabetes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Screen for diabetic nephropathy with urine albumin-creatinine ratio and eGFR, and initiate ACEi/ARB or SGLT2i for renoprotection.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply malabsorption recognition reasoning for Maldigestion and Malabsorption.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize steatorrhea/malabsorption (pancreatic insufficiency, bacterial overgrowth, mucosal disease) as a cause of chronic diarrhea and select appropriate initial investigations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Neuromuscular Junction Disorders: Myasthenia Gravis, Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome, and Botulism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate myasthenia gravis (fatigable weakness, worsens with activity, ocular/bulbar onset), Lambert-Eaton (proximal weakness that improves with repeated activity, paraneoplastic association), and botulism (descending paralysis, autonomic findings) by pattern and outline the initial workup (e.g., antibody testing, EMG) for each.
candidates.study_unit: Neuromuscular Junction Disorders: Myasthenia Gravis, Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome, and Botulism

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Rashes (Common Benign Pediatric Skin Findings, Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common benign pediatric rashes and distinguish them from rashes requiring further workup (e.g. purpuric, vesiculobullous, or systemically-associated rashes).
candidates.study_unit: Rashes (Common Benign Pediatric Skin Findings, Approach)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Approach to and Differential Diagnosis of Psychosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with psychosis, generate and prioritize a differential diagnosis distinguishing primary psychotic disorders from delirium, medical-condition-induced psychosis, and substance/medication-induced psychosis before attributing symptoms to a primary psychiatric disorder.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to and Differential Diagnosis of Psychosis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply empyema management reasoning for Complicated Parapneumonic Effusion and Empyema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize complicated parapneumonic effusion and empyema, and identify indications for pleural drainage/tube thoracostomy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply barretts recognition reasoning for Barrett's Esophagus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Barrett's esophagus as a complication of chronic GERD requiring endoscopic surveillance given esophageal adenocarcinoma risk.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply afe recognition reasoning for Amniotic Fluid Embolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the acute presentation of amniotic fluid embolism (sudden hypoxia, hypotension, coagulopathy during/after delivery) as a peripartum emergency requiring immediate resuscitation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CPPD as a differential for acute monoarthritis and interpret its crystal pattern.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Growth Disorders (Short Stature, Growth Hormone Deficiency).
candidates.source_competency_text: Use growth-velocity trends and bone age to differentiate normal variants (familial short stature, constitutional delay of growth and puberty) from pathologic short stature (growth hormone deficiency, hypothyroidism, chronic disease, Turner syndrome) warranting endocrine referral.
candidates.study_unit: Growth Disorders (Short Stature, Growth Hormone Deficiency)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Sexual Abuse.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize behavioural and physical red flags for sexual abuse, the appropriate forensic/examination approach, and mandatory-reporting obligations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pph management reasoning for Postpartum Hemorrhage.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postpartum hemorrhage, apply the tone-tissue-trauma-thrombin framework to identify cause, and initiate the stepwise resuscitation/uterotonic management sequence.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply interpretation reasoning for Cardiac Biomarker Interpretation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret serial troponin results in the context of clinical probability of ACS.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply drug class selection reasoning for Antiplatelet and Anticoagulant Therapy (Reference).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the general indications, contraindications, and monitoring principles for antiplatelet agents and for anticoagulant classes (vitamin K antagonists, DOACs, heparins) without reference to a specific current dosing regimen.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Club Drugs (MDMA, GHB, Ketamine).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic intoxication/withdrawal presentation and health consequences of this substance.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Traumatic Auricular Hematoma (Cauliflower Ear).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize auricular hematoma after blunt ear trauma and the need for prompt (within 72h, up to 7d) aspiration/incision-and-drainage plus splinting to prevent avascular necrosis and cauliflower-ear deformity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the auscultatory findings of major stenotic and regurgitant valve lesions.
candidates.study_unit: Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply vaginal bleeding pregnancy reasoning for Vaginal Bleeding and the Pregnant Patient in the ED.
candidates.source_competency_text: Integrate pregnancy status (via B-hCG) into vaginal-bleeding workup and select trimester-appropriate exam and management (e.g. avoiding speculum/bimanual exam in 2nd/3rd trimester bleeding).
candidates.study_unit: Vaginal Bleeding and the Pregnant Patient in the ED

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize refractory hypoxemia and ventilation-related complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chest injury recognition reasoning for Chest Trauma (incl. Penetrating Neck Trauma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and prioritize management of life-threatening chest injuries found on primary survey (tension pneumothorax, cardiac tamponade, flail chest, etc.).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Ocular Manifestations of Multiple Sclerosis (Optic Neuritis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painful subacute monocular vision loss with an afferent pupillary defect as optic neuritis, and know its association with multiple sclerosis, requiring urgent ophthalmology/neurology referral and MRI.
candidates.study_unit: Ocular Manifestations of Multiple Sclerosis (Optic Neuritis)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Patellar Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize patellar fracture (inability to extend knee/straight leg raise, palpable deformity) and distinguish it from a benign bipartite patella variant on x-ray.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Chronic Myeloid Leukemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy (e.g., imatinib) as first-line treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Sexual Dysfunction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Offer appropriate initial support and management measures or referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Breath Holding Spells.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate benign cyanotic/pallid breath-holding spells (provoked by anger/frustration or pain/surprise, brief LOC, spontaneous resolution) from seizure, and recognize the association with iron deficiency anemia (spells improve with iron supplementation) and the indication for cardiac evaluation (prolonged QT) when spells are atypical or there is a family history of syncope/sudden death.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply primary survey reasoning for Approach to Trauma: Epidemiology and Primary/Secondary Survey.
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform an ABCDE primary trauma survey and identify immediately life-threatening injuries requiring intervention before secondary survey.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Trauma: Epidemiology and Primary/Secondary Survey

candidates.principal_decision: Apply reporting triggers reasoning for Other Mandatory Reporting Obligations.
candidates.source_competency_text: For a given clinical scenario (suspected child abuse, a gunshot wound, a patient with a medical condition impairing safe driving or flying, suspected abuse of a long-term-care resident, a death of unclear cause), identify the correct mandatory-reporting trigger and the correct recipient body (CAS, police, Ministry of Transportation, Registrar/Coroner, Retirement Homes Regulatory Authority).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply analysis strategy reasoning for Summary Study Designs (Meta-Analysis, Systematic Review, Scoping Review).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish intention-to-treat analysis from per-protocol analysis.
candidates.study_unit: Summary Study Designs (Meta-Analysis, Systematic Review, Scoping Review)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Breast Imaging Modality Selection by Age and Presentation (Mammography, Ultrasound, MRI, BI-RADS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select ultrasound as first-line breast imaging in patients under 30 or who are pregnant/lactating, and mammography as first-line over age 30; interpret a BI-RADS 4 or 5 assessment as requiring biopsy.
candidates.study_unit: Breast Imaging Modality Selection by Age and Presentation (Mammography, Ultrasound, MRI, BI-RADS)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply standards reasoning for Patient Monitoring (Intraoperative Standards).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the mandatory minimum monitoring standard for any anesthetic (continuous anesthesiologist presence, pulse oximetry, ECG, capnography, BP, temperature probe availability).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply interpretation reasoning for Pedigree Analysis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Construct and interpret a three-generation pedigree, including standard symbols and inheritance-pattern recognition (autosomal dominant/recessive, X-linked).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply thyroid nodule workup reasoning for Thyroid Nodules.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the thyroid nodule evaluation algorithm (TSH, ultrasound risk features, fine needle aspiration with Bethesda classification) to determine malignancy risk.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Chronic Stable Angina.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate anti-anginal and secondary-prevention pharmacotherapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Plantar Fasciitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize plantar fasciitis (insidious heel pain worse with first steps after rest, common in runners/obesity/DM) as a clinical diagnosis managed non-operatively (stretching, orthotics, NSAIDs).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Infertility.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose female-factor (ovulatory, tubal, uterine) and male-factor causes of infertility in a couple.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome (HLHS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize HLHS as ductal-dependent for systemic circulation (shock and metabolic acidosis on ductal closure), and the emergency management sequence (intubation, metabolic-acidosis correction, IV prostaglandin E1 to maintain ductal patency, surgical palliation or transplant).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Distal Femoral Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize distal femoral fracture (knee effusion, extreme pain with motion) and assess for vascular injury (popliteal artery is tethered near the distal femur).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply retained placenta reasoning for Retained Placenta.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize retained placenta as a cause of postpartum hemorrhage risk and outline the management approach (manual removal, associated risks).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Acid-Base Disorders: Metabolic Acidosis and Metabolic Alkalosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate management plan, particularly for high anion gap metabolic acidosis and its life-threatening causes (e.g. toxic alcohol ingestion, DKA).
candidates.study_unit: Acid-Base Disorders: Metabolic Acidosis and Metabolic Alkalosis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Acute Coronary Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and manage early post-MI complications (arrhythmia, mechanical complications, heart failure).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply duration differential reasoning for Brief Psychotic Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize brief psychotic disorder as psychosis lasting <1 mo with eventual full return to premorbid functioning, often precipitated by a stressor, and differentiate from schizophreniform/schizophrenia by duration and prognosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Endophthalmitis and Vitritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize post-intraocular-surgery/injection pain, redness, and vision loss as endophthalmitis until proven otherwise, requiring same-day ophthalmology emergency referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Anorexia Nervosa.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose anorexia nervosa (restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, intense fear of gaining weight or persistent behaviour interfering with weight gain, disturbance in self-perceived weight/shape) and grade severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply obstructive jaundice diagnosis reasoning for Jaundice (Biliary/Obstructive).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of jaundice, with particular attention to identifying extrahepatic/obstructive (surgical) causes requiring urgent intervention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cow's Milk Protein Allergy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize cow's milk protein allergy (regurgitation, eczema, hematochezia, FTT in a formula- or breast-fed infant) and first-line management (extensively hydrolyzed or amino-acid formula, or maternal dairy elimination if breastfeeding).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Lead Poisoning (Hematologic Manifestations).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lead poisoning as a cause of microcytic anemia with basophilic stippling and identify exposure risk factors (e.g., old paint, occupational).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply copd exacerbation mgmt reasoning for Acute Exacerbation of COPD.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select antibiotic and ventilatory support strategy for acute COPD exacerbation based on symptom severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply examination reasoning for Approach to and General Management of Traumatic Hand Injuries.
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform and interpret a systematic hand exam (skin, tendon, nerve, vessel, bone) after trauma, including testing nerve function before local anesthesia.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to and General Management of Traumatic Hand Injuries

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pk vs pd reasoning for Drug Interactions (Mechanisms and Clinically Significant Examples).
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a drug interaction mechanism as pharmacokinetic (altered absorption/distribution/metabolism/excretion) or pharmacodynamic (additive/synergistic or antagonistic effects).
candidates.study_unit: Drug Interactions (Mechanisms and Clinically Significant Examples)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply method counselling reasoning for Contraception.
candidates.source_competency_text: Discuss and select among hormonal methods, intrauterine devices, and emergency postcoital contraception based on patient preference, contraindications, and efficacy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply age stratified management reasoning for Pneumonia (Pediatric, Respirology Chapter -- Age-Stratified Treatment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select first-line antibiotic therapy for community-acquired pneumonia based on the age-stratified table (e.g. ampicillin+gentamicin in neonates; high-dose amoxicillin in preschool/school-age children; azithromycin when atypical organisms are suspected in school-age children) and interpret respiratory rate relative to age when assessing severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Tuberculosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate latent TB infection from active pulmonary/extrapulmonary/miliary TB, and select TST vs. IGRA screening appropriately.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Premenstrual Syndrome and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate management plan and explore the psychosocial impact of the condition.
candidates.study_unit: Premenstrual Syndrome and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial assessment reasoning for Hypersensitivity Pneumonitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select basic imaging and pulmonary testing, remove exposure, and refer when disease is severe, progressive, or diagnostically uncertain.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply timing reasoning for End-of-Life Decision Making (Advance Care Planning, Goals of Care, Code Status).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical triggers for initiating an EOL care discussion (recent hospitalization for serious illness, severe progressive disease, anticipated death within 6-12 mo, a MAID request).
candidates.study_unit: End-of-Life Decision Making (Advance Care Planning, Goals of Care, Code Status)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize heart failure and arrhythmia as complications of untreated valve disease.
candidates.study_unit: Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply urgent action reasoning for Mediastinitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate stabilization, broad initial investigation and antimicrobial care, and urgent surgical consultation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply vte workup reasoning for Venous Thromboembolism: DVT and Pulmonary Embolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Wells' criteria and D-dimer/ultrasound to rule in or out DVT.
candidates.study_unit: Venous Thromboembolism: DVT and Pulmonary Embolism

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Somatic Symptom Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose somatic symptom disorder (>=1 distressing somatic symptom plus excessive thoughts/feelings/behaviours related to the symptom, persisting >6 mo) as a diagnosis of inclusion (based on the disproportionate response) rather than pure exclusion of organic disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply crc screening and diagnosis reasoning for Colorectal Neoplasia (Carcinoma and Polyps).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify patients at high risk for colorectal cancer for a screening program, and diagnose colorectal carcinoma/polyps in a patient presenting with lower GI bleeding, iron-deficiency anemia, or a change in bowel habits.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply multidimensional assessment reasoning for Suffering: Definition, Sources, and Relief of Refractory Physical/Existential Suffering.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify the multidimensional (physical, social-relational, psychological, spiritual, existential) sources of suffering in a palliative patient, recognizing that suffering is subjective and not confined to physical symptoms.
candidates.study_unit: Suffering: Definition, Sources, and Relief of Refractory Physical/Existential Suffering

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Toxic Shock Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize toxic shock syndrome in a patient with fever, rash, hypotension, and multiorgan involvement, with attention to tampon-associated and surgical-wound risk factors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply manage reasoning for Fibromyalgia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Explain multimodal, nonpharmacologic-forward initial management concepts.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply alf recognition reasoning for Acute Liver Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute liver failure (coagulopathy plus encephalopathy in a patient without prior liver disease) as a life-threatening emergency requiring urgent transplant-center referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Local Anesthetic Systemic Toxicity (LAST).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate LAST-specific emergency management (stop LA administration, airway/oxygenation support, seizure control, lipid emulsion therapy) as distinct from routine ACLS.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply workup reasoning for Delirium.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify the underlying cause using a systematic approach (e.g., I WATCH DEATH categories) and initiate urgent management addressing the precipitant.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply response to request reasoning for Medical Assistance in Dying (MAID).
candidates.source_competency_text: Respond to a patient's MAID request with a compassionate, non-judgmental approach and take appropriate steps toward referral if the patient meets eligibility criteria, recognizing the current mental-illness-sole-criterion exclusion.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Abnormal Pseudocholinesterase.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize prolonged post-succinylcholine/mivacurium paralysis as a sign of abnormal (deficient) pseudocholinesterase, and manage supportively (ventilate until recovery) rather than administering a cholinesterase inhibitor.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Septic Arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute monoarticular pain, effusion, fever, and inability to bear weight/move the joint as septic arthritis until proven otherwise, obtain joint aspirate before antibiotics when feasible, and initiate emergent IV antibiotics plus surgical drainage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Erythrocytosis (Approach to Elevated Hemoglobin/Hematocrit).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate primary (e.g., polycythemia vera) from secondary (hypoxic, EPO-mediated, or spurious) causes of an elevated hemoglobin/hematocrit.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize DIC as concurrent bleeding and thrombosis (elevated D-dimer, low fibrinogen, prolonged PT/PTT, thrombocytopenia, schistocytes) triggered by an underlying critical illness (sepsis, trauma, obstetric emergency, malignancy).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply transient causes reasoning for Incontinence in Older Adults (Urinary and Fecal).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a geriatric-specific transient-cause framework (e.g., delirium, restricted mobility, stool impaction, infection, pharmaceuticals, psychological) before assuming an established/chronic urologic or gynecologic cause.
candidates.study_unit: Incontinence in Older Adults (Urinary and Fecal)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply intoxication withdrawal reasoning for Opioid Use Disorder, Intoxication, and Withdrawal.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the intoxication and withdrawal syndrome for this substance and initiate appropriate acute management (including withdrawal-severity-scale-guided treatment where applicable), given the risk of life-threatening complications.
candidates.study_unit: Opioid Use Disorder, Intoxication, and Withdrawal

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Facial Nerve (CN VII) Paralysis (Bell's Palsy vs. Ramsay Hunt Syndrome).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish central facial paralysis (forehead-sparing, cross-refer to Neurology) from peripheral facial paralysis (forehead involved), and distinguish Bell's palsy (idiopathic, acute onset, diagnosis of exclusion, treat with corticosteroids +/- antivirals and corneal protection) from Ramsay Hunt syndrome (herpes zoster oticus: vesicles on the pinna/ear canal, hyperacusis, SNHL, worse prognosis, treat with corticosteroids and acyclovir).
candidates.study_unit: Facial Nerve (CN VII) Paralysis (Bell's Palsy vs. Ramsay Hunt Syndrome)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Approach to Splenomegaly.
candidates.source_competency_text: Generate a differential for splenomegaly (infectious, congestive, hematologic/infiltrative, hemolytic) and recognize indications for further hematologic workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize HUS by its triad (microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, acute kidney injury) typically following Shiga-toxin-producing E. coli (e.g. O157:H7) gastroenteritis, and that antibiotic treatment of the preceding diarrheal illness may increase HUS risk.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk and management reasoning for Neonatal Hypoglycemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify at-risk neonates for hypoglycemia (infant of a diabetic mother, SGA, LGA, preterm, perinatal stress) and initiate management (early feeding, IV dextrose for symptomatic or severe hypoglycemia) without delay for cause-finding.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Renal Mass and Renal Neoplasms.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a renal mass/neoplasm presentation and arrange appropriate investigation and referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply volvulus recognition reasoning for Volvulus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sigmoid and cecal volvulus, interpret the classic imaging findings, and identify indications for urgent decompression/surgery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply uc surgical reasoning for Ulcerative Colitis (Surgical Indications and Management).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for colectomy in ulcerative colitis (toxic megacolon, refractory disease, dysplasia/malignancy) and general operative principles (e.g., ileal pouch-anal anastomosis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Ventricular Tachyarrhythmias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate emergency management of pulseless and pulsed VT.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply osteomalacia rickets reasoning for Osteomalacia and Rickets.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish osteomalacia (adults) from rickets (children) as defective bone mineralization typically due to vitamin D deficiency, and recognize characteristic radiographic findings (Looser zones).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply back pain red flags reasoning for Back Pain (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Screen for extraspinal and spinal emergencies (cauda equina syndrome, epidural abscess, aortic dissection, AAA) in back pain.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Delusional Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize delusional disorder (isolated, non-bizarre delusion(s) with otherwise largely preserved functioning) and distinguish it from schizophrenia by the absence of broader functional impairment and prominent hallucinations/disorganized thought.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply previa recognition reasoning for Placenta Previa.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painless antepartum bleeding with placenta previa on imaging and apply the appropriate management plan (expectant vs. delivery, avoiding digital exam).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply status epilepticus mgmt reasoning for Seizures / Status Epilepticus (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply stepwise pharmacologic management of status epilepticus, including escalation to refractory status.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply precautions selection reasoning for Communicable Disease Control and Infection Prevention and Control Practices.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a pathogen's transmission route, select the appropriate Additional Precautions (contact, droplet, contact+droplet, or airborne) beyond Routine Practices.
candidates.study_unit: Communicable Disease Control and Infection Prevention and Control Practices

candidates.principal_decision: Apply history reasoning for Substance Use Disorders: General Approach and Diagnosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Take a structured substance use history addressing use pattern, consequences, prior quit attempts, withdrawal, and functional impact.
candidates.study_unit: Substance Use Disorders: General Approach and Diagnosis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Febrile Seizures.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish simple febrile seizure (generalized, <15 min, no recurrence in 24h, normal neuro exam, benign prognosis, no routine EEG/neuroimaging needed) from complex febrile seizure (focal, prolonged, or recurrent) warranting further workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply men syndromes reasoning for Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the component tumours of MEN1 (parathyroid, pituitary, pancreatic), MEN2A (medullary thyroid cancer, pheochromocytoma, parathyroid), and MEN2B (medullary thyroid cancer, pheochromocytoma, mucosal neuromas/marfanoid habitus), and the rationale for family-member screening.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Panic Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate management (CBT with interoceptive exposure, SSRI/SNRI pharmacotherapy) and counsel that benzodiazepines are not first-line for chronic management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply system navigation reasoning for Physician Licensure and Certification.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the role of the LMCC and provincial/territorial medical regulatory authorities in physician licensure.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ovd indications reasoning for Operative Vaginal Delivery (Forceps, Vacuum Extraction).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications and contraindications for operative vaginal delivery (forceps or vacuum) without requiring instrument-level technique.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply achalasia recognition reasoning for Achalasia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize achalasia's classic presentation (dysphagia to solids and liquids) and identify appropriate diagnostic workup (manometry, barium swallow).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening and comorbidity reasoning for Obesity.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use age/sex-specific BMI percentiles to screen for pediatric obesity, and recognize associated comorbidities (insulin resistance, dyslipidemia, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, slipped capital femoral epiphysis) and the role of family-centred lifestyle counselling.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ak recognition reasoning for Pre-Malignant Skin Conditions (Actinic Keratosis, Leukoplakia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize actinic keratosis (rough erythematous scaly papule on sun-damaged skin) as a premalignant lesion and select appropriate field or lesion-directed treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gerd recognition reasoning for Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose GERD and initiate an appropriate initial management plan (lifestyle, acid suppression), and recognize when to investigate for alarm features/complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply psoriasis recognition reasoning for Psoriasis (Plaque, Guttate, Erythrodermic, Pustular, Inverse) and Systemic Therapy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize plaque psoriasis (well-demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale, Auspitz sign, extensor/scalp/nail distribution) and its guttate, erythrodermic, pustular, and inverse variants.
candidates.study_unit: Psoriasis (Plaque, Guttate, Erythrodermic, Pustular, Inverse) and Systemic Therapy

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency management reasoning for Coma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a comatose patient, assess level of consciousness (e.g., GCS), secure airway/breathing/circulation, pursue an efficient cause-directed workup (glucose, toxin screen, imaging), and initiate empiric emergent treatment (e.g., naloxone, glucose, thiamine).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chronic approach reasoning for Chronic Pain and Central Sensitization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize chronic pain (>3 months) as requiring a multimodal approach (continuing long-acting analgesics, regional techniques, non-pharmacologic adjuncts) rather than acute-pain dosing alone.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Cardiac Arrest / Sudden Cardiac Death.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate basic and advanced cardiac life support for cardiac arrest.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ethical reasoning reasoning for Research Ethics.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the requirement for research ethics board approval and informed consent in human research.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply design tradeoffs reasoning for Observational Study Designs (Cohort, Case-Control, Cross-Sectional, Ecological).
candidates.source_competency_text: For a given research question, select the most appropriate observational design and identify its characteristic strengths (e.g., cohort providing incidence/RR) and vulnerabilities (e.g., case-control's recall bias, ecological fallacy).
candidates.study_unit: Observational Study Designs (Cohort, Case-Control, Cross-Sectional, Ecological)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply copd perioperative reasoning for COPD (Surgical and Perioperative Considerations).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize COPD as a major perioperative pulmonary risk factor and as a candidacy consideration for lung-volume-reduction/transplant referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Chronic Myeloid Leukemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CML presenting with marked leukocytosis with a left shift across all maturation stages, splenomegaly, and confirmed by the BCR-ABL/Philadelphia chromosome.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply graves management reasoning for Graves' Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select first-line management (antithyroid drugs, radioactive iodine ablation, or surgery) for Graves' disease based on patient factors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention followup reasoning for Valve Intervention: Repair/Replacement and Prosthetic Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize anticoagulation requirements differ between mechanical and bioprosthetic valves.
candidates.study_unit: Valve Intervention: Repair/Replacement and Prosthetic Management

candidates.principal_decision: Apply system navigation reasoning for Role of Professional Associations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify the distinct roles of the CMA, provincial medical associations, and specialty societies.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Thalassemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish thalassemia trait/disease (microcytic anemia with normal-to-high RBC count and normal ferritin) from iron deficiency anemia using the Mentzer index and hemoglobin electrophoresis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complication recognition reasoning for Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize leukostasis and DIC (particularly in acute promyelocytic leukemia) as life-threatening AML complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Psoriatic arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize inflammatory joint disease associated with psoriasis and arrange referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diabetic neuropathy reasoning for Microvascular Complications of Diabetes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize peripheral and autonomic diabetic neuropathy and perform annual diabetic foot examination.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply agonist antagonist reasoning for Drug-Receptor Interactions: Agonists and Antagonists.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a drug as a full agonist, partial agonist, or antagonist (chemical, physiological, or pharmacological), and distinguish competitive-reversible from competitive-irreversible and non-competitive antagonism by their effect on a dose-response curve (rightward shift and overcomeable vs. reduced Emax and not overcomeable).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Limb Pain (Pediatric, Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply an age-stratified differential to pediatric limb pain (trauma, growing pains, infection -- osteomyelitis, malignancy -- bone tumour/leukemia) and recognize red flags (night pain waking the child, systemic symptoms, focal bony tenderness) requiring urgent workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply p gp reasoning for Pharmacokinetics Overview and Drug Absorption.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize P-glycoprotein as a clinically relevant efflux transporter whose inhibition (macrolides) or induction (rifampin, St. John's wort) alters serum concentrations of its substrates (digoxin, apixaban, cyclosporine).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Opportunistic Fungi (Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia, Cryptococcus, Candida, Aspergillus).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize PJP, cryptococcal, candidal, and aspergillus infections as opportunistic diseases in HIV/immunocompromised hosts and initiate appropriate empiric management.
candidates.study_unit: Opportunistic Fungi (Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia, Cryptococcus, Candida, Aspergillus)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply public health reasoning for COVID-19.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply outbreak-management and infection-control principles to COVID-19 in institutional settings.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Olecranon Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize olecranon fracture (palpable defect, loss of active extension from triceps avulsion) and know displaced fractures with loss of extensor mechanism require operative fixation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Peritonsillar Abscess (Quinsy).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize trismus, muffled ('hot potato') voice, uvular deviation, and drooling on a background of severe unilateral sore throat as peritonsillar abscess, requiring urgent needle aspiration/incision and drainage plus antibiotics rather than outpatient management as simple pharyngitis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Acute Pericarditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate pericarditis from ACS.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cs indications reasoning for Caesarean Delivery.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for Caesarean delivery (elective and emergent) and counsel on associated risks/benefits.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Depersonalization/Derealization Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish depersonalization/derealization disorder (persistent or recurrent episodes with intact reality testing) from psychotic disorders (in which reality testing is impaired).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Tic Disorders and Tourette's Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a tic disorder by motor/vocal tic type and duration criteria (provisional vs. persistent vs. Tourette's), screen for common psychiatric comorbidities (OCD, ADHD), and outline a stepped treatment approach.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Peripheral/Local Edema.
