candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize DVT as a must-not-miss cause requiring urgent evaluation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Zygomatic Fractures.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the pathognomonic triad (subconjunctival hemorrhage, periorbital ecchymosis, infraorbital/CN V2 numbness) and malar flattening suggesting zygomatic complex fracture.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Epistaxis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Manage anterior epistaxis (most common, Kiesselbach's plexus) with direct pressure and topical vasoconstrictor/cautery, and recognize posterior epistaxis (more common in elderly/hypertensive patients, higher-volume bleeding) as requiring posterior packing, admission, and ENT involvement; know recurrent unilateral epistaxis in an adolescent male raises concern for juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation steps reasoning for Steps to Control an Outbreak and Epidemic Curves.
candidates.source_competency_text: Sequence the steps of an outbreak investigation (confirm the outbreak, verify diagnosis, define a case, find cases/line list, descriptive epidemiology, generate/evaluate hypotheses, implement control measures, communicate, continue surveillance).
candidates.study_unit: Steps to Control an Outbreak and Epidemic Curves

candidates.principal_decision: Apply maintenance reasoning for General Anesthesia Maintenance and Extubation Readiness.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the standard components of general anesthesia maintenance (volatile and/or IV agents, analgesia, muscle relaxation as needed).
candidates.study_unit: General Anesthesia Maintenance and Extubation Readiness

candidates.principal_decision: Apply child abuse recognition reasoning for Child Abuse and Neglect (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical findings suggestive of child abuse/neglect and fulfill mandatory reporting obligations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply stabilization reasoning for Hypoxemic and Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Support airway, oxygenation, and ventilation while treating reversible causes and escalating to noninvasive or invasive support when needed.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cerumen Impaction and Exostoses.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize cerumen impaction as the most common cause of conductive hearing loss in patients 15-50 yr and know indications/contraindications for irrigation (contraindicated with suspected TM perforation or active infection); recognize exostoses as usually incidental findings associated with cold-water swimming.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply safety reasoning for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess safety risk (including suicide risk, common in PTSD) and identify need for urgent care.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening and counselling reasoning for Sexually Transmitted Infections (Adolescent).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the confidentiality and consent principles specific to adolescent STI screening/treatment, and outline the general approach to common STIs (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HPV) in an adolescent.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply perinatal infection screening reasoning for Infections During Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize prenatal screening indications and vertical-transmission-prevention counselling for major congenital/perinatal infections (e.g., toxoplasmosis, rubella, CMV, HSV, HIV, syphilis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Glomerular Disease: Nephritic/Nephrotic Syndrome Classification and Major Glomerulonephritides.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate nephritic from nephrotic syndrome presentations using clinical features (hematuria/RBC casts vs. edema/heavy proteinuria) and recognize rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis as a nephrology emergency.
candidates.study_unit: Glomerular Disease: Nephritic/Nephrotic Syndrome Classification and Major Glomerulonephritides

candidates.principal_decision: Apply triage reasoning for Red Eye (Differential Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate benign red eye (subconjunctival hemorrhage, viral conjunctivitis) from vision-threatening causes (acute angle-closure glaucoma, scleritis, keratitis, uveitis, orbital cellulitis) requiring urgent referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Acute Limb Ischemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize threatened-limb features and urgency.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply trigger avoidance reasoning for Malignant Hyperthermia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify anesthetic triggers to avoid in known/suspected MH-susceptible patients (all volatile agents except nitrous oxide, succinylcholine).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply biopsychosocial formulation reasoning for Approach to Psychiatric Assessment and Management Planning.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a biopsychosocial framework (predisposing, precipitating, perpetuating, protective factors across biological/psychological/social domains) to formulate a psychiatric assessment and construct a management plan spanning biological, psychological, and social interventions.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Psychiatric Assessment and Management Planning

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Nutritional Deficiencies and Toxic Injuries (Neurologic).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical patterns of common nutritional (e.g., B12, thiamine) and toxic (e.g., alcohol, heavy metal) neurologic injuries and their reversibility with treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply manage reasoning for ANCA-associated vasculitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Escalate urgently for organ-threatening disease without testing induction-regimen details.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply spinal cord injury recognition reasoning for C-Spine and Spinal Cord Trauma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize signs and symptoms of spinal cord injury (including spinal shock) and initiate immobilization and management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Bronchiectasis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize bronchiectasis from chronic productive cough, recurrent infection, hemoptysis, and characteristic imaging.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Potassium Disorders: Hyperkalemia and Hypokalemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ECG changes and life-threatening presentations of severe hyperkalemia/hypokalemia requiring urgent treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk id reasoning for Preoperative Cardiopulmonary and Airway-Risk Optimization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify comorbidities (uncontrolled HTN, recent MI/unstable CAD, COPD/asthma, OSA/obesity, aspiration risk factors) that increase perioperative risk and require optimization or delay of elective surgery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Sarcoidosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common pulmonary and extrapulmonary sarcoidosis patterns and important mimics.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Leukocoria and Retinoblastoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize leukocoria (absent red reflex, white pupillary reflex on photograph) as a must-not-miss finding requiring same-week ophthalmology referral to exclude retinoblastoma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize PCOS using its clinical/diagnostic criteria (oligo/anovulation, hyperandrogenism, polycystic ovarian morphology) and its long-term metabolic implications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lipid lowering therapy reasoning for Treatment of Dyslipidemias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select first-line lipid-lowering pharmacotherapy (statin intensity by risk category) and recognize statin-associated myopathy/LFT monitoring.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Shock: Recognition and Initial Stabilization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Restore perfusion while rapidly identifying and treating the underlying cause and reassessing response.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Conjunctivitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate viral, bacterial, and allergic conjunctivitis by history/exam and recognize features (severe pain, photophobia, vision change, contact-lens wear) that mandate urgent referral rather than empiric treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply triage reasoning for Diplopia (Double Vision).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish monocular from binocular diplopia and recognize pupil-involving third-nerve palsy as a neurosurgical emergency requiring urgent imaging.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Bulimia Nervosa.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize medical complications of purging behaviour (electrolyte disturbance, esophageal/dental damage, arrhythmia risk).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Approach to Pediatric Anemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use MCV-based classification (microcytic, normocytic, macrocytic) and age-specific prevalence to work up pediatric anemia, recognizing physiologic anemia of infancy as a normal nadir not requiring investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Corneal Foreign Body and Corneal Abrasion.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose corneal foreign body/abrasion with fluorescein staining, exclude a retained intraocular/deep foreign body or infection, and recognize rust rings and organic-material mechanisms as needing referral.
candidates.study_unit: Corneal Foreign Body and Corneal Abrasion

candidates.principal_decision: Apply arrest reasoning for Intraoperative Cardiac Arrest and Arrhythmias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify pulseless arrest rhythms as shockable vs. non-shockable and initiate the corresponding ACLS pathway (cross-references SU-A-36).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply bite prophylaxis reasoning for Bites (Animal and Human, Wound Prophylaxis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select prophylactic antibiotic coverage by bite-wound pathogen risk (dog/cat vs. human) and tetanus status.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Sleep Apnea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel on safety and modifiable risks, initiate appropriate first-line planning, and refer when needed.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ponv reasoning for Common Postoperative Anesthetic Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postoperative nausea and vomiting, exclude hemodynamic causes first, and select an appropriate antiemetic.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Pulmonary Vasculitis and Alveolar Hemorrhage.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess airway and oxygenation, obtain targeted urinalysis/renal function/serology/imaging, and arrange urgent specialty care for organ-threatening disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply transfusion reasoning for Blood Products and Transfusion.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for blood product administration (PRBC, FFP, platelets) in the context of intraoperative hemorrhage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Gestational Trophoblastic Disease/Neoplasia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate evacuation and beta-hCG surveillance, and recognize indications for oncology referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize median-nerve distribution numbness/tingling and provocative-test findings (Tinel's, Phalen's) suggesting carpal tunnel syndrome, and identify conservative vs. surgical management indications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Endometriosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize endometriosis as a cause of chronic pelvic pain, secondary dysmenorrhea, and infertility, and identify the pattern of clinical features suggesting the diagnosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Thyroid Carcinoma (Types, Nodule Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the standard thyroid nodule workup (serum TSH plus thyroid ultrasound, with FNA guided by ultrasound risk features/size), recognize papillary carcinoma as the most common and generally favourable-prognosis subtype, and recognize red flags (rapidly enlarging mass, hoarseness, dysphagia, family history of MEN II) suggesting a more aggressive subtype (medullary, anaplastic).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply acute bronchitis reasoning for Bronchitis (Acute).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute bronchitis as a cause of cough, distinguish it from pneumonia, and counsel against unnecessary antibiotic use.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Congestive Heart Failure (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pediatric CHF by age-specific presentation (infant: poor feeding, diaphoresis with feeds, FTT; older child: exercise intolerance, recurrent 'URTIs'/'asthma') and the 4 key exam features (tachycardia, tachypnea, cardiomegaly, hepatomegaly), and identify the underlying CHD or other cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sun counselling reasoning for Sun Protection and Photodamage (Sunscreens, Sunburn, UV Radiation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel patients on sun-protective behaviour and sunscreen selection (SPF, broad-spectrum, physical vs. chemical) as primary prevention for photodamage and skin cancer.
candidates.study_unit: Sun Protection and Photodamage (Sunscreens, Sunburn, UV Radiation)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pattern recognition reasoning for OCD-Related Disorders (Body Dysmorphic Disorder, Hoarding, Trichotillomania, Excoriation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the OCD-related disorder pattern (body dysmorphic disorder: preoccupation with perceived physical defect; hoarding disorder: persistent difficulty discarding possessions; trichotillomania: recurrent hair-pulling; excoriation disorder: recurrent skin-picking) and that each requires significant distress/impairment for diagnosis.
candidates.study_unit: OCD-Related Disorders (Body Dysmorphic Disorder, Hoarding, Trichotillomania, Excoriation)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Groups Facing Systemic Barriers, Discrimination, and Structural Violence.
candidates.source_competency_text: For a given equity-seeking group, identify the systemic barriers, discrimination, and structural factors (not innate characteristics) driving that group's poorer health outcomes.
candidates.study_unit: Groups Facing Systemic Barriers, Discrimination, and Structural Violence

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Syncope and Loss of Consciousness (Cardiac Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize high-risk features (exertional syncope, structural heart disease, family history of sudden death) requiring urgent evaluation.
candidates.study_unit: Syncope and Loss of Consciousness (Cardiac Differential)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Pyloric Stenosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pyloric stenosis (projectile non-bilious vomiting in a 2-8 wk old, palpable olive-shaped mass, hypochloremic hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis) and the management sequence (fluid/electrolyte correction before pyloromyotomy).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply eczema subtype ddx reasoning for Other Eczematous Dermatoses (Contact, Dyshidrotic, Nummular, Seborrheic, Stasis, Asteatotic Dermatitis; Lichen Simplex Chronicus).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish contact (irritant vs. allergic), dyshidrotic, nummular, seborrheic, stasis, and asteatotic dermatitis by distribution and clinical features, and select an appropriate first-line topical therapy.
candidates.study_unit: Other Eczematous Dermatoses (Contact, Dyshidrotic, Nummular, Seborrheic, Stasis, Asteatotic Dermatitis; Lichen Simplex Chronicus)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply psych safety approach reasoning for Approach to Common Psychiatric Presentations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a safety-first approach (own safety, means restriction) and structured mental status exam to an undifferentiated psychiatric ED presentation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Generalized Edema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize generalized edema as a sign of volume overload.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypothyroidism management reasoning for Hypothyroidism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate and titrate levothyroxine replacement, monitoring TSH at appropriate intervals.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gu trauma management reasoning for Abdominal and Genitourinary Trauma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Manage genitourinary tract injuries (ureteral, bladder, urethral) identified on trauma workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply antepartum surveillance reasoning for Fetal Surveillance (Antepartum).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select and interpret antepartum fetal surveillance tests (non-stress test, biophysical profile) and recognize indications for increased surveillance.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention plan reasoning for Falls.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate falls-prevention and management plan, including medication review and referral where indicated.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Amenorrhea and Oligomenorrhea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Rule out pregnancy first, then differentiate primary from secondary amenorrhea and characterize oligomenorrhea, identifying the compartment-based (hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian-uterine/outflow) cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cataracts.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize gradual painless vision loss with glare/haloes as consistent with cataract, and know the indication for surgical referral (visual-function impairment) versus observation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia (Jaundice).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish physiologic jaundice (appears after 24h, peaks day 3-5, resolves by 2 wk) from pathologic jaundice (appears <24h, rapidly rising, or persisting >2-3 wk) requiring bilirubin-level-based phototherapy/exchange-transfusion decision-making, and recognize kernicterus as the feared complication of untreated severe hyperbilirubinemia.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Dupuytren's Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize palmar fascia thickening/cords and progressive digit contracture as features of Dupuytren's disease, and that surgical release is indicated once contracture limits function.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply photosensitivity reasoning for Fixed Drug Eruption and Photosensitivity Reaction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish phototoxic (exaggerated sunburn, direct injury) from photoallergic (pruritic eczematous, type IV hypersensitivity) drug-induced photosensitivity reactions.
candidates.study_unit: Fixed Drug Eruption and Photosensitivity Reaction

candidates.principal_decision: Apply irritant vs allergic contact reasoning for Other Eczematous Dermatoses (Contact, Dyshidrotic, Nummular, Seborrheic, Stasis, Asteatotic Dermatitis; Lichen Simplex Chronicus).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate irritant from allergic contact dermatitis by mechanism, time course, and role of patch testing.
candidates.study_unit: Other Eczematous Dermatoses (Contact, Dyshidrotic, Nummular, Seborrheic, Stasis, Asteatotic Dermatitis; Lichen Simplex Chronicus)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Premenstrual Syndrome and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate normal premenstrual symptoms from PMS and from PMDD, and from other causes of cyclical physical/mood changes.
candidates.study_unit: Premenstrual Syndrome and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH).
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform and interpret Barlow/Ortolani maneuvers on newborn hip screening, recognize risk factors (breech presentation, female, family history, first-born), and know ultrasound is the imaging modality of choice before 6 months of age.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gastric ca recognition reasoning for Gastric Carcinoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize alarm features (weight loss, early satiety, persistent dyspepsia, GI bleeding) suggestive of gastric carcinoma and initiate urgent endoscopic investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk screening reasoning for Suicide Risk Assessment and Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Screen every psychiatric patient for suicidal ideation using direct, non-judgmental questioning.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply wound assessment reasoning for Wound Management (ED Basics).
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform basic ED wound assessment, cleansing, and closure-technique selection.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply presentation differences reasoning for Mood Disorders in Children and Adolescents.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that irritable mood may substitute for depressed mood in the pediatric MDD diagnostic criteria, and age-specific associated features (insomnia in children vs. hypersomnia in adolescents).
candidates.study_unit: Mood Disorders in Children and Adolescents

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Lennox-Gastaut syndrome's triad (multiple drug-resistant seizure types, cognitive/behavioural impairment, slow generalized spike-wave EEG) and its typically poor prognosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Graves' Disease Ophthalmopathy (Thyroid Eye Disease).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lid retraction, proptosis, and restrictive diplopia as thyroid eye disease, and identify exposure keratopathy or compressive optic neuropathy (sudden vision change) as sight-threatening urgent-referral red flags.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pregnancy counselling reasoning for Counselling of the Pregnant Patient (Nutrition, Lifestyle, Medications, Immunizations, Radiation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel a pregnant patient on nutrition (e.g., folic acid, iron), lifestyle (substance use, exercise), medication safety, recommended immunizations, and radiation-exposure risk.
candidates.study_unit: Counselling of the Pregnant Patient (Nutrition, Lifestyle, Medications, Immunizations, Radiation)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Specific Visceral Organ Imaging (Liver, Spleen, Biliary Tree: Modality Selection and Mass Characterization).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select the appropriate follow-up imaging modality (CT or MRI) after an incidental liver lesion is identified on ultrasound, and recognize cirrhosis findings across modalities.
candidates.study_unit: Specific Visceral Organ Imaging (Liver, Spleen, Biliary Tree: Modality Selection and Mass Characterization)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ottawa charter reasoning for Health Promotion, Behaviour Change, and Community Needs Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the Ottawa Charter's five health-promotion strategies (healthy public policy, supportive environments, community action, personal skills, reoriented health services) to a population-health scenario.
candidates.study_unit: Health Promotion, Behaviour Change, and Community Needs Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Pediatric Asthma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose pediatric asthma from recurrent wheeze/cough/dyspnea with reversibility, stratify severity/control, and outline a stepwise pharmacologic approach (SABA reliever, inhaled corticosteroid controller, add-on therapy), and recognize indications for hospitalization in an acute exacerbation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Chromosomal Aneuploidy Syndromes (Trisomy 21, 18, 13).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic phenotype, associated cardiac/GI/other anomalies, and prognosis of trisomy 21 (Down syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), and trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), and relate incidence to advanced maternal age.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Aortic Aneurysm.
candidates.source_competency_text: Stabilize an unstable patient and obtain urgent vascular/surgical assessment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypothyroidism diagnosis reasoning for Hypothyroidism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose primary hypothyroidism using elevated TSH with low free T4, and distinguish from subclinical and central hypothyroidism.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Sleep Apnea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify obstructive versus central sleep-apnea risk factors and clinical consequences.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Calcaneal Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize calcaneal fracture after a fall from height, and screen for concomitant lumbar spine compression fracture and contralateral calcaneal/lower extremity injury given the shared axial-loading mechanism.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply physiologic risk reasoning for Pediatric Anesthesia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize increased pediatric susceptibility to bradycardia (PNS-dominant response to depolarizing relaxants), arrhythmia, hyperkalemia, and malignant hyperthermia (cross-references SU-A-33).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply abd mass ddx reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Abdominal Mass.
candidates.source_competency_text: Generate a surgical differential diagnosis for an abdominal mass by location and characteristics, and identify features requiring urgent surgical referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply inhalation injury reasoning for Burns (incl. Inhalation Injury).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize inhalation injury (CO/cyanide poisoning, thermal airway injury) in burn patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gh deficiency reasoning for Growth Hormone Disorders (Deficiency and Excess/Acromegaly).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose GH deficiency using IGF-1 levels and provocative testing (insulin tolerance test), and recognize when adult GH replacement is indicated.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and management reasoning for Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CDH by scaphoid abdomen and absent breath sounds with bowel sounds audible in the chest at birth, and the critical management point that bag-mask ventilation must be avoided (worsens bowel distension/lung compression) in favour of immediate intubation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Acute Coronary Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize STEMI requiring emergent reperfusion (PCI/fibrinolysis pathway activation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for HIV Infection: Epidemiology, Transmission, Natural History, and Antiretroviral Therapy Overview.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the general classes of antiretroviral therapy and their role in reducing transmission risk (without encoding a specific current regimen, which is current-guidance-sensitive).
candidates.study_unit: HIV Infection: Epidemiology, Transmission, Natural History, and Antiretroviral Therapy Overview

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pediatric presentation reasoning for Anxiety Disorders in Children and Adolescents.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pediatric anxiety disorder presentations (including separation anxiety disorder beyond the developmentally normal 10-18 mo window) and age-appropriate first-line management (CBT before pharmacotherapy in most cases).
candidates.study_unit: Anxiety Disorders in Children and Adolescents

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Dyspnea (Cardiac Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate emergent management for acute cardiogenic dyspnea.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hearing impairment reasoning for Hearing Impairment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate conductive from sensorineural hearing loss in a primary-care patient and initiate appropriate counselling/referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose OCD using DSM-5-type criteria (obsessions and/or compulsions that are time-consuming or cause significant distress/impairment) and distinguish obsessions (ego-dystonic, unwanted) from delusions and from OCPD traits (ego-syntonic).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply toxidrome recognition reasoning for Specific Toxidromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize classic toxidromes (anticholinergic, cholinergic, opioid, sympathomimetic, serotonin syndrome) from clinical exam findings.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply viral hepatitis diagnosis reasoning for Viral Hepatitis (A, B, C, D).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute or chronic viral hepatitis (A, B, C, D) using serology, differentiate transmission routes and chronicity risk, and recognize indications for antiviral treatment/screening.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Pelvic Organ Prolapse.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose and stage pelvic organ prolapse (cystocele, rectocele, uterine/vault prolapse) and identify contributing risk factors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Antiphospholipid antibody syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize arterial or venous thrombosis and pregnancy morbidity suggestive of APS.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Neuro-Ophthalmology (Optic Neuropathy, Atrophy, Disc Edema, Visual Field Defects, Amaurosis Fugax, Pupil Abnormalities).
candidates.source_competency_text: Given visual symptoms/findings (painless vision loss, disc pallor vs. edema, a specific visual field defect pattern, transient monocular vision loss, or an abnormal pupillary light response), identify the likely neuro-ophthalmologic diagnosis and localize the lesion along the visual pathway.
candidates.study_unit: Neuro-Ophthalmology (Optic Neuropathy, Atrophy, Disc Edema, Visual Field Defects, Amaurosis Fugax, Pupil Abnormalities)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Thalassemia (Alpha and Beta, Minor/Major/Intermedia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize thalassemia trait/minor vs. major/intermedia by CBC pattern (low MCV with normal/high RBC count), ethnicity-based pretest probability, and Hb electrophoresis, distinguishing it from iron deficiency anemia.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply tdm indications reasoning for Therapeutic Drug Monitoring.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize which clinical scenarios warrant therapeutic drug monitoring (low therapeutic index, unpredictable dose-response, high consequence of toxicity/failure, wide interpatient PK variability) and identify the drugs that commonly require it (digoxin, phenytoin, vancomycin, aminoglycosides, lithium, warfarin).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Interventional Radiology Vascular Procedures (Angiography, Angioplasty/Stents, Thrombolysis, Embolization, IVC Filter, Central Venous Access).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the general indications for referral to interventional radiology (angioplasty/stenting for vascular stenosis, thrombolysis for acute limb ischemia or PE, embolization for uncontrolled hemorrhage, IVC filter when anticoagulation is contraindicated), without needing specific procedural technique detail.
candidates.study_unit: Interventional Radiology Vascular Procedures (Angiography, Angioplasty/Stents, Thrombolysis, Embolization, IVC Filter, Central Venous Access)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Chronic Abdominal Pain (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish functional chronic abdominal pain (normal growth, no alarm features) from organic causes (celiac disease, IBD, constipation) requiring targeted investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Elbow Dislocation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize elbow dislocation on exam/x-ray (radio-capitellar line), assess neurovascular status, and perform/recognize indications for closed reduction; distinguish simple from complex (fracture-associated) dislocation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply asthma severity reasoning for Asthma (Acute Severe Exacerbation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify acute asthma severity and select appropriate escalation of therapy (bronchodilators, steroids, NIV, intubation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply reporting duty reasoning for Mandatory Reporting: Reportable Diseases.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that physicians in Canada have a mandatory, provincially-legislated duty to report specified diseases to public health, that failure to report can result in licence suspension, and identify the reasons reporting is required (outbreak control, threat containment, treatable/preventable disease, surveillance).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply barriers reasoning for Drug Distribution (Volume of Distribution, Protein Binding, Depots, Barriers).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the BBB and placenta as relative barriers relevant to CNS side-effect risk and fetal drug exposure.
candidates.study_unit: Drug Distribution (Volume of Distribution, Protein Binding, Depots, Barriers)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply awareness reasoning for Breast Reconstruction (Post-Mastectomy).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that immediate or delayed breast reconstruction (implant-based or autologous flap) is an option to discuss after mastectomy, as part of comprehensive post-cancer-treatment counselling.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Approach to Head Computed Tomography and Modality Selection by Neurologic Presentation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select CT as the first-line imaging modality for acute head trauma, suspected intracranial hemorrhage, altered mental status, and hydrocephalus, and recognize danger signs on head CT (mass effect, midline shift, herniation) requiring urgent neurosurgical consultation.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Head Computed Tomography and Modality Selection by Neurologic Presentation

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pneumoconioses and Occupational Fibrotic Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common radiographic and clinical patterns and major complications, including malignancy and infection risk.
candidates.study_unit: Pneumoconioses and Occupational Fibrotic Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply exam reasoning for Thoracolumbar Spine (Spondylolisthesis, Low Back Pain Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply straight leg raise and femoral stretch tests to localize lumbosacral radiculopathy, and recognize spondylolisthesis (forward vertebral slip, classically L5-S1) as a cause of mechanical back pain with neurogenic claudication.
candidates.study_unit: Thoracolumbar Spine (Spondylolisthesis, Low Back Pain Approach)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Frailty.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate a multidisciplinary management plan addressing the identified contributing domains.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Cerebellar Disorders: Wernicke-Korsakoff Syndrome and Cerebellar Ataxias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Wernicke encephalopathy (confusion, ataxia, ophthalmoplegia) as a reversible medical emergency requiring emergent thiamine before glucose, and distinguish cerebellar (truncal/limb) ataxia from sensory ataxia on exam.
candidates.study_unit: Cerebellar Disorders: Wernicke-Korsakoff Syndrome and Cerebellar Ataxias

candidates.principal_decision: Apply agep recognition reasoning for Acute Generalized Exanthematous Pustulosis (AGEP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize AGEP by rapid onset of extensive sterile pustules with high fever and neutrophilia after a causative drug, and distinguish it from generalized pustular psoriasis and SJS/TEN.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gilberts recognition reasoning for Gilbert's Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Gilbert syndrome as a benign, common cause of mild isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia requiring no treatment, as a diagnosis of exclusion.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags and management reasoning for Septic Arthritis and Osteomyelitis (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize septic arthritis (Kocher criteria: fever, non-weight-bearing, elevated ESR/CRP, elevated WBC) as a surgical emergency requiring urgent joint aspiration and empiric IV antibiotics, and distinguish it from osteomyelitis (bony tenderness without joint effusion) and from transient synovitis (well-appearing, normal/mildly elevated inflammatory markers).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ALL as the most common childhood malignancy, presenting with bone pain, pancytopenia symptoms, and lymphadenopathy/hepatosplenomegaly, and recognize its urgency for hematology-oncology referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply syrinx recognition reasoning for Syringomyelia (Syrinx).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize dissociated sensory loss (cape distribution) as suggestive of syringomyelia and the association with Chiari malformation/trauma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize proximal weakness and characteristic dermatomyositis findings.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and response reasoning for Sexual Abuse and Assault.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize disclosure or clinical findings suggestive of sexual abuse/assault, assess immediate safety and forensic considerations, and initiate an appropriate examination, reporting, and support/referral plan.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply headache primary care reasoning for Headache.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate benign primary headache disorders (e.g., migraine, tension-type) from secondary causes requiring urgent investigation in the primary-care setting.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply febrile infant stratify reasoning for Febrile Infant and Febrile Seizures (incl. Common Pediatric Febrile Infections).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply age-based risk stratification (PECARN/Step-by-Step) to determine septic-workup and antibiotic need in a febrile infant.
candidates.study_unit: Febrile Infant and Febrile Seizures (incl. Common Pediatric Febrile Infections)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply health advocacy reasoning for Indigenous Health Disparities and Comorbidities.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize structural/social determinants driving disproportionate disease burden in Indigenous populations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply central tendency dispersion reasoning for Distributions and Descriptive Statistics.
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate mean, median, and mode from a data set, and identify which measure best reflects central tendency for a skewed (non-normal) distribution.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC).
candidates.source_competency_text: Treat the underlying trigger and provide supportive blood-product replacement (FFP, cryoprecipitate, platelets) guided by bleeding severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CLL as the most common adult leukemia in Western countries, often an incidental finding of marked lymphocytosis with smudge cells on blood film in an asymptomatic older adult.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply brain tumour recognition reasoning for Metastatic Brain Tumours and Adult Diffuse Gliomas.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the presentation of a supratentorial mass lesion (progressive headache, new focal deficit, seizure) and the role of contrast MRI in distinguishing metastasis from primary glioma.
candidates.study_unit: Metastatic Brain Tumours and Adult Diffuse Gliomas

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hypercoagulable Disorders (Thrombophilia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical features prompting a thrombophilia workup (unprovoked/recurrent VTE, VTE at young age, unusual sites, arterial thrombosis, recurrent miscarriage) and identify the major hereditary (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin gene mutation, protein C/S or antithrombin deficiency) and acquired (antiphospholipid syndrome) causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Social Anxiety Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize social anxiety disorder (persistent fear of social/performance situations due to fear of negative evaluation, causing avoidance or endurance with marked distress) and distinguish from normal shyness by severity/impairment/duration (>=6 mo).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply thyroid cancer subtypes reasoning for Thyroid Malignancies.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish papillary, follicular, medullary, and anaplastic thyroid carcinoma by prognosis and typical clinical behaviour, and recognize medullary thyroid cancer's association with MEN2.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Hemophilia A, Hemophilia B, and Factor XI Deficiency.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the X-linked hemarthrosis/deep-muscle-bleeding pattern of hemophilia A (factor VIII) and B (factor IX), confirmed by isolated prolonged PTT and specific factor assay.
candidates.study_unit: Hemophilia A, Hemophilia B, and Factor XI Deficiency

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Breast Diagnostic/Interventional Procedures and Mammographic Feature Characterization (Benign vs. Malignant Masses).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish benign (circumscribed, oval, popcorn calcification) from malignant (irregular, spiculated, pleomorphic calcification) mammographic mass features, and recognize when core needle biopsy is indicated for a BI-RADS 4/5 finding.
candidates.study_unit: Breast Diagnostic/Interventional Procedures and Mammographic Feature Characterization (Benign vs. Malignant Masses)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Agoraphobia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize agoraphobia as an independent DSM-5 diagnosis (not merely a panic-disorder complication) and its characteristic situational avoidance pattern.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply worker rights reasoning for Workplace Legislation and Workers' Compensation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify a worker's four core rights under Canadian occupational health and safety legislation: to know, to participate, to refuse unsafe work, and (for certified workers) to stop work.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply classification reasoning for Gestational Age and Size Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a newborn by gestational age (preterm/term/post-term) and size-for-age (SGA/AGA/LGA) using standardized growth curves, recognizing each category's distinct risk profile.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigate reasoning for Gout.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use crystal analysis appropriately.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gi bleed ddx reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Gastrointestinal Bleeding (Surgical Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Localize GI bleeding as upper vs. lower, generate a surgical differential, and recognize indications for urgent surgical/endoscopic intervention.
candidates.study_unit: Differential Diagnosis of Gastrointestinal Bleeding (Surgical Approach)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose PTSD (exposure to trauma plus intrusion, avoidance, negative alterations in cognition/mood, and hyperarousal symptoms persisting >1 mo with functional impairment) and distinguish from acute stress disorder by duration.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply resuscitation algorithm reasoning for Neonatal Resuscitation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the neonatal resuscitation algorithm (initial steps -- warm, dry, stimulate, position airway; positive-pressure ventilation if apneic/HR<100; chest compressions and epinephrine if HR remains <60 despite adequate ventilation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Acute and Delayed Blood Transfusion Reactions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and immediately stop the transfusion for suspected acute hemolytic transfusion reaction (fever, flank pain, hemoglobinuria, shock) vs. manage febrile non-hemolytic, allergic, TRALI, or TACO reactions appropriately, and recognize delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction and iron overload as delayed complications.
candidates.study_unit: Acute and Delayed Blood Transfusion Reactions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Microdeletion and Other Recognizable Genetic Syndromes (22q11.2/DiGeorge Syndrome, Prader-Willi Syndrome, Angelman Syndrome, Noonan Syndrome, CHARGE Syndrome).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the hallmark phenotype of the most clinically significant named microdeletion/imprinting syndromes (22q11.2 deletion/DiGeorge: conotruncal cardiac defect, hypocalcemia, immunodeficiency; Prader-Willi: hypotonia then hyperphagia/obesity; Angelman: severe intellectual disability with inappropriate happy affect; Noonan: pulmonary stenosis, webbed neck; CHARGE).
candidates.study_unit: Microdeletion and Other Recognizable Genetic Syndromes (22q11.2/DiGeorge Syndrome, Prader-Willi Syndrome, Angelman Syndrome, Noonan Syndrome, CHARGE Syndrome)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply eligibility purpose reasoning for Community Treatment Order (CTO).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the purpose of a CTO (structured community treatment plan for a patient with a pattern of relapse/readmission due to treatment non-adherence) and that it is consent-based with defined review rights, without needing exact provincial eligibility-criteria numbers as fixed fact.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Cystic Fibrosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify pulmonary and multisystem complications that require specialist multidisciplinary care.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Intracranial Hemorrhage.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with intracranial hemorrhage, identify the likely etiology (hypertensive, amyloid angiopathy, trauma, AVM/aneurysm), order appropriate investigations, and outline acute blood-pressure and ICP management, recognizing surgical indications requiring Neurosurgery referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Bulimia Nervosa.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose bulimia nervosa (recurrent binge eating with compensatory behaviours -- purging, laxative/diuretic misuse, fasting, excessive exercise -- at least weekly for 3 mo, in a patient often of normal or above-normal weight) and distinguish from anorexia nervosa binge-purge subtype by weight status.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Chest Pain (Cardiac Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize chest pain presentations requiring urgent cardiac workup vs. lower-risk presentations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply intoxication withdrawal reasoning for Alcohol Use Disorder, Intoxication, and Withdrawal.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the intoxication and withdrawal syndrome for this substance and initiate appropriate acute management (including withdrawal-severity-scale-guided treatment where applicable), given the risk of life-threatening complications.
candidates.study_unit: Alcohol Use Disorder, Intoxication, and Withdrawal

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Stroke: Primary and Secondary Prevention.
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel on modifiable stroke risk factors (lipids, glycemic control, smoking cessation, physical activity, antihypertensive/antiplatelet or anticoagulant therapy as indicated) for primary and secondary stroke prevention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cerebral Palsy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize cerebral palsy (non-progressive motor disorder from an early static brain insult, classified by motor type -- spastic/dyskinetic/ataxic -- and topographic distribution) and its common comorbidities (intellectual disability, seizures, feeding difficulty) requiring interdisciplinary management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Scaphoid Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize anatomical snuffbox tenderness after FOOSH as suspicious for scaphoid fracture even with a negative initial x-ray, and immobilize (thumb spica) with repeat imaging in 2 wk to avoid missing an occult fracture and its high avascular-necrosis risk (especially proximal-pole fractures).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Approach to joint pain and patterns of joint involvement.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate inflammatory, degenerative, crystal, infectious, and non-articular patterns.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to joint pain and patterns of joint involvement

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Anemia of Chronic Disease (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish anemia of chronic disease (normal/high ferritin, low TIBC) from iron deficiency anemia (low ferritin, high TIBC) using iron studies in a child with an underlying chronic inflammatory condition.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply leukoplakia recognition reasoning for Pre-Malignant Skin Conditions (Actinic Keratosis, Leukoplakia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize oral leukoplakia as a premalignant mucosal lesion requiring biopsy to exclude malignancy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Renal Transplantation: Indications, Immunosuppression, and Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize renal transplantation as the preferred renal replacement modality for eligible ESRD patients and identify the major post-transplant complications requiring recognition (graft rejection, opportunistic infection, malignancy, new-onset diabetes).
candidates.study_unit: Renal Transplantation: Indications, Immunosuppression, and Complications

candidates.principal_decision: Apply legal professional action reasoning for Canadian Legal System Framework (Criminal/Civil/Administrative Law).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish criminal, civil, and administrative legal consequences of a given act, and recognize that criminal law is national while civil/administrative law varies by province/territory.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Orbital Floor Fractures.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize blow-out orbital floor fracture presentation (enophthalmos, diplopia on upgaze from inferior rectus entrapment, infraorbital numbness) and urgent ophthalmology co-management indications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply counselling reasoning for Genetic Testing and Counselling.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify indications for presymptomatic testing, newborn screening, preconception counselling, and preimplantation genetic diagnosis, and construct an initial management plan including referral for genetic counselling and testing.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention levels reasoning for Disease Prevention: Natural History, Surveillance, and Levels of Prevention.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a given intervention as primordial, primary, secondary, or tertiary prevention.
candidates.study_unit: Disease Prevention: Natural History, Surveillance, and Levels of Prevention

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fasting reasoning for Preoperative Medications and Fasting Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Canadian fasting-duration guidelines (6h solids, 2h clear fluids in adults) to reduce aspiration risk before elective surgery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diabetes primary care reasoning for Diabetes Mellitus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose type 2 diabetes mellitus in a primary-care patient using standard glycemic criteria and manage it longitudinally (lifestyle, first-line pharmacotherapy, complication screening).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Acute Limb Ischemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform a focused vascular examination, arrange appropriate initial assessment, stabilize, and obtain urgent vascular consultation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Lactase Deficiency (Lactose Intolerance).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lactose intolerance (bloating, cramping, osmotic diarrhea temporally related to dairy intake) and distinguish primary/genetic from secondary/post-infectious lactase deficiency.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Lyme Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize erythema migrans and staged Lyme disease presentations in a patient with tick exposure in an endemic Canadian region, and interpret Public-Health-Lab Lyme serology.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy (Janz Syndrome).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize JME (morning myoclonic jerks, generalized tonic-clonic seizures, adolescent onset, 3.5-6 Hz spike-wave EEG increased with photic stimulation) and that it requires lifelong antiepileptic therapy despite an otherwise excellent prognosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypogonadotropic hypogonadism reasoning for Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (Kallmann syndrome, pituitary tumour/apoplexy, drug-induced) by low LH/FSH with low sex-hormone levels, and initiate hormone-replacement therapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Compartment Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pain out of proportion, pain on passive stretch (most sensitive), and a tense swollen compartment as compartment syndrome (a clinical diagnosis) and initiate emergent fasciotomy without waiting for the late '5 Ps'.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Overactive Bladder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize urgency/frequency syndrome and exclude important alternate causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply technique reasoning for Induction Technique and Agents.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify indications for rapid sequence induction (aspiration risk) vs. routine induction.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply consent and support reasoning for Adults with developmental disabilities.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess the patient's ability to provide voluntary informed consent and appropriately incorporate input from caregivers or support workers.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Congestive Heart Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate HFrEF from HFpEF conceptually.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Hematuria.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate glomerular from nonglomerular hematuria and initiate appropriate evaluation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pagets disease reasoning for Paget's Disease of Bone.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Paget's disease of bone as an incidental finding of isolated elevated alkaline phosphatase with normal calcium, and its characteristic radiographic findings and bisphosphonate management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply acs classification reasoning for Acute Coronary Syndrome (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify ACS as UA, NSTEMI, or STEMI using biomarkers and ECG, and select reperfusion strategy (PCI vs. thrombolysis) and timing.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply stepwise pharmacotherapy reasoning for Treatment of Diabetes: Glycemic Targets, Lifestyle, and Pharmacotherapy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select initial and add-on non-insulin antihyperglycemic therapy for T2DM using the stepwise algorithm (metformin first-line, then SGLT2i/GLP-1RA/DPP-4i/sulfonylurea/TZD/insulin by patient factors).
candidates.study_unit: Treatment of Diabetes: Glycemic Targets, Lifestyle, and Pharmacotherapy

candidates.principal_decision: Apply appendicitis management reasoning for Appendicitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute appendicitis from history, exam, and imaging, and recognize indications for urgent appendectomy vs. selected nonoperative management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply groin hernia management reasoning for Groin Hernias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate indirect, direct, and femoral inguinal hernias on exam, and recognize incarceration/strangulation as indications for emergent surgical repair.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hereditary crc recognition reasoning for Familial Colorectal Cancer Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize features suggestive of a hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome (young age, family history pattern, polyp burden) warranting genetics referral and intensified screening.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pediatric Fracture Patterns (Fractures in Children).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pediatric-specific fracture patterns (greenstick, buckle/torus) due to more pliable bone, and recognize fracture patterns/mechanisms inconsistent with history as a red flag for non-accidental trauma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply abscess recognition reasoning for Cerebral Abscess.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize fever + headache + focal deficit + ring-enhancing lesion as suggesting cerebral abscess requiring urgent imaging and neurosurgical/ID involvement.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pediatric IBD (chronic diarrhea +/- blood/mucus, abdominal pain, growth failure/pubertal delay as a distinguishing pediatric feature of Crohn disease) and distinguish Crohn disease from ulcerative colitis by distribution and extraintestinal features.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply causation criteria reasoning for Criteria for Causation (Bradford Hill Criteria).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the Bradford Hill criteria (strength, consistency, specificity, temporality, biological gradient, plausibility, coherence, experimental evidence, analogy) to assess whether an observed association is likely causal.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red eye triage reasoning for Ophthalmologic Emergencies (Red Eye Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate benign from vision-/life-threatening causes of red eye (acute angle closure glaucoma, iritis, corneal ulcer) using associated symptoms.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply developmental milestones reasoning for Growth and Development (Growth Charts, Growth Velocity, Developmental Milestones).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize expected gross motor, fine motor, speech/language, cognitive, and social-emotional milestones by age as the normal baseline for developmental screening.
candidates.study_unit: Growth and Development (Growth Charts, Growth Velocity, Developmental Milestones)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Vulvar Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a persistent vulvar lesion, ulcer, or pruritus unresponsive to first-line treatment as a warning feature requiring biopsy to exclude vulvar malignancy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Eyelid Malposition (Ptosis, Trichiasis, Entropion, Ectropion).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lid-malposition disorders (ptosis, entropion, ectropion, trichiasis) and identify acquired ptosis with pupil involvement as a red flag for third-nerve palsy or Horner syndrome requiring urgent neurologic workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Nuclear Medicine Respiratory and Cardiac Imaging (V/Q Scan including Pregnancy Considerations, Myocardial Perfusion Scan, MUGA).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize V/Q scan (or a modified perfusion-only, lower-dose protocol) as the preferred pulmonary embolism imaging strategy in pregnant patients with a normal CXR.
candidates.study_unit: Nuclear Medicine Respiratory and Cardiac Imaging (V/Q Scan including Pregnancy Considerations, Myocardial Perfusion Scan, MUGA)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hereditary Spherocytosis and Hereditary Elliptocytosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hereditary spherocytosis (spherocytes, elevated MCHC, increased osmotic fragility) and hereditary elliptocytosis (elliptocytes) as intrinsic membrane-defect hemolytic anemias, and identify splenectomy as the definitive treatment for severe disease with pre-splenectomy vaccination.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply trauma assessment reasoning for Neurotrauma: Trauma Assessment and Head/Brain Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply primary/secondary survey trauma assessment to a head-injured patient and classify head injury severity by GCS.
candidates.study_unit: Neurotrauma: Trauma Assessment and Head/Brain Injury

candidates.principal_decision: Apply team roles reasoning for Collaboration (Interprofessional Palliative Care Team).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify the distinct roles of physicians, nurses, social workers/case managers, pharmacists, occupational/physical therapists, dieticians, and spiritual care workers on an interprofessional palliative care team.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cirrhosis diagnosis reasoning for Cirrhosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose cirrhosis and its complications (portal hypertension, variceal bleeding, ascites, hepatic encephalopathy, hepatocellular carcinoma) and initiate an appropriate management plan.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize diabetes insipidus (central vs. nephrogenic) as a cause of hypotonic polyuria and hypernatremia.
candidates.study_unit: Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis management reasoning for Specific Phobic Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize specific phobia (marked, disproportionate, persistent fear of a specific object/situation, actively avoided or endured with intense anxiety, >=6 mo) and that exposure-based CBT -- not pharmacotherapy -- is first-line treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply psc recognition reasoning for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize primary sclerosing cholangitis as a cholestatic liver disease strongly associated with ulcerative colitis, requiring surveillance for cholangiocarcinoma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Hypertension: Hypertensive Nephrosclerosis, Renovascular Hypertension, and Renal Parenchymal Hypertension.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate BP-target-appropriate management for hypertensive nephrosclerosis and recognize when malignant hypertension requires urgent BP-lowering.
candidates.study_unit: Hypertension: Hypertensive Nephrosclerosis, Renovascular Hypertension, and Renal Parenchymal Hypertension

candidates.principal_decision: Apply iih recognition reasoning for Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumour Cerebri).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize IIH as a cause of headache/papilledema/visual changes in a young obese woman and the need for neuroimaging plus LP opening pressure to diagnose.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Osgood-Schlatter Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Osgood-Schlatter disease (tender, sometimes prominent tibial tubercle in an active adolescent) as a self-limited traction apophysitis managed with activity modification, not imaging-driven workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Angiography of the Gastrointestinal Tract (GI Bleed Localization).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CT angiography as the modality of choice for localizing an active GI bleed, given active bleeding at a sufficient rate is required for angiographic visualization.
candidates.study_unit: Angiography of the Gastrointestinal Tract (GI Bleed Localization)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Rheumatic Fever.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Jones criteria conceptually to recognize acute rheumatic fever.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Failure to Thrive.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify failure to thrive by mechanism (inadequate intake, inadequate absorption, increased metabolic demand, defective utilization) and weigh organic against psychosocial/environmental etiologies; recognize red flags requiring urgent workup vs. outpatient nutritional follow-up.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Thyroglossal Duct Cyst.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a midline neck mass that elevates with tongue protrusion/swallowing as a thyroglossal duct cyst, and know pre-operative thyroid ultrasound is required to confirm the presence of a normally located thyroid gland before surgical excision (Sistrunk procedure).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prom management reasoning for Prelabour Rupture of Membranes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose rupture of membranes, distinguish term from preterm PROM, and apply the appropriate expectant-management vs. delivery decision framework.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Flashes of Light (Photopsia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize photopsia as a retinal-traction warning sign requiring dilated fundus exam to exclude retinal tear/detachment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Otosclerosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize progressive conductive hearing loss in a young adult (often with a family history or during pregnancy) with a normal TM as otosclerosis, and know management options range from hearing aids to stapedectomy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply spin snout reasoning for Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the SPIN (specific test rules IN) and SNOUT (sensitive test rules OUT) heuristics to select an appropriate test for ruling in vs. ruling out a diagnosis.
candidates.study_unit: Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply bias subtypes reasoning for Bias and Confounding in Epidemiologic Studies.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a study description, identify the specific type of selection bias (Berkson's, non-response, loss-to-follow-up) or information bias (recall, interviewer, observer) present.
candidates.study_unit: Bias and Confounding in Epidemiologic Studies

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Sinusitis (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish acute bacterial sinusitis (persistent symptoms >10 d, severe onset, or double-worsening course) from a prolonged uncomplicated viral URTI.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply manage reasoning for Rheumatoid arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize need for early rheumatology referral and broad DMARD principles.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Uveitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize anterior uveitis (photophobia, ciliary flush, small/irregular pupil, hypopyon in severe cases) as requiring urgent slit-lamp confirmation and topical cycloplegic/steroid therapy under ophthalmology guidance, and screen for associated systemic inflammatory disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition 2 reasoning for Oncologic Emergencies: Hyperviscosity Syndrome and Tumour Lysis Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize tumour lysis syndrome (hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hyperuricemia, hypocalcemia, acute kidney injury) as a risk after initiating chemotherapy for a high-burden hematologic malignancy and initiate prophylaxis (hydration, allopurinol/rasburicase) and monitoring.
candidates.study_unit: Oncologic Emergencies: Hyperviscosity Syndrome and Tumour Lysis Syndrome

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Parasitic Infections: Protozoa (Entamoeba, Giardia, Trichomonas, Cryptosporidium).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate antiparasitic therapy (e.g., metronidazole) for the relevant protozoal infection.
candidates.study_unit: Parasitic Infections: Protozoa (Entamoeba, Giardia, Trichomonas, Cryptosporidium)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pud complications reasoning for Peptic Ulcer Disease (H. pylori, NSAID-, and Stress-Induced).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize complications of PUD, including hemorrhage and perforation, as causes of acute abdominal pain and upper GI bleeding.
candidates.study_unit: Peptic Ulcer Disease (H. pylori, NSAID-, and Stress-Induced)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Bone and Joint Infections (Septic Arthritis, Diabetic Foot Infections, Osteomyelitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose diabetic foot infection severity and osteomyelitis (probe-to-bone test, imaging) to guide antibiotic duration and surgical referral.
candidates.study_unit: Bone and Joint Infections (Septic Arthritis, Diabetic Foot Infections, Osteomyelitis)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cervical Cancer and Cervical Cancer Screening.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical presentations of cervical cancer (postcoital bleeding, abnormal discharge, advanced-stage pelvic symptoms) warranting urgent investigation.
candidates.study_unit: Cervical Cancer and Cervical Cancer Screening

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Shoulder Dislocation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize anterior vs. posterior shoulder dislocation on exam/x-ray, assess axillary nerve and neurovascular status pre- and post-reduction, and perform/recognize indications for closed reduction.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Psychosocial and Spiritual Needs (incl. FICA Spiritual Assessment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the distinct psychosocial (psychological/emotional/social) vs. spiritual (meaning, value, purpose) domains of a holistic palliative assessment, and apply the FICA framework (Faith, Importance, Community, Address) to a spiritual-needs conversation.
candidates.study_unit: Psychosocial and Spiritual Needs (incl. FICA Spiritual Assessment)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply manage reasoning for Osteoarthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select broad nonpharmacologic and initial symptom-management concepts.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply referral reasoning for Brachial Plexus Injuries.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify indications for urgent surgical exploration (open/sharp injury) vs. observation (closed traction injury).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Palpitations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select appropriate rhythm-monitoring strategy (resting ECG vs. ambulatory monitoring) based on symptom frequency.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hand Infections.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical features of common hand infections (paronychia, felon, flexor tenosynovitis/Kanavel signs, deep-space infection) and identify which require urgent surgical drainage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and management reasoning for Nephrotic Syndrome (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize nephrotic syndrome's tetrad (heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, edema, hyperlipidemia) and that minimal change disease is the predominant pediatric cause, typically corticosteroid-responsive; recognize infection and thrombosis as key complications from urinary immunoglobulin/antithrombin loss.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Traumatic Hand Amputations and Replantation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize appropriate initial management and transport of an amputated digit/part (wrap in saline gauze, place in bag on ice, avoid direct ice contact) and identify replantation candidacy factors requiring urgent referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Drug Ototoxicity.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize aminoglycosides, loop diuretics, platinum-based chemotherapy, and high-dose salicylates as ototoxic and monitor hearing/dose in at-risk patients (e.g. renal impairment, prolonged courses).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Vaginal Discharge and Vulvovaginitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate diagnostic testing and first-line management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Acute and Chronic Laryngitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute laryngitis as usually viral and self-limited (voice rest, hydration) and chronic laryngitis (lifestyle: smoking, reflux) as warranting risk-factor modification and laryngoscopy if persistent.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Schizoaffective Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish schizoaffective disorder from schizophrenia with mood symptoms and from mood disorder with psychotic features by the relative timing/persistence of psychotic vs. mood symptoms.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Carotid Stenosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Arrange appropriate initial investigation, risk reduction, and urgent referral when neurologic symptoms are present.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply reversible causes reasoning for Major or Mild Neurocognitive Disorder (Dementia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Screen for and identify reversible/treatable causes of cognitive decline before attributing to a primary neurodegenerative process.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hepatic encephalopathy management reasoning for Hepatic Encephalopathy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hepatic encephalopathy as a complication of cirrhosis/portal hypertension, identify precipitants (GI bleed, infection, constipation, medication non-adherence), and initiate treatment (e.g., lactulose).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply class recognition reasoning for Antidepressants.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the indications, class-characteristic adverse effects, and rational-use principles of antidepressants as a drug class, without hard-coding specific current dosing, sequencing, or monitoring-schedule recommendations (verified independently against current guidance at question-generation stage).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for CNS Infections (Meningitis, Encephalitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret CSF findings to differentiate bacterial, viral, and other causes of meningitis/encephalitis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply syphilis staging reasoning for Cutaneous Manifestations of Sexually Transmitted Infections (Syphilis, Gonococcemia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the staged presentation of syphilis (painless chancre -> secondary maculopapular/condyloma lata rash -> tertiary gumma) and select penicillin G-based treatment by stage.
candidates.study_unit: Cutaneous Manifestations of Sexually Transmitted Infections (Syphilis, Gonococcemia)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply toxic alcohol recognition reasoning for Alcohol-Related Emergencies (incl. Toxic Alcohols).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish toxic alcohol ingestion (elevated osmolar gap progressing to anion gap metabolic acidosis) from simple ethanol intoxication and initiate treatment (fomepizole/ethanol, hemodialysis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Generalized Anxiety Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate first-line management (CBT and/or SSRI/SNRI).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Tibial Shaft Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize tibial shaft fracture as carrying a high risk of compartment syndrome (subcutaneous location, tight fascial compartments) and open injury, and know IM nailing is standard operative fixation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Ebstein's Anomaly.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Ebstein's anomaly (apically displaced, malformed tricuspid valve leaflets), its association with maternal lithium/benzodiazepine exposure and with accessory conduction pathways (e.g. WPW).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply consent reasoning for Genetic Testing and Counselling.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply informed-consent principles when discussing genetic testing options, including the implications of a positive result for the patient and family members.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Pericardial Effusion and Cardiac Tamponade.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize tamponade as an emergency requiring urgent pericardiocentesis.
