candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Lyme Arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Lyme arthritis (large-joint monoarthritis, classically the knee, in a child with tick exposure in an endemic area +/- preceding erythema migrans) and the role of serologic testing and antibiotic treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply intestinal ischemia recognition reasoning for Intestinal Ischemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute mesenteric ischemia as a surgical emergency with pain out of proportion to exam findings and initiate urgent management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hzv prevention reasoning for Herpes Simplex Virus and Herpes Zoster Virus Infections.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recommend recombinant zoster vaccine for prevention in patients >=50 years.
candidates.study_unit: Herpes Simplex Virus and Herpes Zoster Virus Infections

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cholangitis management reasoning for Acute Cholangitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute cholangitis (Charcot's triad, Reynolds' pentad) as a surgical/gastroenterologic emergency requiring urgent biliary decompression.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply depression reasoning for Depression.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose depression in a primary-care patient using standard screening/diagnostic criteria, assess suicide risk, and initiate first-line management (psychotherapy referral and/or pharmacotherapy).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply longitudinal management reasoning for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Plan smoking cessation, vaccination, inhaled therapy, rehabilitation, oxygen assessment, and follow-up at a generalist level.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply calculation reasoning for Assessment of Renal Function: GFR Measurement, Urinalysis, Urine Microscopy, and Urine Biochemistry.
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate/interpret eGFR and creatinine clearance as measures of renal function.
candidates.study_unit: Assessment of Renal Function: GFR Measurement, Urinalysis, Urine Microscopy, and Urine Biochemistry

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Adjustment Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish adjustment disorder (emotional/behavioural symptoms within 3 mo of an identifiable stressor, resolving within 6 mo of stressor/consequences ending, not meeting criteria for another disorder) from PTSD, normal stress response, and major depressive disorder.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Recurrent Headache (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate primary headache (tension, migraine, cluster) from secondary causes requiring urgent workup (raised ICP from a mass lesion, meningitis) using red flags (early-morning headache/vomiting, focal neuro deficits, papilledema, worsening pattern).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply safety reasoning for Contrast Agents and Contrast Safety (Iodinated Contrast, Gadolinium, Barium, Microbubbles; Contrast-Induced Nephropathy Prevention).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize contraindications to IV/oral/rectal contrast agents (prior adverse reaction, renal impairment, dehydration, myasthenia gravis, right-to-left cardiac shunt for microbubbles) and appropriate preventive hydration strategies before contrast-enhanced imaging in at-risk patients.
candidates.study_unit: Contrast Agents and Contrast Safety (Iodinated Contrast, Gadolinium, Barium, Microbubbles; Contrast-Induced Nephropathy Prevention)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cord syndrome localization reasoning for Spinal Cord Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a pattern of motor/sensory findings, identify the incomplete spinal cord syndrome (Brown-Sequard, central cord, anterior cord, posterior cord) and its typical mechanism.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply paralytic ileus reasoning for Paralytic (Adynamic) Ileus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate paralytic ileus from mechanical bowel obstruction and initiate appropriate supportive management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Mediastinal Abnormalities and Cardiac Silhouette (Mediastinal Mass Compartments, Cardiomegaly).
candidates.source_competency_text: Localize a mediastinal mass to the anterior, middle, or posterior compartment using Felson's method and generate an appropriate differential diagnosis for each compartment.
candidates.study_unit: Mediastinal Abnormalities and Cardiac Silhouette (Mediastinal Mass Compartments, Cardiomegaly)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Knee Osteoarthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize knee osteoarthritis (chronic joint pain/stiffness/crepitus, LOSS x-ray findings) and know non-operative management (weight loss, exercise, analgesics) precedes surgical referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply nmj pharm reasoning for Muscle Relaxants, Reversal Agents, and Induction Analgesia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish depolarizing (succinylcholine) from non-depolarizing muscle relaxants by mechanism, onset/duration, and reversal strategy (sugammadex for rocuronium/vecuronium; anticholinesterases for others).
candidates.study_unit: Muscle Relaxants, Reversal Agents, and Induction Analgesia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Pneumoconioses and Occupational Fibrotic Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Remove or reduce exposure, initiate appropriate surveillance/referral, and address work and prevention implications.
candidates.study_unit: Pneumoconioses and Occupational Fibrotic Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply feeding counselling reasoning for Nutrition (Infant Feeding, Breastfeeding/Formula, Signs of Adequate/Inadequate Intake).
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel on breastfeeding vs. formula feeding, appropriate introduction of complementary foods, and foods/substances to avoid in infancy (honey before 12 mo, excess milk after 1 yr, added sugar/salt).
candidates.study_unit: Nutrition (Infant Feeding, Breastfeeding/Formula, Signs of Adequate/Inadequate Intake)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Patellofemoral (Pain) Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize patellofemoral pain syndrome as a common, largely clinical diagnosis of activity-related anterior knee pain managed with non-operative quadriceps/hip strengthening.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cyp interactions reasoning for Drug Metabolism and Cytochrome P450-Mediated Interactions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Predict the clinical consequence of co-administering a CYP inhibitor or inducer with a CYP substrate drug (e.g., toxicity from inhibition, therapeutic failure from induction) using the named high-yield examples (macrolides, azole antifungals, grapefruit juice, rifampin, carbamazepine, St. John's wort).
candidates.study_unit: Drug Metabolism and Cytochrome P450-Mediated Interactions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Celiac Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize celiac disease presentations (chronic diarrhea, FTT, abdominal distension, iron deficiency anemia, dermatitis herpetiformis) and the diagnostic approach (tTG-IgA serology while on a gluten-containing diet, duodenal biopsy confirmation).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hashimoto diagnosis reasoning for Hashimoto's Thyroiditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Hashimoto's thyroiditis by elevated anti-TPO/anti-thyroglobulin antibodies and its association with other autoimmune disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pelvic pain triage reasoning for Acute Pelvic Pain (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify gynecological emergencies (ovarian torsion, ectopic pregnancy, tubo-ovarian abscess) presenting as acute pelvic pain.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Brachial Plexus Injuries.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical presentation of traction/compressive vs. sharp/open brachial plexus injury (including obstetric palsy) and distinguish findings suggesting root avulsion.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hazard classification reasoning for Disaster Preparedness, Emergency Response, and Recovery.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify a disaster's causal hazard as natural, human-system, or multi-level.
candidates.study_unit: Disaster Preparedness, Emergency Response, and Recovery

candidates.principal_decision: Apply special mechanisms reasoning for Special Considerations in Burn Injury (Chemical, Electrical, Inhalation, Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize distinguishing features and additional risks of chemical, electrical, and inhalation burns, and features prompting suspicion of non-accidental (pediatric) burn injury.
candidates.study_unit: Special Considerations in Burn Injury (Chemical, Electrical, Inhalation, Pediatric)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lung cancer recognition reasoning for Lung Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize presenting features of lung cancer (hemoptysis, weight loss, mass) and identify appropriate initial investigation and referral pathway.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply culturally safe care reasoning for Indigenous Health in Canada and the Legacy of Colonization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a curiosity-based, culturally humble approach (e.g., asking what the patient needs the physician to know) rather than assuming an Indigenous patient's preferences regarding traditional medicine.
candidates.study_unit: Indigenous Health in Canada and the Legacy of Colonization

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Total Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return (TAPVR).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize TAPVR's pathophysiology (all pulmonary veins drain to the right-sided circulation; an ASD is obligatory for survival) and the classic 'snowman' heart silhouette on CXR.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chronic diarrhea diagnosis reasoning for Chronic Diarrhea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of chronic diarrhea, contrasting small vs. large bowel causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sbo management reasoning for Mechanical Small Bowel Obstruction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize mechanical small bowel obstruction, distinguish partial from complete and simple from strangulated obstruction, and identify indications for surgical vs. nonoperative management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Approach to Abnormal Gait.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with a gait disturbance, differentiate ataxic from other gait patterns (e.g., spastic, parkinsonian, steppage), localize the level of the nervous system involved, and determine cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Syncope and Loss of Consciousness (Cardiac Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish syncope from seizure and other transient loss-of-consciousness mimics.
candidates.study_unit: Syncope and Loss of Consciousness (Cardiac Differential)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cough reasoning for Cough.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause of acute or chronic cough in a primary-care patient and differentiate benign causes from those requiring further investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply splenectomy complications reasoning for Splenectomy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for splenectomy and identify post-splenectomy sepsis risk, including required vaccinations and antibiotic prophylaxis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply di workup reasoning for Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish central from nephrogenic diabetes insipidus using fluid-deprivation testing and response to exogenous DDAVP.
candidates.study_unit: Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH

candidates.principal_decision: Apply rosacea management reasoning for Perioral Dermatitis and Rosacea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select an appropriate first-line topical or oral therapy for rosacea based on predominant feature (erythema/telangiectasia vs. papulopustular vs. phymatous).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply postop abscess reasoning for Postoperative Intra-Abdominal Abscess.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize intra-abdominal abscess as a cause of persistent postoperative fever/pain and identify indications for drainage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Radial Head Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize radial head fracture on history/exam (lateral elbow tenderness, painful pronation/supination) and x-ray (sail sign), and know Mason classification broadly guides non-operative versus operative management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anemia management reasoning for Iron and Folate Deficiency Anemia in Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize iron and folate deficiency anemia in pregnancy on routine screening and initiate appropriate supplementation.
candidates.study_unit: Iron and Folate Deficiency Anemia in Pregnancy

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Enteropathic arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize inflammatory arthritis associated with inflammatory bowel disease and coordinate referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply triage reasoning for Preseptal versus Orbital Cellulitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate preseptal (eyelid-confined, afebrile, normal EOM/vision) from orbital cellulitis (proptosis, painful/restricted EOM, vision change, fever) -- orbital cellulitis is a true emergency requiring immediate IV antibiotics and imaging.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply urgent action reasoning for Arterial Blood Gases, Acid-Base Status, and Hypoxemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize severe hypoxemia or ventilatory failure and initiate stabilization and escalation.
candidates.study_unit: Arterial Blood Gases, Acid-Base Status, and Hypoxemia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Fever of Unknown Origin.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a systematic diagnostic approach (repeated history, exposures, infectious contacts, targeted investigations) to fever of unknown origin.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply tachyarrhythmia algorithm reasoning for Appendices: Advanced Cardiac Life Support Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the unstable-tachyarrhythmia algorithm (synchronized cardioversion for hemodynamic instability; adenosine for regular narrow-complex; rate/rhythm control medication choice by QRS width).
candidates.study_unit: Appendices: Advanced Cardiac Life Support Guidelines

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hyperthermia ddx reasoning for Intraoperative Temperature Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Generate a differential for intraoperative hyperthermia (drug reaction, transfusion reaction, infection/sepsis, hypermetabolic states including malignant hyperthermia) rather than assuming infection by default.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply awareness reasoning for Magnetic Seizure Therapy and Neurosurgical/Device-Based Treatments.
candidates.source_competency_text: General awareness that magnetic seizure therapy, ablative neurosurgery, deep brain stimulation, and vagus nerve stimulation are experimental or last-resort options reserved for severe treatment-resistant depression/OCD unresponsive to standard treatment, without needing procedural or patient-selection detail.
candidates.study_unit: Magnetic Seizure Therapy and Neurosurgical/Device-Based Treatments

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Uterine (Endometrial) Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postmenopausal bleeding as the cardinal warning sign of endometrial cancer and identify major risk factors (unopposed estrogen exposure, obesity, PCOS, tamoxifen).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Corneal Ulcer (Microbial Keratitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize corneal ulcer (white corneal infiltrate, severe pain, photophobia, contact-lens history) as a same-day ophthalmology emergency requiring culture and urgent topical antimicrobial therapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Sleep-Wake Disorders (Overview, Sleep Hygiene, and DSM-5 Categories).
candidates.source_competency_text: Given insomnia or excessive daytime sleepiness, generate a differential across the DSM-5 sleep-wake disorder categories (dyssomnias, breathing-related, parasomnias) and recognize characteristic distinguishing features (e.g., cataplexy for narcolepsy, snoring/witnessed apneas for OSA).
candidates.study_unit: Sleep-Wake Disorders (Overview, Sleep Hygiene, and DSM-5 Categories)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Physical Abuse.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize historical and examination red flags for physical abuse (injury inconsistent with developmental stage or stated mechanism, patterned bruising/burns, delayed presentation, multiple injuries of different ages, classic metaphyseal lesions/rib fractures on skeletal survey) and the mandatory-reporting obligation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Neuroblastoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish neuroblastoma (irregular, firm, midline-crossing abdominal mass, may arise anywhere along the sympathetic chain, associated with catecholamine metabolites and paraneoplastic opsoclonus-myoclonus) from Wilms tumour.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply suffix recognition reasoning for Common Drug Endings (Suffix-to-Class Recognition).
candidates.source_competency_text: Infer a drug's pharmacologic class from its name ending (e.g., -olol, -pril, -sartan, -statin, -azole, -caine, -mab) to anticipate its mechanism, indications, and class-typical adverse effects/interactions, while recognizing the chapter's documented exceptions (methimazole, itraconazole, nystatin).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Otitis Media with Effusion.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish OME (asymptomatic middle-ear effusion without acute infection) from AOM, and recognize persistent OME (>3 mo) as an indication for audiology referral given conductive hearing loss risk.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Acute Laryngotracheobronchitis (Croup).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the barky cough, hoarseness, and inspiratory stridor of croup, grade severity by the Westley score/clinical impression, and initiate dexamethasone +/- nebulized epinephrine for moderate-severe cases while reserving hospitalization for refractory or severe presentations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Testicular Tumour Recognition.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize testicular tumour presentation and arrange urgent diagnostic referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply drowning disposition reasoning for Non-Fatal Drowning / Submersion Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply symptom/oxygenation-based criteria to determine safe discharge vs. observation vs. ICU admission after non-fatal drowning.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply classification reasoning for Burn Injury Classification, Pathophysiology, and Severity Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify burn depth (superficial, partial-thickness, full-thickness) by clinical appearance and estimate extent conceptually (rule of nines / palmar surface).
candidates.study_unit: Burn Injury Classification, Pathophysiology, and Severity Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Rheumatoid arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize inflammatory symmetric polyarthritis and extra-articular features.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply uti pregnancy management reasoning for Urinary Tract Infection in Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize UTI and asymptomatic bacteriuria in pregnancy, apply routine screening, and select pregnancy-safe antibiotic therapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply capacity distinction reasoning for Framework for the Approach to the Older Adult (Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish clinical assessment of cognition/function from legal decision-making capacity, consent, and substitute decision-making, which remain the domain of ELOM pending final cross-chapter ownership resolution.
candidates.study_unit: Framework for the Approach to the Older Adult (Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Hip Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hip fracture (shortened, externally rotated leg, inability to weight-bear) in an elderly fall patient, obtain appropriate imaging (Garden classification for femoral neck fractures), and know that early surgical fixation (<48 h) improves outcomes for most patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply rosacea vs acne reasoning for Perioral Dermatitis and Rosacea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish rosacea from acne vulgaris (absence of comedones, central-face predilection, flushing) and from perioral dermatitis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Infective Endocarditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply modified Duke criteria conceptually (blood cultures, echocardiography).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ad diagnosis reasoning for Atopic Dermatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize atopic dermatitis by age-dependent distribution, chronic pruritic course, and associated atopic history (asthma, allergic rhinitis, filaggrin-related xerosis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply palliative principles reasoning for Principles of Palliative Care and End-of-Life Care Discussions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify patients who could benefit from a palliative approach to care and structure a goals-of-care/end-of-life discussion addressing physical, psychological, social, and spiritual needs.
candidates.study_unit: Principles of Palliative Care and End-of-Life Care Discussions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Bipolar Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize mood stabilizer pharmacotherapy as first-line and the risk of antidepressant-induced switch to mania if used without a mood stabilizer.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Limp in Children (Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply an age-stratified differential to the limping child (developmental dysplasia of the hip and toddler's fracture in the young child; transient synovitis and Legg-Calve-Perthes in the young school-age child; SCFE in the adolescent) and recognize septic arthritis as the diagnosis that must never be missed.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Mediastinitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute mediastinitis after esophageal/tracheal perforation, infection spread, or thoracic procedures.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hdp recognition reasoning for Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (Gestational Hypertension, Preeclampsia, Eclampsia, HELLP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose and stage hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, superimposed preeclampsia), recognize severe features and eclampsia/HELLP, and initiate urgent management.
candidates.study_unit: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (Gestational Hypertension, Preeclampsia, Eclampsia, HELLP)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply history exam reasoning for Preoperative Assessment (History, Investigations, ASA Classification).
candidates.source_competency_text: Elicit a focused anesthesia-relevant history (prior anesthetics/complications, NPO status, comorbidities, FMHx of MH/pseudocholinesterase deficiency, medications/allergies) and perform an airway-focused physical exam (Mallampati, 3-3-2 rule, thyromental distance).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Macrocytic Anemia: Vitamin B12 and Folate Deficiency.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish B12 from folate deficiency (elevated MMA and homocysteine in B12 deficiency vs. isolated elevated homocysteine in folate deficiency) and identify their major causes (pernicious anemia, malabsorption, dietary, medication-induced).
candidates.study_unit: Macrocytic Anemia: Vitamin B12 and Folate Deficiency

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and investigation reasoning for Urinary Tract Infection (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that infants/young children with UTI often present with fever alone rather than localizing urinary symptoms, apply appropriate urine-collection technique for diagnosis (catheterized sample in a non-toilet-trained child), and recognize indications for renal imaging after a febrile UTI (e.g. to evaluate for vesicoureteral reflux).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Mild Neurocognitive Disorder (Mild Cognitive Impairment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize MCI as cognitive decline with preserved independence in activities of daily living, and identify it as a risk state for progression to major neurocognitive disorder.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate innocent from pathologic murmurs.
candidates.study_unit: Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply perniosis recognition reasoning for Perniosis (Chilblains) and Traumatic/Mechanical Skin Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize perniosis (chilblains) by erythematous-to-violaceous acral lesions after cold, damp, non-freezing exposure and manage with warming/avoidance.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dh recognition reasoning for Dermatitis Herpetiformis and Porphyria Cutanea Tarda.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize dermatitis herpetiformis as the cutaneous marker of celiac disease and its dapsone/gluten-free-diet management.
candidates.study_unit: Dermatitis Herpetiformis and Porphyria Cutanea Tarda

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening recommendations reasoning for Cervical Cancer Screening Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply current periodic-health-examination screening recommendations for cervical cancer screening to a given patient's age/sex/risk profile, including when to start, stop, and how to interpret an abnormal result.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Metabolic Bone Disease Imaging (Osteoporosis/DEXA, Osteomalacia, Hyperparathyroidism, Paget's Disease).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize DEXA as the gold-standard screening/diagnostic tool for osteoporosis and interpret T-score thresholds for osteopenia and osteoporosis.
candidates.study_unit: Metabolic Bone Disease Imaging (Osteoporosis/DEXA, Osteomalacia, Hyperparathyroidism, Paget's Disease)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Recognition of Airspace and Parenchymal Lung Abnormalities (Atelectasis, Consolidation/Pneumonia, Pulmonary Nodule).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize atelectasis and consolidation on CXR (silhouette sign, air bronchograms) and correlate with the likely underlying pneumonia or obstructive etiology.
candidates.study_unit: Recognition of Airspace and Parenchymal Lung Abnormalities (Atelectasis, Consolidation/Pneumonia, Pulmonary Nodule)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Blood and Tissue Infections (Malaria, Trypanosoma cruzi, Toxoplasma gondii).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose malaria in a febrile returned traveller and recognize the need for urgent species identification and treatment.
candidates.study_unit: Blood and Tissue Infections (Malaria, Trypanosoma cruzi, Toxoplasma gondii)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Venous Thromboembolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use appropriate initial investigation, prevention, escalation, and referral principles.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply escalation logic reasoning for Pain and Symptom Management (WHO Pain Ladder, Table of Common Symptoms).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the WHO pain ladder's stepwise non-opioid to weak-opioid to strong-opioid escalation principle, distinguishing nociceptive from neuropathic and bony pain management categories.
candidates.study_unit: Pain and Symptom Management (WHO Pain Ladder, Table of Common Symptoms)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dm classification reasoning for Diabetes Mellitus: Classification and Diagnosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify diabetes mellitus by etiology (T1DM, T2DM, other specific causes, gestational) using clinical and genetic distinguishing features.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and management reasoning for Sexually Transmitted Infections (Gynecologic Presentation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common gynecologic STI presentations (chlamydia, gonorrhea, trichomoniasis), initiate appropriate testing and treatment, and address partner notification/reportability.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply incidence prevalence reasoning for Measures of Disease Occurrence and Age-Standardization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate and distinguish incidence rate from point and period prevalence, and explain why prevalence is a function of both incidence and disease duration.
candidates.study_unit: Measures of Disease Occurrence and Age-Standardization

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Depressive Disorders (Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder).
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate biopsychosocial management plan (pharmacotherapy, psychotherapy, safety planning) and recognize indications for escalation of care.
candidates.study_unit: Depressive Disorders (Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Malignant Bone Tumours (Primary and Metastatic).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize aggressive imaging features (periosteal reaction, cortical destruction, soft tissue mass) and red-flag history (night pain, weight loss, pain at rest) as suspicious for malignant bone tumour, warranting urgent referral and biopsy before any definitive treatment; recognize that in adults, metastatic disease is a far more common cause of a destructive bone lesion than a primary bone sarcoma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Skin Lesions and Masses: Differential Diagnosis and Surgical Management of Malignant Lesions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Generate a differential diagnosis for a skin lesion/mass and recognize features suggesting malignancy requiring surgical referral/excision.
candidates.study_unit: Skin Lesions and Masses: Differential Diagnosis and Surgical Management of Malignant Lesions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply thyroid surgical overview reasoning for Thyroid and Parathyroid (Surgical Overview).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for thyroidectomy/parathyroidectomy and major postoperative complications (recurrent laryngeal nerve injury, hypocalcemia).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pheo perioperative reasoning for Pheochromocytoma and Paraganglioma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the need for alpha-blockade before beta-blockade and before surgical resection to prevent hypertensive crisis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Phosphate and Magnesium Disorders: Hyperphosphatemia, Hypophosphatemia, Hypermagnesemia, and Hypomagnesemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize phosphate and magnesium disorders as complications of AKI/CKD and other conditions, and their characteristic clinical/ECG findings.
candidates.study_unit: Phosphate and Magnesium Disorders: Hyperphosphatemia, Hypophosphatemia, Hypermagnesemia, and Hypomagnesemia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Opportunistic Fungi (Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia, Cryptococcus, Candida, Aspergillus).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize CD4-threshold-based prophylaxis concepts for opportunistic infections (without encoding a specific current regimen).
candidates.study_unit: Opportunistic Fungi (Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia, Cryptococcus, Candida, Aspergillus)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anatomy application reasoning for Regional Anesthesia: Principles and Neuraxial (Epidural/Spinal) Technique.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply spinal/epidural anatomy (L3-L4/L4-L5 safe insertion level below the L1 cord terminus) to avoid neurologic injury during technique selection counseling.
candidates.study_unit: Regional Anesthesia: Principles and Neuraxial (Epidural/Spinal) Technique

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cruciate Ligament Tears (ACL/PCL).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the audible pop, immediate swelling (hemarthrosis), and giving-way history of an acute ACL tear, and distinguish it from PCL injury (posterior-directed force, e.g. dashboard injury) on mechanism and exam.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial workup reasoning for Sarcoidosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Choose appropriate initial imaging and laboratory assessment and identify organ involvement requiring urgent referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Acute Pericarditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the classic pleuritic, positional chest pain and ECG findings (diffuse ST elevation, PR depression) of acute pericarditis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening criteria reasoning for Screening Principles and Screening Biases.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Wilson-Jungner-type ideal screening criteria (disease burden, natural history understood, effective early treatment, acceptable/sensitive/cost-effective test) to judge whether a proposed screening program is appropriate.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Multiple Myeloma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize multiple myeloma via the CRAB criteria (hyperCalcemia, Renal failure, Anemia, Bone lesions) plus M-protein on serum/urine protein electrophoresis and elevated free light chains.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply peripheral nerve basics reasoning for Peripheral Nerves.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a peripheral nerve lesion pattern (single nerve distribution) as distinct from root/plexus/cord pathology.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply vte treatment reasoning for Venous Thromboembolism: DVT and Pulmonary Embolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select anticoagulation strategy (DOAC vs. LMWH) for confirmed VTE.
candidates.study_unit: Venous Thromboembolism: DVT and Pulmonary Embolism

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hcc recognition reasoning for Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize HCC as a complication of cirrhosis warranting surveillance (ultrasound +/- AFP) and identify features suggestive of HCC on imaging/labs.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply concussion reasoning for Concussion/Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose concussion/mild TBI, apply red-flag criteria for urgent imaging/referral, and counsel on graduated return-to-activity protocols.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Approach to Lymphadenopathy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Localize and characterize lymphadenopathy (generalized vs. localized, size, consistency, tenderness) and determine the need for biopsy vs. observation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and management reasoning for Necrotizing Enterocolitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize NEC (preterm infant with feeding intolerance, abdominal distension, bloody stools, pneumatosis intestinalis or portal venous gas on abdominal X-ray) and initial management (bowel rest, broad-spectrum antibiotics, surgical consultation for perforation/pneumoperitoneum).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Travel Medicine (General Travel Precautions, Fever in the Returned Traveller).
candidates.source_competency_text: Take a structured travel/exposure history and generate a differential for fever in the returned traveller (malaria, enteric fever, dengue, and other vector-borne illnesses).
candidates.study_unit: Travel Medicine (General Travel Precautions, Fever in the Returned Traveller)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pityriasis rosea reasoning for Papulosquamous Diseases: Lichen Planus and Pityriasis Rosea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pityriasis rosea by herald patch followed by a Christmas-tree-pattern truncal eruption and manage expectantly (self-limited).
candidates.study_unit: Papulosquamous Diseases: Lichen Planus and Pityriasis Rosea

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and response reasoning for Elder Abuse.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical findings suggestive of elder abuse (physical, psychological, financial, neglect), assess immediate risk, and outline an appropriate safety and reporting plan.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply renal clearance reasoning for Drug Excretion and Renal Elimination.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the renal clearance formula (filtration + secretion - reabsorption) to explain why renal impairment reduces clearance of renally-eliminated drugs, and recognize transporter-mediated excretion interactions (e.g., probenecid delaying penicillin excretion).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Primary and Normal-Tension Open-Angle Glaucoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize open-angle glaucoma as asymptomatic until advanced (peripheral field loss), requiring periodic IOP/optic-disc screening in at-risk patients, and know that normal-tension glaucoma can progress despite normal IOP.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Dyspnea (Cardiac Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select initial investigations (ECG, CXR, ABG, BNP where relevant).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Infective Endocarditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical features (fever, new murmur, embolic phenomena) suggesting infective endocarditis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Chemical Burns to the Eye.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ocular chemical exposure (especially alkali, which penetrates faster and deeper than acid) as requiring immediate copious irrigation before any other history, exam, or referral step, and know the litmus-paper/pH-neutralization endpoint for stopping irrigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diverticulitis management reasoning for Diverticulitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute diverticulitis, grade severity, and initiate appropriate management including identifying indications for urgent surgical intervention (e.g., perforation, abscess, obstruction).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Femoral Diaphysis Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize femoral shaft fracture (shortened, externally rotated leg, often open injury) as a high-energy trauma requiring hemodynamic assessment (large blood loss potential) and know to rule out an easily-missed ipsilateral femoral neck fracture.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply preop assessment reasoning for Preoperative Assessment and Preparation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform a preoperative risk assessment (cardiopulmonary, thromboembolic, medication-related) and identify strategies to minimize perioperative morbidity/mortality.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize JIA subtypes (oligoarticular -- most common, uveitis risk requiring ophthalmologic screening; polyarticular; systemic -- fever, rash, serositis) by joint-count pattern and systemic features, distinguishing from septic arthritis and other causes of childhood joint pain.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Specific Learning Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize specific learning disorder as a discrepancy between academic achievement and cognitive potential in a specific domain (reading, writing, math) despite adequate instruction, and the role of interdisciplinary educational assessment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply error types reasoning for Statistical Hypothesis Testing, Error Types, and Confidence Intervals.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish Type I (false-positive, alpha) from Type II (false-negative, beta) error and explain the relationship between power, sample size, and Type II error.
candidates.study_unit: Statistical Hypothesis Testing, Error Types, and Confidence Intervals

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Presbycusis (Age-Related Hearing Loss).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize presbycusis as the most common cause of sensorineural hearing loss in older adults and its downstream functional/social impact (communication, isolation, safety).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply immediate mgmt reasoning for Malignant Hyperthermia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate immediate MH management (stop triggering agent, dantrolene, cooling, treat hyperkalemia/dysrhythmia, avoid calcium channel blockers with dantrolene).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply central sensitization reasoning for Chronic Pain and Central Sensitization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize central sensitization/hyperalgesia as a distinct CNS-driven mechanism from ongoing nociceptive tissue damage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply htn emergency recognition reasoning for Hypertensive Emergencies (incl. Asymptomatic Severe Hypertension).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish hypertensive emergency (end-organ injury) from asymptomatic severe hypertension and select an appropriate IV agent when treatment is indicated.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply wound complications reasoning for Wound and Incisional Complications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize surgical site infection, wound dehiscence, and incisional hernia as postoperative wound complications and identify appropriate management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply asthma copd chronic mgmt reasoning for Asthma/COPD.
candidates.source_competency_text: Confirm the diagnosis and stage severity of asthma/COPD in a stable outpatient, and select guideline-based controller (maintenance) pharmacotherapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply amenorrhea reasoning for Amenorrhea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Evaluate a patient with amenorrhea in the primary-care setting, first ruling out pregnancy and then differentiating primary from secondary causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pertussis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pertussis by its catarrhal-paroxysmal-convalescent staged course (paroxysmal cough with inspiratory whoop; young infants may present with apnea rather than whoop) and its reportable, vaccine-preventable status.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Supraventricular Tachyarrhythmias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize atrial fibrillation/flutter and other SVTs on ECG.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ad stepwise management reasoning for Atopic Dermatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select management by severity using the stepwise ladder: emollients/trigger avoidance -> topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors -> systemic/biologic therapy for refractory disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hyperprolactinemia workup reasoning for Prolactin Disorders (Hyperprolactinemia and Prolactinoma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Investigate hyperprolactinemia (medication review, TSH, hCG, macroprolactin, MRI sella) and select dopamine-agonist therapy for prolactinoma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply counselling and referral reasoning for Termination of Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel a patient requesting termination of pregnancy on available options (medical vs. surgical), obtain appropriate informed consent, and initiate referral within the applicable gestational-age and access framework.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply exam technique reasoning for Neurological Examination (Mental Status, Cranial Nerve, Motor, Sensory, Coordination/Gait).
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform and correctly interpret each component of the bedside neurological exam (mental status, CN I-XII, tone/power/reflexes, primary sensory modalities, coordination and gait) as the shared physical-exam substrate for every focal-deficit presentation in this chapter.
candidates.study_unit: Neurological Examination (Mental Status, Cranial Nerve, Motor, Sensory, Coordination/Gait)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply unstable dysrhythmia reasoning for Cardiac Dysrhythmias (SVT, Atrial Fibrillation, Ventricular Tachydysrhythmias).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish stable from unstable dysrhythmias and select emergent cardioversion vs. rate/rhythm-control pharmacotherapy.
candidates.study_unit: Cardiac Dysrhythmias (SVT, Atrial Fibrillation, Ventricular Tachydysrhythmias)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply communication reasoning for End-of-Life Care.
candidates.source_competency_text: Discuss end-of-life options with patients and families.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Wound Classification and Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify wound type (laceration, puncture, crush, avulsion, abrasion) and assess for underlying tendon/nerve/vascular injury, contamination, and tetanus-immunization status prior to closure.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply foodborne pathogen recognition reasoning for Food-Borne Environmental Hazards.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a food source and clinical presentation, identify the likely biological food-borne contaminant (Salmonella, Campylobacter, E. coli O157:H7, Listeria, Clostridium botulinum, prion) from Table 12.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diverticular bleed recognition reasoning for Lower Gastrointestinal Bleeding (including Diverticular Bleeding).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize diverticulosis as the most common vascular cause of lower GI bleeding.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize VSD by size-dependent clinical course (small VSD: asymptomatic, spontaneous closure; moderate-to-large VSD: CHF by 2 mo, holosystolic murmur at LLSB with mid-diastolic apical rumble, risk of late pulmonary hypertension if untreated) and the indication for surgical closure by 1 yr in large defects.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply control and risk reasoning for Asthma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess symptom control, exacerbation risk, triggers, adherence, and inhaler technique.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for General Approach to Interstitial Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize an interstitial/restrictive presentation from progressive exertional dyspnea, dry cough, examination, imaging, and PFT findings.
candidates.study_unit: General Approach to Interstitial Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pericardial Effusion and Cardiac Tamponade.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical/echocardiographic signs of tamponade physiology (Beck's triad, pulsus paradoxus, echo findings).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply constipation diagnosis reasoning for Constipation (Adult).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause and severity of adult constipation and initiate an appropriate management plan.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Care of the Dying Patient (Predictors of Decline, Final Hours, Final-Days Care).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical predictors that a patient is entering the final months/hours of life (functional decline, comorbidity burden, sentinel events, Cheyne-Stokes breathing, terminal restlessness, mottling).
candidates.study_unit: Care of the Dying Patient (Predictors of Decline, Final Hours, Final-Days Care)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cluster recognition reasoning for Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the three personality-disorder clusters (A: odd/eccentric; B: dramatic/emotional/erratic; C: anxious/fearful) and their characteristic patterns, and differentiate personality disorder from an acute or comorbid Axis-I-type illness (e.g., Cluster A vs. schizophrenia by preserved thought organization and absence of sustained psychosis).
candidates.study_unit: Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Hodgkin and Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painless, progressive lymphadenopathy +/- B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) as suggestive of lymphoma and initiate excisional lymph node biopsy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply product selection reasoning for Blood Product Selection and Transfusion Indications.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select the appropriate blood product (packed RBCs, platelets, FFP, cryoprecipitate) and transfusion threshold for a given clinical scenario (e.g., restrictive vs. liberal RBC transfusion strategy).
candidates.study_unit: Blood Product Selection and Transfusion Indications

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dysphagia approach reasoning for Dysphagia (Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate oropharyngeal from esophageal dysphagia and initiate a management plan based on cause and severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Pediatric Enuresis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess enuresis for a medical cause and provide appropriate initial counselling/management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply communication reasoning for Confidentiality.
candidates.source_competency_text: Disclose information only with appropriate consent or legal authority.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lgib management reasoning for Lower Gastrointestinal Bleeding (including Diverticular Bleeding).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of lower GI bleeding, with attention to hemodynamic status and need for specialized care.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Myelodysplastic Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize MDS in an older adult with unexplained cytopenia(s) and dysplastic blood film/marrow findings, and recognize its risk of transformation to AML.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Chronic Stable Angina.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select appropriate outpatient investigation pathway (stress testing vs. angiography based on risk).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss (Otologic Emergency).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sudden (typically unilateral) hearing loss as an otologic emergency requiring urgent audiogram and ENT referral for empiric oral or intratympanic corticosteroids within 72 h, rather than watchful waiting.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Musculoskeletal Imaging Modality Selection, Approach to Bone X-Ray, and Fracture Description.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select plain film as the initial study for suspected fracture/dislocation, obtaining orthogonal views and imaging the joint above and below the injury, and recognize when CT is indicated for occult or complex intra-articular fractures.
candidates.study_unit: Musculoskeletal Imaging Modality Selection, Approach to Bone X-Ray, and Fracture Description

candidates.principal_decision: Apply efficacy potency reasoning for Pharmacodynamics: Dose-Response, Efficacy, Potency, and Therapeutic Index.

candidates.study_unit: Pharmacodynamics: Dose-Response, Efficacy, Potency, and Therapeutic Index

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Tibial Plateau Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize tibial plateau fracture as carrying risk of compartment syndrome and neurovascular injury (medial fractures especially), and know severe soft tissue injury may delay definitive ORIF.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cholecystitis management reasoning for Acute Cholecystitis (Calculous and Acalculous).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute cholecystitis (calculous and acalculous) and initiate appropriate management including timing of cholecystectomy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gcs assessment reasoning for Coma and Glasgow Coma Scale Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate and interpret the Glasgow Coma Scale and use it to grade severity and trend neurologic status.
candidates.study_unit: Coma and Glasgow Coma Scale Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply esophageal ca recognition reasoning for Esophageal Carcinoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize progressive dysphagia and other alarm features (weight loss, odynophagia) as suggestive of esophageal carcinoma and initiate urgent endoscopic investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply back pain approach reasoning for Approach to Limb/Back Pain.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a structured approach to limb/back pain distinguishing mechanical, radicular, and red-flag (cauda equina, infection, tumour, fracture) causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Fever (Pediatric, Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply age-stratified fever-without-source algorithms (a febrile neonate <28 d requires full septic workup and empiric antibiotics regardless of appearance; risk-stratify older infants) and recognize signs of serious bacterial illness.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply colorectal polyps reasoning for Colorectal Polyps.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize adenomatous polyps as premalignant lesions and identify appropriate screening/surveillance/removal principles.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Acute Abdominal "-itis" Imaging: Best Initial Modality for Cholecystitis, Appendicitis, Diverticulitis, and Pancreatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select the best initial imaging modality for suspected acute cholecystitis (U/S), acute appendicitis (U/S or CT depending on age/habitus), acute diverticulitis (CT), and acute pancreatitis (U/S for screening, CT for complications).
candidates.study_unit: Acute Abdominal "-itis" Imaging: Best Initial Modality for Cholecystitis, Appendicitis, Diverticulitis, and Pancreatitis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply vasa previa recognition reasoning for Vasa Previa.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painless vaginal bleeding after membrane rupture with fetal heart rate abnormality as suggestive of vasa previa requiring emergent delivery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for CNS Infections (Meningitis, Encephalitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize bacterial meningitis as a medical emergency and initiate empiric antibiotics without delay for imaging/LP when clinically indicated.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply consent reasoning for Preoperative Assessment (History, Investigations, ASA Classification).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that valid consent for the anesthetic plan is an explicit part of preoperative assessment, not a separate administrative step.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply technique selection reasoning for Skin Biopsy Types and Excisional Techniques.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select the appropriate biopsy technique (shave vs. punch vs. incisional vs. excisional) based on lesion characteristics and suspected diagnosis.
candidates.study_unit: Skin Biopsy Types and Excisional Techniques

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening recommendations reasoning for Colorectal Cancer Screening Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply current periodic-health-examination screening recommendations for colorectal cancer screening to a given patient's age/sex/risk profile, including when to start, stop, and how to interpret an abnormal result.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dress recognition reasoning for Drug Eruptions: Exanthematous Reaction and DRESS/DIHS.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize DRESS/DIHS as a can't-miss severe drug reaction (fever, morbilliform rash, facial edema, eosinophilia, internal organ involvement) requiring prompt drug discontinuation.
candidates.study_unit: Drug Eruptions: Exanthematous Reaction and DRESS/DIHS

candidates.principal_decision: Apply indications reasoning for Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for ECT (treatment-resistant depression, depression with psychotic/catatonic features, situations where medications are unsafe or rapid response is needed -- e.g., high suicide risk, pregnancy, severe dehydration/cachexia -- refractory catatonia, treatment-resistant schizophrenia or mania).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chorio recognition reasoning for Chorioamnionitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize intrapartum fever with chorioamnionitis and initiate antibiotics and expedited delivery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hazard recognition reasoning for Air, Water, and Soil Environmental Hazards.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given an environmental exposure scenario (e.g., contaminated well water, urban smog, contaminated soil near a former industrial site), identify the likely hazard category and associated health effect.
candidates.study_unit: Air, Water, and Soil Environmental Hazards

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Pleural Abnormalities (Pleural Effusion, Pneumothorax including Tension Pneumothorax, Asbestos-Related Disease).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the urgent management implications of tension pneumothorax identified on imaging (needle decompression, chest tube).
candidates.study_unit: Pleural Abnormalities (Pleural Effusion, Pneumothorax including Tension Pneumothorax, Asbestos-Related Disease)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply indications reasoning for Other Somatic Therapy Modalities (Phototherapy, Aerobic Exercise).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize phototherapy (bright light exposure) as first-line for seasonal affective disorder and adjunctive for non-seasonal depression, and aerobic exercise as an evidence-based monotherapy option for mild-moderate MDD and adjunct for moderate-severe MDD.
candidates.study_unit: Other Somatic Therapy Modalities (Phototherapy, Aerobic Exercise)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply counselling reasoning for Infertility.
candidates.source_competency_text: Explain the range of therapeutic options and appropriate referral for further reproductive investigation/treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply genodermatosis recognition reasoning for Heritable Genodermatoses (Ichthyosis Vulgaris, Epidermolysis Bullosa, Oculocutaneous Albinism).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ichthyosis vulgaris (fish-scale xerosis, filaggrin gene), epidermolysis bullosa (trauma-induced blistering from birth), and oculocutaneous albinism as classic inherited skin disorders.
candidates.study_unit: Heritable Genodermatoses (Ichthyosis Vulgaris, Epidermolysis Bullosa, Oculocutaneous Albinism)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize allergic rhinitis (nasal itch, watery rhinorrhea, sneezing, congested boggy turbinates, allergic conjunctivitis) and know intranasal corticosteroid is first-line treatment, with allergen avoidance and oral second-generation antihistamines as adjuncts.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Talar Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize talar fracture as a high-energy injury with significant avascular necrosis risk requiring prompt orthopedic referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lft interpretation reasoning for Investigations of Hepatobiliary Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret a pattern of abnormal liver enzymes (hepatocellular vs. cholestatic) to guide further hepatobiliary investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Abdominal CT Approach, Contrast Studies, and Bowel Obstruction/CT Colonography.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select appropriate contrast route (IV, oral, rectal) for abdominal CT based on clinical indication, and apply the 3-6-9 rule to identify bowel obstruction on CT.
candidates.study_unit: Abdominal CT Approach, Contrast Studies, and Bowel Obstruction/CT Colonography

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Ovarian Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the often-nonspecific presenting features of ovarian cancer (bloating, early satiety, pelvic pain, adnexal mass) and identify features suggesting malignancy vs. benign adnexal mass.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complication awareness reasoning for Breast Augmentation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize implant-related complications a generalist may encounter in follow-up (capsular contracture presentation, and awareness that breast implants carry a rare association with BIA-ALCL warranting referral for new peri-implant swelling/effusion).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Approach to a Neck Mass (DDx by Age, Evaluation).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the age-based rule of thumb (congenital <20, inflammatory 20-40, neoplastic >40) and lateral-vs-midline location to generate a differential for a neck mass, and recognize features (hard, fixed, >3 wk duration, associated B symptoms or mucosal lesion) that mandate urgent malignancy workup (FNA, panendoscopy) rather than a trial of antibiotics.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to a Neck Mass (DDx by Age, Evaluation)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial mgmt reasoning for Intraoperative Hypotension and Shock.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate first-line management for intraoperative hypotension based on the identified shock category.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Aortic Aneurysm.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize aneurysm presentations that suggest rupture or other emergency complication.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply acute management reasoning for Asthma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize and initially stabilize an acute severe exacerbation, including escalation when response is inadequate.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply angioedema urticaria reasoning for Angioedema, Urticaria, and Erythema Nodosum.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish hereditary from acquired angioedema, recognize laryngeal-edema risk requiring epinephrine, and classify urticaria as acute vs. chronic with appropriate investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Sleep-Wake Disorders (Overview, Sleep Hygiene, and DSM-5 Categories).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sleep hygiene and CBT for insomnia (CBTi) as first-line for chronic insomnia, and that non-benzodiazepine agents are generally preferred over benzodiazepines when pharmacotherapy is used.
candidates.study_unit: Sleep-Wake Disorders (Overview, Sleep Hygiene, and DSM-5 Categories)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply tinea versicolor reasoning for Superficial Yeast Infections (Candidiasis, Tinea Versicolor).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pityriasis (tinea) versicolor by hypo-/hyperpigmented scaling macules that fail to tan, and treat with topical/systemic antifungals.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Echocardiography and Advanced Cardiac Imaging.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for echocardiography (structural/functional assessment, valve disease, ejection fraction).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply aih recognition reasoning for Autoimmune Hepatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize autoimmune hepatitis as a cause of chronic hepatocellular liver disease, typically in a young woman with elevated autoantibodies, warranting immunosuppressive treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Skin Lesions and Masses: Differential Diagnosis and Surgical Management of Malignant Lesions.
candidates.source_competency_text: Understand that surgical excision is the primary management for malignant skin lesions and that margins are determined by lesion depth/type.
candidates.study_unit: Skin Lesions and Masses: Differential Diagnosis and Surgical Management of Malignant Lesions

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Amphetamine Use Disorder and Stimulant Intoxication.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic intoxication/withdrawal presentation and health consequences of this substance.
candidates.study_unit: Amphetamine Use Disorder and Stimulant Intoxication

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Local Anesthetic Systemic Toxicity (LAST).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize early (perioral tingling, tinnitus, metallic taste) and late (seizure, cardiac dysrhythmia/arrest) signs of local anesthetic systemic toxicity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply antisocial pd reasoning for Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize antisocial personality disorder requires a childhood-onset conduct disorder history and a minimum age of 18 for diagnosis.
candidates.study_unit: Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Reactive Arthritis (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize reactive arthritis as a post-infectious (GI or GU pathogen) asymmetric oligoarthritis, distinguishing it from septic arthritis by the absence of active joint infection.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk assessment reasoning for Pulmonary Embolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Estimate pretest probability using history, examination, and validated decision tools in appropriate patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply primary survey reasoning for Approach to Facial Trauma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply ABCs/primary-survey principles to a facial trauma patient, prioritizing airway control and identifying life-threatening associated injuries before detailed facial assessment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply routine surveillance reasoning for Subsequent Prenatal Visits.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the recommended content and schedule of subsequent prenatal visits (growth, BP, urine, fetal heart tones) across gestation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anticipatory guidance reasoning for Poison Prevention.
candidates.source_competency_text: Counsel caregivers on safe medication/chemical storage and poison-prevention strategies appropriate to a child's developmental stage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Chronic Stable Angina.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the classic presentation and risk-factor profile of stable angina.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply environmental history reasoning for Environmental Health Framework, Jurisdiction, and Risk Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Take a structured environmental exposure history using the CH2OPD2 mnemonic.
candidates.study_unit: Environmental Health Framework, Jurisdiction, and Risk Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply empiric antidotes reasoning for Altered Level of Consciousness / Coma (incl. Empiric Antidotes).
candidates.source_competency_text: Administer empiric antidotes (dextrose, oxygen, naloxone, thiamine) in undifferentiated coma.
candidates.study_unit: Altered Level of Consciousness / Coma (incl. Empiric Antidotes)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply macrovascular screening reasoning for Macrovascular Complications of Diabetes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize diabetes as a coronary artery disease risk-equivalent and screen for/manage macrovascular risk factors (blood pressure, lipids, smoking cessation, antiplatelet therapy where indicated).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lice recognition reasoning for Parasitic and Arthropod Skin Infestations (Scabies, Lice, Bed Bugs, Cutaneous Larva Migrans, Leishmaniasis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize scalp/pubic/body lice by nits and excoriations and select permethrin-based treatment with environmental decontamination.
candidates.study_unit: Parasitic and Arthropod Skin Infestations (Scabies, Lice, Bed Bugs, Cutaneous Larva Migrans, Leishmaniasis)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply reassurance reasoning for Benign Conjunctival/Subconjunctival Lesions (Pinguecula, Pterygium, Subconjunctival Hemorrhage).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize subconjunctival hemorrhage, pinguecula, and pterygium as benign, self-limited or slow-growing causes of red eye/eye surface change not requiring urgent referral (absent red-flag features).
candidates.study_unit: Benign Conjunctival/Subconjunctival Lesions (Pinguecula, Pterygium, Subconjunctival Hemorrhage)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply rash reasoning for Rash.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose common primary-care rash presentations and differentiate benign from urgent/serious causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cv risk stratification reasoning for Dyslipidemia and Cardiovascular Risk Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a validated cardiovascular risk calculator incorporating lipid levels to determine statin-therapy eligibility for primary prevention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fluid volume recognition reasoning for Polyhydramnios/Oligohydramnios.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize oligohydramnios and polyhydramnios on ultrasound and their principal associated maternal/fetal conditions.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chest tube indications reasoning for Tube Thoracostomy (Chest Tube Insertion).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify indications for tube thoracostomy (pneumothorax, hemothorax, empyema, complicated effusion) and recognize major complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply standardization reasoning for Measures of Disease Occurrence and Age-Standardization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Explain why age-standardization (direct or indirect) is needed to compare crude rates between populations with different age structures, and calculate/interpret a Standardized Mortality Ratio.
candidates.study_unit: Measures of Disease Occurrence and Age-Standardization

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Acute Kidney Injury: Classification, Prerenal/Renal/Postrenal Approach, and Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose AKI using the KDIGO staging criteria (serum creatinine change and urine output) and differentiate prerenal, intrinsic renal, and postrenal etiologies using history, urine microscopy, and FENa.
candidates.study_unit: Acute Kidney Injury: Classification, Prerenal/Renal/Postrenal Approach, and Management

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk stratification reasoning for Preoperative Assessment (History, Investigations, ASA Classification).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the ASA Physical Status classification to stratify perioperative risk and communicate it as a common clinical shorthand.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Nuclear Medicine Respiratory and Cardiac Imaging (V/Q Scan including Pregnancy Considerations, Myocardial Perfusion Scan, MUGA).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the general concept of myocardial perfusion scanning to distinguish reversible ischemia from fixed infarction.
candidates.study_unit: Nuclear Medicine Respiratory and Cardiac Imaging (V/Q Scan including Pregnancy Considerations, Myocardial Perfusion Scan, MUGA)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Hemophilia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hemophilia A (factor VIII deficiency) and B (factor IX deficiency) by isolated PTT prolongation with normal PT, X-linked inheritance, and deep joint/muscle bleeding pattern (hemarthrosis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cystic Kidney Diseases: Adult Polycystic Kidney Disease, Autosomal Recessive Polycystic Kidney Disease, and Medullary Sponge Kidney.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the presentation of ADPKD (family history, hematuria, flank pain, HTN, palpable kidneys, extrarenal manifestations) and its diagnostic confirmation by imaging, and distinguish it from ARPKD and medullary sponge kidney by inheritance pattern and age of presentation.
candidates.study_unit: Cystic Kidney Diseases: Adult Polycystic Kidney Disease, Autosomal Recessive Polycystic Kidney Disease, and Medullary Sponge Kidney

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with mild TBI/concussion, determine need for imaging/observation vs. hospitalization, counsel on post-concussive sequelae and return-to-play, and recognize red flags for repeat injury.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply systems tools reasoning for Quality Improvement Concepts and Systems Analysis Tools.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select an appropriate systems-analysis tool (5 Whys for root-cause exploration, Ishikawa/fishbone diagram for categorizing contributing factors, Pareto chart for prioritizing among many contributing factors) for a given quality problem.
candidates.study_unit: Quality Improvement Concepts and Systems Analysis Tools

candidates.principal_decision: Apply classification reasoning for Congenital Anomalies: Classification and Mechanisms.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate minor vs. major anomalies and classify an anomaly's mechanism (malformation, disruption, deformation, dysplasia), and distinguish an association from a sequence and a syndrome (e.g., VACTERL association, Potter sequence, CHARGE syndrome).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Venous Thromboembolism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize venous thrombosis risk and vascular-context presentations requiring assessment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of hyponatremia and hypernatremia using volume status assessment and urine/serum osmolality.
candidates.study_unit: Sodium Disorders: Hyponatremia, Hypernatremia, and Diabetes Insipidus

candidates.principal_decision: Apply absorption factors reasoning for Pharmacokinetics Overview and Drug Absorption.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify factors that alter drug absorption and bioavailability (lipophilicity, surface area, molecular size, ionization/pH, drug transporters) and their clinical consequences.

candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose pediatric IBS using Rome IV criteria after excluding organic red flags (weight loss, GI bleeding, nocturnal symptoms, family history of IBD/celiac).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hsv recognition reasoning for Herpes Simplex Virus and Herpes Zoster Virus Infections.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize primary vs. recurrent HSV-1/HSV-2 by distribution and select appropriate oral antiviral therapy.
candidates.study_unit: Herpes Simplex Virus and Herpes Zoster Virus Infections

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Intellectual Disability.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize intellectual disability as significant limitation in both intellectual functioning and adaptive behaviour with onset before 18 yr, distinct from isolated learning disorder.
