candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize laryngospasm as a post-extubation emergency and apply the stepwise treatment algorithm (suction -> remove airway/LMA -> CPAP with 100% O2 -> low-dose propofol/succinylcholine -> re-intubate if hypoxia persists).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Multiple Sclerosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize MS as episodic, anatomically-disseminated CNS demyelination (e.g., optic neuritis, sensory symptoms, ataxia) in a young adult, describe the relapsing-remitting vs. progressive clinical patterns, and outline the role of MRI/CSF in diagnosis and of disease-modifying therapy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply confounding reasoning for Bias and Confounding in Epidemiologic Studies.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish a confounder from a mediator, and identify randomization, stratification, matching, or regression modelling as methods to control confounding.
candidates.study_unit: Bias and Confounding in Epidemiologic Studies

candidates.principal_decision: Apply melanoma recognition reasoning for Malignant Melanoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the ABCDE criteria to recognize a mole with malignant features and initiate urgent biopsy/referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for COVID-19.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize COVID-19's clinical presentation and identify patients eligible for antiviral therapy based on risk factors for severe outcomes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ugib management reasoning for Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding (including Mallory-Weiss Tear).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause, severity, and complications of hematemesis or melena; determine and manage hemodynamic status and resuscitate as needed.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for ANCA-associated vasculitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a pulmonary-renal or systemic vasculitic presentation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pleural Abnormalities (Pleural Effusion, Pneumothorax including Tension Pneumothorax, Asbestos-Related Disease).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pneumothorax (including tension pneumothorax with mediastinal shift) on upright and supine chest imaging, and recognize pleural effusion, including which plain-film view is most sensitive for small effusions.
candidates.study_unit: Pleural Abnormalities (Pleural Effusion, Pneumothorax including Tension Pneumothorax, Asbestos-Related Disease)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anorectal abscess management reasoning for Anorectal Abscess.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize anorectal abscess and initiate urgent incision and drainage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply adequate intake reasoning for Nutrition (Infant Feeding, Breastfeeding/Formula, Signs of Adequate/Inadequate Intake).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply triage reasoning for Episcleritis versus Scleritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate episcleritis (mild, self-limited, blanches with phenylephrine) from scleritis (severe boring pain, does not blanch, associated systemic autoimmune disease, vision-threatening, urgent referral).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnostic criteria reasoning for Neurofibromatosis Type 2.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize NF2's predisposition to intracranial/spinal tumours and its diagnostic criteria centred on bilateral vestibular schwannomas, distinguishing it from NF1.

candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize proximal humeral fracture on exam/x-ray, assess axillary nerve function, and know most non-displaced fractures are managed non-operatively with early mobilization.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply qi terminology reasoning for Quality Improvement Concepts and Systems Analysis Tools.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish quality improvement, quality assurance, quality control, and total quality management by their focus (systems vs. individual/institutional performance vs. entire-system barriers).
candidates.study_unit: Quality Improvement Concepts and Systems Analysis Tools

candidates.study_unit: Drug Eruptions: Exanthematous Reaction and DRESS/DIHS

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cs anesthesia reasoning for Obstetrical Anesthesia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize neuraxial (spinal/epidural) as first-line for Caesarean section, with general anesthesia reserved for contraindications or time-critical delivery.

candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate croup, bacterial tracheitis, and epiglottitis by clinical presentation and select age/severity-appropriate management.
candidates.study_unit: Common Pediatric ED Presentations: Respiratory Distress (Croup, Bacterial Tracheitis, Epiglottitis)

candidates.study_unit: Arteriovenous Malformations, Cavernous Malformations, and Dural Arteriovenous Fistulas

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Polymyalgia rheumatica.

candidates.study_unit: Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Vascular Diseases of the Kidney: Renal Artery Stenosis, Thrombotic Microangiopathy, and Calcineurin Inhibitor Nephropathy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize renal artery stenosis, thrombotic microangiopathy (TTP-HUS spectrum), and calcineurin inhibitor nephropathy as vascular causes of renal dysfunction and their distinguishing investigations.
candidates.study_unit: Vascular Diseases of the Kidney: Renal Artery Stenosis, Thrombotic Microangiopathy, and Calcineurin Inhibitor Nephropathy

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lipid screening reasoning for Dyslipidemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply primary-care lipid-screening and cardiovascular-risk-based lipid-management thresholds (e.g., Framingham Risk Score-guided statin initiation) as part of periodic preventive care.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Sideroblastic Anemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sideroblastic anemia (ring sideroblasts on bone marrow, elevated ferritin, high transferrin saturation) and its major causes (hereditary, MDS-associated, alcohol, lead, isoniazid).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fde recognition reasoning for Fixed Drug Eruption and Photosensitivity Reaction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize fixed drug eruption by its hallmark recurrence at the same anatomic site on re-exposure to the causative drug.
candidates.study_unit: Fixed Drug Eruption and Photosensitivity Reaction

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Acute and Chronic Diarrhea (Pediatric, Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify pediatric diarrhea as acute (usually infectious/self-limited) vs. chronic (osmotic, secretory, inflammatory, or motility causes) and assess for dehydration as the primary complication to manage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypertension reasoning for Hypertension.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose hypertension per current diagnostic criteria, assess cardiac risk factors and target-organ damage, and initiate longitudinal primary-care management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Quadriceps/Patellar Tendon Rupture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize inability to perform straight leg raise plus a palpable gap as extensor mechanism rupture, and know complete ruptures require early surgical repair.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Pediatric Bladder and Bowel Dysfunction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize bladder/bowel dysfunction and its urinary complication context.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition and management reasoning for Diabetes Mellitus (Pediatric, Type 1 and Type 2).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize new-onset pediatric T1DM (polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss, DKA as a presenting emergency) versus T2DM (obesity-associated, often milder presentation), and outline initial DKA management principles (fluid resuscitation, insulin, electrolyte monitoring) and hypoglycemia recognition/treatment in an insulin-treated child.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply eligibility pathways reasoning for Medical Assistance in Dying (MAID).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish MAID Track 1 (natural death reasonably foreseeable) from Track 2 (serious and incurable illness/disease/disability, death not reasonably foreseeable) eligibility pathways.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome / Pre-Excitation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the WPW ECG pattern (short PR, delta wave).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply stabilization reasoning for Urologic Trauma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize renal, bladder and urethral injury; stabilize, investigate and refer urgently.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pediatric Thyroid Dysfunction (Hyperthyroidism and Hypothyroidism).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize congenital hypothyroidism as a newborn-screening priority (irreversible intellectual disability if treatment delayed) and distinguish it from acquired autoimmune hypothyroidism/Graves disease presenting later in childhood.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Pneumothorax and Tension Pneumothorax.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize spontaneous or traumatic pneumothorax and the clinical diagnosis of tension pneumothorax.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cystic Fibrosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize cystic fibrosis from recurrent respiratory infection, malabsorption, and characteristic diagnostic testing.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply symptom management reasoning for Symptom Management in Palliative Care.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select appropriate pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic management for common palliative-care symptoms (pain, dyspnea, nausea, delirium) with palliative intent.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Sexual Dysfunction.
candidates.source_competency_text: Address a patient's sexual dysfunction (e.g., dyspareunia, low desire, arousal or orgasmic disorder) in an unbiased, nonjudgmental way, identifying contributing physical and psychosocial factors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply trauma investigations reasoning for Approach to Trauma: Epidemiology and Primary/Secondary Survey.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select appropriate initial trauma investigations (labs, FAST, CT) based on mechanism and hemodynamic status.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Trauma: Epidemiology and Primary/Secondary Survey

candidates.principal_decision: Apply postop delirium reasoning for Postoperative Delirium.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize postoperative delirium, identify and treat reversible contributing causes, and apply nonpharmacologic prevention strategies.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Acute Pericarditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate anti-inflammatory therapy and recognize when to investigate for underlying cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Pelvic Inflammatory Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize long-term complications (infertility, chronic pelvic pain, ectopic pregnancy risk) as counselling points.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fluid interpretation reasoning for Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret basic pleural fluid results to identify infection, malignancy, and other important causes.
candidates.study_unit: Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pituitary adenoma reasoning for Pituitary Pathology: Adenoma and Hypopituitarism.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pituitary adenoma mass effects (bitemporal hemianopsia, headache) and hormone-excess syndromes (PRL, GH, ACTH), with definitive management cross-referenced to Neurosurgery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase Deficiency.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize G6PD deficiency as an X-linked cause of acute hemolysis triggered by oxidative stressors (infection, sulfa drugs, fava beans) and severe neonatal jaundice.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply labour staging reasoning for Four Stages of Labour.
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess and stage labour (first, second, third, fourth stages) and recognize normal progression.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply siadh vs csw reasoning for Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate SIADH from cerebral salt wasting using volume status, the key distinguishing feature (euvolemic vs. hypovolemic).
candidates.study_unit: Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Eye Movement Disorders (Internuclear Ophthalmoplegia, Diplopia, Nystagmus).
candidates.source_competency_text: Given diplopia, nystagmus, or a specific eye-movement abnormality (e.g., failure of adduction on lateral gaze), determine whether it is monocular or binocular, localize the lesion (e.g., MLF for INO), and identify the likely cause.
candidates.study_unit: Eye Movement Disorders (Internuclear Ophthalmoplegia, Diplopia, Nystagmus)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply classification reasoning for Approach to Congenital Heart Disease (Epidemiology, Cyanotic vs. Acyanotic Classification, Initial Investigations).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the cyanotic-vs-acyanotic (L-to-R shunt/obstruction beyond lungs vs. R-to-L shunt/mixing) physiologic framework and initial investigations (echo, ECG, CXR, pre-/post-ductal saturations, 4-limb BPs, hyperoxia test) to a newly suspected congenital heart lesion.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Congenital Heart Disease (Epidemiology, Cyanotic vs. Acyanotic Classification, Initial Investigations)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypoxemia mechanism reasoning for Arterial Blood Gases, Acid-Base Status, and Hypoxemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use the A-a gradient and response to oxygen conceptually to distinguish hypoventilation, V/Q mismatch, diffusion impairment, and shunt.
candidates.study_unit: Arterial Blood Gases, Acid-Base Status, and Hypoxemia

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Erysipelas and Cellulitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate empiric antibiotic therapy and recognize when IV therapy or admission is warranted.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gbs management reasoning for Early-Onset Group B Streptococcus Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply antenatal GBS screening and recognize indications for intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis to prevent early-onset neonatal GBS disease.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Adverse Drug Reactions: Classification and Clinical Approach.
candidates.source_competency_text: Take a structured history (timing, de-challenge/re-challenge, complete medication history including OTC/natural health products) to evaluate a suspected ADR and distinguish drug effect from underlying disease.
candidates.study_unit: Adverse Drug Reactions: Classification and Clinical Approach

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for White Blood Cell Count Abnormalities (Neutrophilia, Neutropenia, Lymphocytosis, Lymphopenia, Eosinophilia, Agranulocytosis, Leukemoid Reaction).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize febrile neutropenia as a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics, distinct from non-urgent WBC abnormalities.
candidates.study_unit: White Blood Cell Count Abnormalities (Neutrophilia, Neutropenia, Lymphocytosis, Lymphopenia, Eosinophilia, Agranulocytosis, Leukemoid Reaction)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply contraindications reasoning for Regional Anesthesia: Principles and Neuraxial (Epidural/Spinal) Technique.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize absolute (coagulopathy, infection at site, severe hypovolemia, patient refusal, fixed-output cardiac lesions) and relative contraindications to neuraxial anesthesia.
candidates.study_unit: Regional Anesthesia: Principles and Neuraxial (Epidural/Spinal) Technique

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Acute Coronary Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize STEMI/NSTEMI/unstable angina presentations and ECG patterns.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Arthritis of the Hip.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate osteoarthritis (activity-related pain, LOSS x-ray findings) from inflammatory arthritis of the hip (morning stiffness, systemic findings), and know non-operative management precedes arthroplasty.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Congenital Talipes Equinovarus (Club Foot).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize club foot on newborn exam (rigid equinus, varus, adduction deformity) and know first-line treatment is serial casting (Ponseti method) initiated shortly after birth.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply exposure history reasoning for Asbestos-Related Pleural Disease and Mesothelioma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Elicit asbestos exposure and latency and recognize benign pleural disease versus features concerning for mesothelioma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnostic criteria reasoning for Neurofibromatosis Type 1.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply NF1 diagnostic criteria (2 or more of: >6 cafe-au-lait spots, 2+ neurofibromas or 1 plexiform neurofibroma, 2+ Lisch nodules, optic glioma, axillary/inguinal freckling, a distinctive bony lesion, or an affected first-degree relative) and recognize associated learning disorders/seizures.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply endocrine paraneoplastic recognition reasoning for Endocrine Paraneoplastic Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the endocrine paraneoplastic syndromes (ectopic ACTH/Cushing's, SIADH, PTHrP-mediated hypercalcemia, insulin/IGF2-mediated hypoglycemia) and their associated malignancies (small cell lung cancer prominently) as a cause-to-investigate when a patient presents with the corresponding electrolyte/hormonal abnormality.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Mumps.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize mumps (bilateral parotid swelling, low vaccine-preventable incidence given MMR coverage) and its complications (orchitis, aseptic meningitis, pancreatitis).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply opioid safety reasoning for Acute Pain Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize opioid side effects (respiratory depression, sedation, constipation) and select/monitor patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) dosing safely, including recognizing and treating opioid overdose with naloxone.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Respiratory Distress in the Newborn (RDS, TTN, Meconium Aspiration).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate RDS (preterm, surfactant deficiency, ground-glass CXR, responds to surfactant/CPAP), transient tachypnea of the newborn (term/near-term, C-section or rapid delivery, self-limited retained-fetal-lung-fluid), and meconium aspiration syndrome (post-term, meconium-stained fluid, patchy infiltrates, risk of PPHN).
candidates.study_unit: Respiratory Distress in the Newborn (RDS, TTN, Meconium Aspiration)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Drug- and Treatment-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize medication or radiation exposure as a potential cause of new interstitial respiratory symptoms and imaging abnormalities.
candidates.study_unit: Drug- and Treatment-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Nuclear Medicine Brain Imaging (SPECT/PET for Dementia, Traumatic Brain Injury, Seizure Focus Localization).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that SPECT/PET brain imaging has a role as an adjunct in atypical dementia workup and epileptic-focus localization, without needing specific radiotracer uptake-pattern detail.
candidates.study_unit: Nuclear Medicine Brain Imaging (SPECT/PET for Dementia, Traumatic Brain Injury, Seizure Focus Localization)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply risk assessment steps reasoning for Environmental Health Framework, Jurisdiction, and Risk Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the four-step Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment framework (hazard identification, dose-response, exposure assessment, risk characterization) to an environmental exposure scenario.
candidates.study_unit: Environmental Health Framework, Jurisdiction, and Risk Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Aortic Dissection.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize a presentation concerning for aortic dissection and major ischemic or rupture complications.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Treat the underlying cause and identify indications for drainage, admission, or thoracic consultation.
candidates.study_unit: Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema

candidates.principal_decision: Apply abscess management reasoning for Bacterial Skin and Soft Tissue Infections (Impetigo, Erysipelas, Cellulitis, Folliculitis/Furuncle/Carbuncle, Skin Abscess).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize skin abscess and determine when incision-and-drainage alone suffices versus when adjunctive antibiotics are indicated.
candidates.study_unit: Bacterial Skin and Soft Tissue Infections (Impetigo, Erysipelas, Cellulitis, Folliculitis/Furuncle/Carbuncle, Skin Abscess)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply longitudinal management reasoning for Asthma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Develop an individualized controller and prevention plan with follow-up.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Acute Abdominal Pain (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply an age-stratified differential to acute pediatric abdominal pain (e.g. intussusception/malrotation in infants, appendicitis/mesenteric adenitis in older children) and recognize surgical-emergency red flags (peritoneal signs, bilious vomiting, hemodynamic instability).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose ITP as a diagnosis of exclusion in a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia and mucocutaneous bleeding, distinguishing primary from secondary (drug-induced, lymphoproliferative, autoimmune-associated) ITP.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypercalcemia workup reasoning for Hypercalcemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause of hypercalcemia (primary hyperparathyroidism vs. malignancy-associated most commonly) using PTH level as the initial discriminating test.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Disorders of Calcium Homeostasis (Hypercalcemia, Hypocalcemia, Rickets).
candidates.source_competency_text: Use the PTH/vitamin D axis to work up hyper- and hypocalcemia, and recognize rickets (bowing deformity, widened wrists/costochondral junctions, delayed fontanelle closure) as the pediatric skeletal manifestation of chronic vitamin D deficiency or renal osteodystrophy.
candidates.study_unit: Disorders of Calcium Homeostasis (Hypercalcemia, Hypocalcemia, Rickets)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Acute Otitis Media.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose AOM by bulging tympanic membrane with acute onset of signs/symptoms, and apply watchful-waiting vs. antibiotic-treatment criteria by age and severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Tetralogy of Fallot.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Tetralogy of Fallot's four components (VSD, right ventricular outflow tract obstruction, overriding aorta, RVH), boot-shaped heart on CXR, and hypercyanotic spell management (knee-to-chest positioning, oxygen, morphine, fluids).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply likelihood ratios reasoning for Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios).
candidates.source_competency_text: Use a likelihood ratio and a Fagan nomogram (or the odds form) to convert a pre-test probability into a post-test probability given a test result.
candidates.study_unit: Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency recognition reasoning for Peripheral Neuropathies: Classification and Guillain-Barré Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute ascending, symmetric weakness with areflexia (± antecedent infection) as GBS, initiate urgent monitoring for respiratory/autonomic failure, and classify peripheral neuropathies by distribution and fibre type (axonal vs. demyelinating).
candidates.study_unit: Peripheral Neuropathies: Classification and Guillain-Barré Syndrome

candidates.principal_decision: Apply indications reasoning for Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize rTMS as a noninvasive option with strong evidence for treatment-resistant depression, less effective than ECT for depression but with a more favourable adverse-effect profile (no anesthesia, no memory loss).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply augmentation decision reasoning for Augmentation of Labour.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for labour augmentation (e.g., inadequate contractions) and outline the oxytocin-based approach.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply loading dose reasoning for Pharmacokinetic Parameters and Dosing Strategy (Half-Life, Clearance, Steady-State, Loading/Maintenance Dosing).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize when a loading dose is indicated (long half-life and/or need for rapid therapeutic effect, e.g., amiodarone, digoxin, phenytoin) vs. when maintenance dosing alone suffices.
candidates.study_unit: Pharmacokinetic Parameters and Dosing Strategy (Half-Life, Clearance, Steady-State, Loading/Maintenance Dosing)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply mtbi disposition reasoning for Head Trauma and Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
candidates.source_competency_text: Determine safe ED disposition (discharge vs. observation) for mild traumatic brain injury.
candidates.study_unit: Head Trauma and Mild Traumatic Brain Injury

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigate reasoning for Rheumatoid arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use appropriate initial inflammatory and serologic testing.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply icp recognition reasoning for Intracranial Pressure Dynamics (ICP/Volume Relationship, Cerebral Blood Flow, ICP Measurement, Elevated ICP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with signs of elevated ICP (Cushing's triad, papilledema, declining GCS), recognize the physiologic basis and initiate urgent assessment.
candidates.study_unit: Intracranial Pressure Dynamics (ICP/Volume Relationship, Cerebral Blood Flow, ICP Measurement, Elevated ICP)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply episode recognition reasoning for Mood Episodes (Major Depressive, Manic, Hypomanic, Mixed).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish major depressive, manic, hypomanic, and mixed mood episodes by their defining symptom/duration criteria, and recognize that a careful history (including ruling out substance/medical causes) is required before attributing an episode to a primary mood disorder.
candidates.study_unit: Mood Episodes (Major Depressive, Manic, Hypomanic, Mixed)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply receptor mapping reasoning for Autonomic Nervous System Physiology and Pharmacology.
candidates.source_competency_text: Match an autonomic receptor subtype (beta1, beta2, alpha1, alpha2, M1, M2, M3) to its organ location and physiologic effect (e.g., beta1 -> increased cardiac contractility/HR; beta2 -> bronchodilation; M3 -> sweat gland stimulation) to predict the effect of a drug acting at that receptor.
candidates.study_unit: Autonomic Nervous System Physiology and Pharmacology

candidates.principal_decision: Apply liver abscess management reasoning for Liver Abscesses.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pyogenic and amebic liver abscess and initiate appropriate investigation (imaging, drainage) and management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Acoustic Neuroma (Vestibular Schwannoma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize unilateral progressive SNHL and/or unilateral tinnitus in an adult as acoustic neuroma until proven otherwise, and order gadolinium-enhanced MRI of the internal auditory canal rather than reassurance or routine audiogram alone.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for von Willebrand Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize desmopressin (DDAVP) and vWF-containing factor concentrates as management options.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for HIV Testing, Pre/Post-Test Counselling, and Prevention (PrEP/PEP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for and general concept of pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), without encoding a specific current regimen.
candidates.study_unit: HIV Testing, Pre/Post-Test Counselling, and Prevention (PrEP/PEP)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lichen planus reasoning for Papulosquamous Diseases: Lichen Planus and Pityriasis Rosea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lichen planus by the '6 Ps' morphology and Wickham's striae, and know its association with hepatitis C.
candidates.study_unit: Papulosquamous Diseases: Lichen Planus and Pityriasis Rosea

candidates.principal_decision: Apply legal professional action reasoning for Legal Foundation of Canadian Healthcare.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify which level of government/legal authority (federal vs. provincial/territorial) governs a given healthcare legal question.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply borderline pd safety reasoning for Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize borderline personality disorder's markedly elevated suicide risk and self-harm behaviour, and that dialectical behavioural therapy (DBT) is the principal evidence-based treatment.
candidates.study_unit: Personality Disorders (Clusters A, B, and C)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply low back pain reasoning for Low Back Pain.
candidates.source_competency_text: Evaluate low back pain, apply red-flag criteria for urgent imaging/referral, and initiate conservative first-line management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply myxedema coma reasoning for Myxedema Coma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize myxedema coma (altered mental status, hypothermia, bradycardia in a hypothyroid patient) and initiate emergency IV levothyroxine and stress-dose steroids.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply electrolyte emergency recognition reasoning for Electrolyte Disturbances (ED Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ED-relevant electrolyte emergencies (severe hyperkalemia, hyponatremia) and initiate first-line stabilization.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply depth of anesthesia reasoning for Patient Monitoring (Intraoperative Standards).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify signs of inadequate (HTN, tachycardia, tearing) vs. excessive (hypotension, bradycardia) anesthetic depth from routine monitor trends.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Seizure and Status Epilepticus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Given a patient with a seizure, differentiate seizure from non-seizure mimics, classify seizure type, identify triggers/underlying causes, and manage both routine and emergent (status epilepticus) presentations, including counselling on driving restrictions.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply surveillance types reasoning for Disease Prevention: Natural History, Surveillance, and Levels of Prevention.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish passive, active, and sentinel surveillance by resource intensity and appropriate use case.
candidates.study_unit: Disease Prevention: Natural History, Surveillance, and Levels of Prevention

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Cardiomyopathies (Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate dilated, hypertrophic, and restrictive cardiomyopathy by history, exam, and echocardiographic findings.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply mallory weiss recognition reasoning for Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding (including Mallory-Weiss Tear).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Mallory-Weiss tear (post-retching mucosal laceration) as a traumatic cause of upper GI bleeding.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Physeal Injury (Salter-Harris Classification).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize physeal (growth plate) injury and know higher Salter-Harris grades carry increasing risk of growth arrest/limb-length discrepancy, warranting orthopedic referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply malpresentation management reasoning for Fetal Malpresentation including Breech Presentation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize fetal malpresentation (including breech) on exam/ultrasound and outline mode-of-delivery options (external cephalic version, vaginal breech candidacy, Caesarean).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Pharyngitis (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish viral from group A streptococcal pharyngitis using clinical scoring and rapid antigen/throat culture testing, and recognize the rationale for antibiotic treatment of GAS pharyngitis (rheumatic fever prevention).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Lower Limb (Venous, Arterial, and Diabetic) Ulcers.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate venous, arterial, and diabetic/neuropathic ulcers by location, appearance, and associated findings; recognize need for vascular workup.
candidates.study_unit: Lower Limb (Venous, Arterial, and Diabetic) Ulcers

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diabetic retinopathy reasoning for Microvascular Complications of Diabetes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the need for regular ophthalmologic screening in diabetes to detect retinopathy before vision loss.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply postop fever ddx reasoning for Postoperative Fever.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a systematic timeline-based differential (wind, water, walking, wound, wonder drugs) to postoperative fever and identify when further investigation/intervention is required.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply termination reasoning for Autonomic Nervous System Physiology and Pharmacology.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the mechanisms terminating ACh (acetylcholinesterase/pseudocholinesterase) and NE (reuptake, MAO, COMT) action, and apply this to acetylcholinesterase-inhibitor use (myasthenia gravis, Alzheimer's disease).
candidates.study_unit: Autonomic Nervous System Physiology and Pharmacology

candidates.principal_decision: Apply primary dyslipidemia recognition reasoning for Primary (Genetic) Dyslipidemias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize rare monogenic dyslipidemias (e.g. familial hypercholesterolemia, familial combined hyperlipidemia) and their distinguishing features from common secondary dyslipidemia.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply common cold reasoning for Common Cold (Acute Rhinitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the common cold as a self-limited viral cause of rhinorrhea and provide appropriate symptomatic-management counselling.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening recommendations reasoning for Prostate Cancer Screening Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply current periodic-health-examination screening recommendations for prostate cancer screening to a given patient's age/sex/risk profile, including when to start, stop, and how to interpret an abnormal result.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply subacute thyroiditis reasoning for Subacute Thyroiditis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize subacute (de Quervain's) thyroiditis by painful goitre following a viral illness and its triphasic course (thyrotoxic, hypothyroid, recovery).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cushing management reasoning for Cushing's Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish exogenous (iatrogenic glucocorticoid) from endogenous Cushing's syndrome as the first diagnostic step, given its much higher prevalence.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply determinants framework reasoning for Concepts of Health, Health Equity, and Cultural Safety.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the social determinants of health / population health model to explain why two patients with the same disease may have different health outcomes.
candidates.study_unit: Concepts of Health, Health Equity, and Cultural Safety

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Tuberculosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize RIPE first-line therapy and the clinical indicators of MDR/XDR-TB requiring specialist referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply gynecomastia workup reasoning for Gynecomastia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the gynecomastia investigation algorithm (hCG, LH, testosterone, estradiol, thyroid function) to distinguish physiologic from pathologic causes, and select observation vs. medical vs. surgical management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening recommendations reasoning for Lung Cancer Screening Guidelines.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply current periodic-health-examination screening recommendations for lung cancer screening to a given patient's age/sex/risk profile, including when to start, stop, and how to interpret an abnormal result.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply macrosomia recognition reasoning for Macrosomia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize risk factors and clinical/sonographic suspicion for fetal macrosomia and its implications for mode/timing of delivery (e.g., shoulder dystocia risk).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lipoma recognition reasoning for Lipoma and Xanthoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize lipoma as a soft, mobile, non-tender subcutaneous mass requiring no treatment unless symptomatic or diagnostically uncertain.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply heme endo reasoning for Preoperative Hematologic and Endocrine Optimization.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize which hematologic (anemia, anticoagulation, factor deficiency) and endocrine (diabetes type/control) findings require preoperative correction or medication adjustment before elective surgery.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prediabetes dx reasoning for Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance / Impaired Fasting Glucose).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (IFG, IGT, A1c) to diagnose pre-diabetes and counsel on lifestyle modification/metformin to reduce progression to diabetes.
candidates.study_unit: Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance / Impaired Fasting Glucose)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Early Pregnancy Loss and First-Trimester Bleeding.
candidates.source_competency_text: Evaluate first-trimester bleeding to determine pregnancy viability and classify the type of spontaneous abortion (threatened, inevitable, incomplete, complete, missed).
candidates.study_unit: Early Pregnancy Loss and First-Trimester Bleeding

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dka hhs mgmt reasoning for Diabetic Emergencies (DKA and HHS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish DKA from HHS on clinical/lab features and initiate appropriate fluid/insulin resuscitation, including timing of dextrose/potassium repletion.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply burden measures reasoning for Measures of Mortality and Disease Burden.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish PYLL (weights early death more heavily), DALY (premature death + disability, 0=perfect health/1=death), and QALY (quality-weighted life years, 0=death/1=perfect health, used in economic evaluation) and identify appropriate use cases for each.
candidates.study_unit: Measures of Mortality and Disease Burden

candidates.principal_decision: Apply primary aldosteronism reasoning for Mineralocorticoid Excess Syndromes (Primary Aldosteronism).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize primary aldosteronism (Conn's syndrome) as a cause of resistant hypertension with hypokalemia, and apply the aldosterone-renin ratio screening test.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ladder reasoning for Acute Pain Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the WHO analgesia ladder and select acetaminophen/NSAID/opioid appropriately by pain severity and patient comorbidity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply fistula in ano reasoning for Fistula-in-Ano.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize fistula-in-ano as a common sequela of anorectal abscess and identify general management principles.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dose limits reasoning for Opioid Therapy for Chronic Non-Cancer Pain.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Canadian guideline dose thresholds (<90 MME/day, ideally <50 MME/day at initiation) and recognize when a slow, collaborative taper is indicated (>=90 MME/day).
candidates.study_unit: Opioid Therapy for Chronic Non-Cancer Pain

candidates.principal_decision: Apply semiology reasoning for Signs and Symptoms of Movement Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Classify an observed abnormal movement as hyperkinetic (tremor, chorea, dystonia, tics, myoclonus) or hypokinetic (bradykinesia, rigidity) and describe it accurately.
candidates.study_unit: Signs and Symptoms of Movement Disorders

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Common Respiratory Presentations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Construct a focused differential for dyspnea, cough, chest pain, and hemoptysis using acuity and key clinical features.
candidates.study_unit: Differential Diagnosis of Common Respiratory Presentations

candidates.principal_decision: Apply route selection reasoning for Drug Administration: Routes and Selection.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select an appropriate route of drug administration given patient status (NPO, vomiting, unconscious, requires rapid onset, requires avoidance of first-pass metabolism) and recognize each route's principal risks (e.g., infection/extravasation for IV, erratic absorption for IM/SC, CSF leak for intrathecal).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hhs vs dka reasoning for Acute Complications of Diabetes (DKA, HHS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state from DKA by degree of ketosis/acidosis and typical patient population.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply osteoporosis management reasoning for Osteoporosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select first-line pharmacotherapy (bisphosphonates) for osteoporosis and counsel on calcium/vitamin D and lifestyle measures.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply critical appraisal reasoning for Critical Appraisal and Levels of Evidence.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply the three-question critical appraisal framework (Are the results valid? What are the results? Will the results help my patient?) to a piece of clinical evidence.
candidates.study_unit: Critical Appraisal and Levels of Evidence

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Nephritic Syndrome (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize nephritic syndrome (hematuria with red cell casts, hypertension, oliguria, mild proteinuria) and the classic pediatric cause (post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis, typically 1-2 wk after streptococcal pharyngitis or skin infection).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Scoliosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Screen for scoliosis using the Adam's forward bend test, recognize red flags (pain, rapid progression, neurologic symptoms) warranting further workup versus typical adolescent idiopathic scoliosis managed with observation/bracing based on curve magnitude.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Vestibular Neuronitis (Labyrinthitis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish vestibular neuronitis (no hearing loss) from labyrinthitis (tinnitus and hearing loss present) after a viral prodrome, and know management is supportive (vestibular suppressants short-term, then vestibular rehabilitation exercises).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Ocular Manifestations of Diabetes Mellitus (Diabetic Retinopathy).
candidates.source_competency_text: Know the recommended dilated-fundus screening interval for diabetic patients and recognize proliferative retinopathy/macular edema as requiring urgent ophthalmology referral.
candidates.study_unit: Ocular Manifestations of Diabetes Mellitus (Diabetic Retinopathy)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ethical reasoning reasoning for Clinical Informatics and Digital Health Ethics.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize ethical considerations in digital health technology use (e.g., AI-assisted decision-making, EHR privacy).
candidates.study_unit: Clinical Informatics and Digital Health Ethics

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypoglycemia workup reasoning for Hypoglycemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply Whipple's triad and a supervised fast/mixed-meal test with insulin, C-peptide, and proinsulin to distinguish endogenous hyperinsulinism (insulinoma) from exogenous causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply abruption recognition reasoning for Placental Abruption.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painful antepartum bleeding with placental abruption, assess maternal/fetal severity, and initiate urgent management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Posterior Vitreous Detachment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize PVD as usually benign but requiring dilated fundus exam to exclude a retinal tear.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply assessment reasoning for Urologic Urinary Infection and Inflammation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose common urologic infection/inflammation, identify severe or complicated disease and arrange initial management/referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply lesion description reasoning for Approach to Skin Lesions: Morphology, Distribution, and Differential Diagnosis of Common Presentations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Describe a skin lesion using standard morphologic terms (macule, papule, plaque, vesicle, bulla, pustule, wheal, etc.) and distribution/pattern descriptors.
candidates.study_unit: Approach to Skin Lesions: Morphology, Distribution, and Differential Diagnosis of Common Presentations

candidates.principal_decision: Apply emergency reasoning for Giant Cell (Temporal) Arteritis -- Ocular Manifestations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize GCA red flags (age >50, new headache, jaw claudication, scalp tenderness, sudden vision loss) as requiring immediate empiric high-dose corticosteroids and urgent ESR/CRP plus temporal artery biopsy to prevent irreversible bilateral blindness.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cat Scratch Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize cat scratch disease (Bartonella henselae) in a patient with regional lymphadenopathy and a history of cat scratch/bite exposure, including disseminated presentations in advanced HIV.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply referral reasoning for Ovarian Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate appropriate investigation (imaging, tumour markers) and recognize indications for gynecologic-oncology referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply dyspnea primary care reasoning for Dyspnea.
candidates.source_competency_text: Evaluate dyspnea in the primary-care setting, identifying patients requiring urgent referral versus those manageable with outpatient workup.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Care of the Dying Patient (Predictors of Decline, Final Hours, Final-Days Care).
candidates.source_competency_text: Plan appropriate final-days care, including non-oral medication routes when swallowing is unsafe and discontinuing non-essential medications.
candidates.study_unit: Care of the Dying Patient (Predictors of Decline, Final Hours, Final-Days Care)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Pediatric Abdominal Mass.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply an age-appropriate pediatric abdominal-mass differential (Wilms tumour, neuroblastoma, hydronephrosis, intussusception) and recognize features (crossing midline vs. not, associated hypertension/hematuria) that help localize the cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Treat the precipitating cause, initiate lung-protective supportive care principles, and involve critical care early.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply multidimensional assessment reasoning for Framework for the Approach to the Older Adult (Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment).
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply a structured, multidimensional approach (function, cognition, mobility, mood, social supports, medications) to the assessment of an older adult, distinct from a single-system history and physical.
candidates.study_unit: Framework for the Approach to the Older Adult (Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Major or Mild Neurocognitive Disorder (Dementia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish major from mild neurocognitive disorder by degree of functional independence, and delirium from dementia by acuity/course/attention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Acute Otitis Media and Otitis Media with Effusion (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose AOM (bulging/erythematous TM with acute symptoms) vs. OME (effusion without acute infection), apply watchful-waiting vs. immediate-antibiotic criteria by age and severity, and recognize predisposing anatomic/craniofacial risk factors for recurrent AOM.
candidates.study_unit: Acute Otitis Media and Otitis Media with Effusion (Pediatric)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize febrile neutropenia as an oncologic emergency requiring urgent empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics.
candidates.study_unit: Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pleural effusion clinically and radiographically and distinguish likely transudative from exudative causes.
candidates.study_unit: Pleural Effusion, Parapneumonic Effusion, and Empyema

candidates.principal_decision: Apply chronic pancreatitis recognition reasoning for Chronic Pancreatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize chronic pancreatitis (recurrent epigastric pain, exocrine/endocrine insufficiency, typically alcohol-related) and its complications (malabsorption, diabetes).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Conversion Disorder (Functional Neurological Symptom Disorder).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize conversion disorder (>=1 symptom of altered voluntary motor or sensory function that is clinically incompatible with recognized neurological/medical disease) and the importance of a genuine, careful neurological workup to rule out organic disease rather than a purely exclusionary diagnosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anorectal disease diagnosis reasoning for Benign Anorectal Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose the cause of anorectal pain (hemorrhoids, fissure, abscess, fistula) and initiate an appropriate management plan, remaining cognizant of red flags for underlying malignancy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Endometriosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate initial management plan (e.g., hormonal suppression) and recognize indications for referral (e.g., infertility, refractory pain, suspected deep infiltrating disease).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Systemic sclerosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize systemic sclerosis and possible pulmonary, renal, or digital complications requiring referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pregnancy diagnosis reasoning for Diagnosis of Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret serum/urine beta-hCG and first-trimester ultrasound findings to confirm and date a pregnancy.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for CNS Infection and Demyelinating Disease Imaging (Meningitis/Encephalitis/Cerebral Abscess, Multiple Sclerosis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that MRI, not CT, is the preferred modality for suspected CNS infection or demyelinating disease, while understanding that a normal MRI does not exclude meningitis and must never delay empiric antibiotics.
candidates.study_unit: CNS Infection and Demyelinating Disease Imaging (Meningitis/Encephalitis/Cerebral Abscess, Multiple Sclerosis)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Presbycusis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize bilateral, symmetric, high-frequency-predominant SNHL developing with age as presbycusis and know management is hearing amplification rather than a search for a reversible cause.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition counselling reasoning for Gender Dysphoria.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize gender dysphoria (marked incongruence between experienced/expressed gender and assigned gender, with clinically significant distress) and provide respectful, affirming initial counselling and referral, without needing gender-affirming procedural/hormonal protocol detail.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Respiratory Infections (Pneumonia).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose community-acquired and nosocomial pneumonia, assess severity (e.g., using a validated clinical prediction rule), and initiate appropriate empiric management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply referral reasoning for General Approach to Interstitial Lung Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify progressive hypoxemia or uncertain ILD requiring specialist assessment.
candidates.study_unit: General Approach to Interstitial Lung Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply cspine clearance reasoning for C-Spine and Spinal Cord Trauma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply clinical criteria (e.g. Canadian C-Spine Rule) to determine need for spinal immobilization and imaging after trauma.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply manage reasoning for Gout.
candidates.source_competency_text: Apply broad initial management and prevention concepts without fixed regimens.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Sepsis and Septic Shock.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sepsis and septic shock, including patients with refractory shock unresponsive to fluids and vasopressors.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply legal professional action reasoning for Physician Competence and Professional Conduct.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize unprofessional conduct and determine an appropriate response, including reporting obligations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Abdominal X-Ray Indications and Systematic Approach (Free ABDO, Bowel Gas Patterns, Volvulus, Obstruction).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize free intraperitoneal air, bowel obstruction (small vs. large bowel dilation using the 3-6-9 rule), and volvulus patterns on AXR as indications for urgent surgical consultation.
candidates.study_unit: Abdominal X-Ray Indications and Systematic Approach (Free ABDO, Bowel Gas Patterns, Volvulus, Obstruction)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Hip Dislocation.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hip dislocation (classic shortened/internally rotated posterior vs. externally rotated anterior limb position) as an emergency requiring reduction within 6 h to reduce avascular necrosis risk, with sciatic nerve assessment for posterior dislocations.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply toxic adenoma mng reasoning for Toxic Adenoma and Toxic Multinodular Goitre.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish toxic adenoma and toxic multinodular goitre from Graves' disease by radioactive iodine uptake pattern and select radioactive iodine or surgical management.
candidates.study_unit: Toxic Adenoma and Toxic Multinodular Goitre

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis and management reasoning for Immune Thrombocytopenic Purpura (Pediatric).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize pediatric ITP (isolated thrombocytopenia, petechiae/bruising in an otherwise well child, often post-viral, diagnosis of exclusion) and that most cases are self-limited and observed, with treatment (IVIG, corticosteroids) reserved for significant bleeding.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Adults with developmental disabilities.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate disability-appropriate investigation, screening and preventive care, medication-safety review, and interdisciplinary coordination while anticipating longer-term health and safety needs.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sens spec calc reasoning for Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios).
candidates.source_competency_text: Calculate and interpret sensitivity, specificity, PPV, and NPV from a 2x2 table, and explain why PPV/NPV (unlike sensitivity/specificity) depend on disease prevalence.
candidates.study_unit: Interpreting Diagnostic Test Results (Sensitivity, Specificity, Predictive Values, Likelihood Ratios)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply crc management reasoning for Colorectal Carcinoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize presenting features of colorectal carcinoma, stage-appropriate initial workup, and general surgical management principles.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply ald recognition reasoning for Alcohol-Related Liver Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the spectrum of alcohol-related liver disease (steatosis, alcoholic hepatitis, cirrhosis) and screen for/address the underlying alcohol use disorder.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply anticipatory guidance reasoning for Injury Prevention Counselling (Age-Specific Anticipatory Guidance).
candidates.source_competency_text: Provide age-appropriate injury-prevention counselling (safe sleep positioning, car seat use, choking-hazard avoidance, water/pool safety, bike helmets) matched to a child's developmental stage.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply acute pancreatitis management reasoning for Acute Pancreatitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose acute pancreatitis (gallstone, alcohol, or other etiology), assess severity, and initiate an appropriate management plan (fluid resuscitation, analgesia, monitoring for complications).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Truncus Arteriosus.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize truncus arteriosus's pathophysiology (single great vessel gives rise to the aorta, pulmonary, and coronary arteries, overlying a large VSD) and the need for surgical repair within the first 6 wk of life.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pancreatic ca recognition reasoning for Pancreatic Cancer.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize painless obstructive jaundice and unexplained weight loss as red-flag features of pancreatic cancer and identify appropriate initial investigation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize indications for treatment (corticosteroids, IVIG, TPO-receptor agonists, splenectomy) based on bleeding severity and platelet count, and recognize when observation alone is appropriate.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply spectrum differentiation reasoning for Postpartum Mood Disorders.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate baby blues (self-limited, <2 wk) from postpartum depression from postpartum psychosis by symptom severity, timing, and presence of psychotic features.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Wrist and Thumb CMC Joint Arthritis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize primary/post-traumatic thumb CMC joint arthritis (pain with grind test, z-deformity) and know non-operative management (splinting, activity modification) precedes surgical options.
candidates.study_unit: Wrist and Thumb CMC Joint Arthritis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypercalcemia management reasoning for Hypercalcemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate emergency management of severe/symptomatic hypercalcemia (IV fluids, bisphosphonates, calcitonin).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Venous Thromboembolism: Diagnosis and Treatment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Use pretest probability (e.g., Wells score) combined with D-dimer and imaging (compression ultrasound for DVT, CT pulmonary angiography for PE) to diagnose VTE.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Chronic Otitis Media (Serous and Suppurative).
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish chronic serous otitis media (persistent straw-coloured effusion) from chronic suppurative otitis media (>6 wk purulent drainage through a perforated TM or ventilation tube) and know both warrant ENT referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply provider wellbeing reasoning for Self-Care for Palliative Care Providers.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize that provider self-care positively predicts compassion satisfaction and negatively predicts burnout/compassion fatigue, and identify workplace and personal self-care strategies.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Pain Syndromes: Neuropathic Pain, Trigeminal Neuralgia, Postherpetic Neuralgia, Painful Diabetic Neuropathy, and Complex Regional Pain Syndrome.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical pattern of neuropathic pain (burning, shooting, allodynia) and identify the specific syndrome (trigeminal neuralgia, postherpetic neuralgia, painful diabetic neuropathy, CRPS) from history, then outline first-line pharmacotherapy.
candidates.study_unit: Pain Syndromes: Neuropathic Pain, Trigeminal Neuralgia, Postherpetic Neuralgia, Painful Diabetic Neuropathy, and Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Nicotine Use Disorder.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the characteristic intoxication/withdrawal presentation and health consequences of this substance.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Fibroids (Uterine Leiomyoma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize fibroids (uterine leiomyoma) as a common benign cause of a pelvic/uterine mass and of heavy or abnormal uterine bleeding, and identify major epidemiologic risk factors (age, Black patients affected earlier/more severely).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial management reasoning for Coronary Revascularization (PCI vs CABG).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize clinical scenarios favouring PCI vs. CABG (e.g., left main/multivessel disease, diabetes, surgical candidacy) at a conceptual level.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Acute Coronary Syndromes.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret serial ECG and troponin trends to risk-stratify ACS.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply scar recognition reasoning for Dermatologic Emergencies (SJS/TEN, DRESS Syndrome).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SJS/TEN, DRESS) and estimate body-surface-area involvement to guide urgent management/burn-unit referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply acute abd pain ddx reasoning for Differential Diagnosis of Acute Abdominal Pain (Surgical Approach).
candidates.source_competency_text: Generate and prioritize a surgical differential diagnosis for acute abdominal pain by location/quadrant, and identify features suggesting a surgical emergency (peritonitis, hemodynamic instability).
candidates.study_unit: Differential Diagnosis of Acute Abdominal Pain (Surgical Approach)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pituitary mass effect reasoning for Pituitary Adenoma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize bitemporal hemianopia and headache as suggesting a pituitary mass and the indication for pituitary MRI and endocrine workup; the endocrine hypersecretion/hypopituitarism syndromes themselves are primarily Endocrinology-owned content.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Asbestos-Related Pleural Disease and Mesothelioma.
candidates.source_competency_text: Arrange appropriate imaging, pleural assessment, exposure counselling, and specialist referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply pruritus approach reasoning for Pruritus (Approach to Generalized Itch).
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate pruritus with an identifiable primary skin lesion from generalized pruritus without skin lesions, and initiate an appropriate systemic workup (CBC, renal/hepatic function, TSH) for the latter.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply bradyarrhythmia reasoning for Intraoperative Cardiac Arrest and Arrhythmias.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize intraoperative bradycardia causes that require urgent action (high-grade heart block risk of asystole) vs. benign causes (vagal reflex, drug effect).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Influenza.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize influenza's clinical presentation and differentiate from other respiratory infections (e.g., COVID-19).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Cardiac Infections (Infective Endocarditis).
candidates.source_competency_text: Identify indications for antibiotic prophylaxis prior to dental/respiratory procedures in high-risk cardiac patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Systemic Diseases with Renal Manifestations: Diabetic Nephropathy, Scleroderma Renal Crisis, Multiple Myeloma, and Malignancy-Associated Renal Disease.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize diabetic nephropathy, scleroderma renal crisis, myeloma-associated renal disease, and malignancy-associated renal disease as renal manifestations of systemic disease, and identify indications suggesting a non-diabetic cause of renal disease in a patient with diabetes.
candidates.study_unit: Systemic Diseases with Renal Manifestations: Diabetic Nephropathy, Scleroderma Renal Crisis, Multiple Myeloma, and Malignancy-Associated Renal Disease

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Parasitic Infections: Protozoa (Entamoeba, Giardia, Trichomonas, Cryptosporidium).
candidates.source_competency_text: Diagnose amoebiasis, giardiasis, trichomoniasis, and cryptosporidiosis based on exposure history and stool/wet-mount findings.
candidates.study_unit: Parasitic Infections: Protozoa (Entamoeba, Giardia, Trichomonas, Cryptosporidium)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply suicide risk assessment reasoning for Suicidal Patient (Risk Assessment and Management).
candidates.source_competency_text: Assess suicide risk (ideation, intent, plan, means, protective factors) and determine ED disposition, including certification criteria.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognize reasoning for Systemic lupus erythematosus and Raynaud phenomenon.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize multisystem features that suggest SLE.
candidates.study_unit: Systemic lupus erythematosus and Raynaud phenomenon

candidates.principal_decision: Apply initial action reasoning for Aortic Dissection.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate stabilization and urgent specialist/emergency escalation.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hemorrhoid management reasoning for Hemorrhoids.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish internal from external hemorrhoids, grade internal hemorrhoids, and identify indications for medical vs. procedural/surgical management.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Abnormal Uterine Bleeding.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate an appropriate management plan and recognize when bleeding severity requires urgent intervention.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigate reasoning for Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies.
candidates.source_competency_text: Initiate basic evaluation and identify respiratory or swallowing risk requiring urgent referral.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition iris reasoning for Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) as a diagnosis of exclusion following ART initiation.
candidates.study_unit: Infections in the Immunocompromised Host (Febrile Neutropenia, Solid Organ Transplant Recipients, IRIS)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Acute Kidney Injury: Classification, Prerenal/Renal/Postrenal Approach, and Management.
candidates.source_competency_text: Construct an initial management plan including correction of prerenal factors, discontinuation of nephrotoxic drugs, treatment of complications (fluid overload, hyperkalemia, acidosis), and recognition of indications for urgent dialysis.
candidates.study_unit: Acute Kidney Injury: Classification, Prerenal/Renal/Postrenal Approach, and Management

candidates.principal_decision: Apply exam interpretation reasoning for Pupillary Examination and Abnormalities.
candidates.source_competency_text: Perform and interpret the pupillary light reflex, and recognize RAPD (optic nerve/severe retinal disease), pupil-involving vs. pupil-sparing third-nerve palsy (surgical emergency vs. microvascular), and pharmacologic vs. neurologic mydriasis/miosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply complications reasoning for Cardiomyopathies (Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize arrhythmia and heart failure as shared complications across cardiomyopathy subtypes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differentiation reasoning for Skin Conditions of the Neonate (Benign Findings, Differential).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize common benign, self-resolving neonatal skin findings (erythema toxicum, milia, Mongolian spots) and distinguish them from findings warranting further evaluation.
candidates.study_unit: Skin Conditions of the Neonate (Benign Findings, Differential)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply diagnosis reasoning for Pulmonary Vascular Abnormalities: Pulmonary Edema and Pulmonary Embolism Imaging.
candidates.source_competency_text: Select CT pulmonary angiography as the definitive imaging study for suspected pulmonary embolism, and recognize V/Q scan as the preferred alternative in patients with renal impairment or in pregnancy.
candidates.study_unit: Pulmonary Vascular Abnormalities: Pulmonary Edema and Pulmonary Embolism Imaging

candidates.principal_decision: Apply normal vs pathologic reasoning for Maternal Physiologic Adaptations to Pregnancy.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish expected physiologic changes of pregnancy (e.g., dilutional anemia, physiologic edema, supine hypotension, increased cardiac output) from pathologic findings.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Blood and Tissue Infections (Malaria, Trypanosoma cruzi, Toxoplasma gondii).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Toxoplasma gondii reactivation as an opportunistic CNS infection in advanced HIV.
candidates.study_unit: Blood and Tissue Infections (Malaria, Trypanosoma cruzi, Toxoplasma gondii)

candidates.principal_decision: Apply sick euthyroid reasoning for Non-Thyroidal Illness (Sick Euthyroid Syndrome).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize sick euthyroid syndrome (abnormal TFTs in severe systemic illness without true thyroid disease) and avoid inappropriate thyroid hormone treatment.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Cardiomyopathies (Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize hypertrophic cardiomyopathy as a cause of exertional syncope/sudden death in young patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply screening reasoning for Cervical Cancer and Cervical Cancer Screening.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the population and interval eligible for cervical cancer screening and the appropriate next step for an abnormal screening result.
candidates.study_unit: Cervical Cancer and Cervical Cancer Screening

candidates.principal_decision: Apply investigation reasoning for Congestive Heart Failure.
candidates.source_competency_text: Interpret BNP/NT-proBNP and echocardiographic ejection fraction in context.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply hypothermia rewarming reasoning for Hypothermia and Cold-Related Injury (incl. Frostbite).
candidates.source_competency_text: Select active vs. passive re-warming strategy based on hypothermia severity.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply management reasoning for Colles' Fracture.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Colles' fracture ('dinner fork' deformity) on exam and x-ray, and know closed reduction with casting is standard for most; consider underlying osteoporosis workup in older patients.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Tubulointerstitial Disease: Acute Interstitial Nephritis and Acute Tubular Necrosis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize acute interstitial nephritis (drug-induced, urine eosinophils) and acute tubular necrosis (ischemic or nephrotoxic) as the major intrinsic-renal causes of AKI and distinguish them by history and urine microscopy.
candidates.study_unit: Tubulointerstitial Disease: Acute Interstitial Nephritis and Acute Tubular Necrosis

candidates.principal_decision: Apply differential reasoning for Palpitations.
candidates.source_competency_text: Differentiate benign (anxiety, caffeine, PACs) from arrhythmic causes.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply prevention reasoning for Influenza.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recommend annual influenza vaccination per PHAC guidance.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis (SCFE).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize SCFE in an obese adolescent presenting with hip, groin, thigh, or referred knee pain and a limp/externally-rotated gait, requiring urgent non-weight-bearing status and orthopedic referral to prevent AVN.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Hypotonic Infant.
candidates.source_competency_text: Localize hypotonia as central (encephalopathic, more common: preserved strength, associated dysmorphism/seizures/altered alertness) vs. peripheral (motor unit disease: weakness prominent, areflexia, tongue fasciculations) using history and exam.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply threshold recognition reasoning for Ontario Mental Health Act: Common Forms and Involuntary Psychiatric Assessment.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize the clinical threshold for initiating an involuntary psychiatric assessment (imminent danger to self/others, or incapacity for self-care due to apparent mental disorder), independent of the exact provincial form numbers/names, which are jurisdiction-specific and not to be hard-coded as generalizable fact.
candidates.study_unit: Ontario Mental Health Act: Common Forms and Involuntary Psychiatric Assessment

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Wilms' Tumour (Nephroblastoma).
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize Wilms tumour as the classic pediatric renal mass (painless abdominal/flank mass typically found incidentally, does not cross midline, +/- hematuria/hypertension) and its associated syndromes (WAGR, Beckwith-Wiedemann, hemihypertrophy).

candidates.principal_decision: Apply recognition reasoning for Essential Thrombocythemia.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize essential thrombocythemia as a clonal cause of marked thrombocytosis with elevated thrombosis (and paradoxical bleeding) risk, distinguished from reactive thrombocytosis.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply red flags reasoning for Periorbital (Preseptal) and Orbital Cellulitis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish preseptal (periorbital swelling/erythema without ophthalmoplegia, proptosis, or pain with eye movement) from orbital cellulitis (ophthalmoplegia, proptosis, painful/limited eye movement, decreased visual acuity), the latter being a surgical/ophthalmologic emergency requiring IV antibiotics and imaging.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply approach reasoning for Encopresis.
candidates.source_competency_text: Recognize encopresis as most commonly overflow soiling from chronic functional constipation with rectal impaction, requiring disimpaction and maintenance therapy rather than behavioural management alone; distinguish from non-retentive fecal incontinence.

candidates.principal_decision: Apply triage reasoning for Congenital Nasolacrimal Duct Obstruction and Ophthalmia Neonatorum.
candidates.source_competency_text: Distinguish benign congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (tearing, usually resolves by age 1) from ophthalmia neonatorum (purulent neonatal conjunctivitis), which requires urgent evaluation for gonococcal/chlamydial infection given the risk of corneal perforation and systemic spread.
candidates.study_unit: Congenital Nasolacrimal Duct Obstruction and Ophthalmia Neonatorum

candidates.principal_decision: Apply safety reasoning for Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT).
